entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Actions
entities.Description: List   of   all   actions   that   are   possible   across   all   AI   Models

Fields.Name: DefaultPrompt
Fields.Description: The   standard   prompt   template   used   when   invoking   this   AI   action ,  can   include   placeholders   for   dynamic   values .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Controls   whether   this   AI   action   is   currently   available   for   use   across   the   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Actions
entities.Description: Table   to   store   the   relationship   between   AI   agents   and   actions .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: The   unique   identifier   for   each   AI   agent - action   mapping .  Serves   as   the   primary   key .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: References   the   unique   identifier   of   the   associated   AI   agent   from   the   AIAgent   table .

Fields.Name: ActionID
Fields.Description: References   the   unique   identifier   of   the   associated   action   from   the   Action   table .

Fields.Name: MinExecutionsPerRun
Fields.Description: Minimum   number   of   times   this   action   must   be   executed   per   agent   run

Fields.Name: MaxExecutionsPerRun
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   times   this   action   can   be   executed   per   agent   run

Fields.Name: ResultExpirationTurns
Fields.Description: Number   of   conversation   turns   before   action   results   expire   from   conversation   context .  NULL  =  never   expire  ( default ).  0  =  expire   immediately   after   next   turn .

Fields.Name: ResultExpirationMode
Fields.Description: How   to   handle   expired   action   results :  None  ( no   expiration ,  default ),  Remove  ( delete   message   entirely ),  Compact  ( reduce   size   via   CompactMode   while   preserving   key   information ).

Fields.Name: CompactMode
Fields.Description: How   to   compact   results   when   ResultExpirationMode = Compact :  FirstNChars  ( truncate   to   CompactLength   characters ,  fast   and   free ),  AISummary  ( use   LLM   to   intelligently   summarize   with   CompactPromptID   or   Action . DefaultCompactPromptID ).

Fields.Name: CompactLength
Fields.Description: Number   of   characters   to   keep   when   CompactMode = FirstNChars .  Required   when   CompactMode   is   FirstNChars ,  ignored   otherwise .

Fields.Name: CompactPromptID
Fields.Description: Optional   override   for   AI   summarization   prompt   when   CompactMode = AISummary .  Lookup   hierarchy :  this   field  ->  Action . DefaultCompactPromptID  ->  system   default .  Allows   agent - specific   summarization   focus  ( e . g .,  technical   vs .  marketing   perspective ).

Fields.Name: DeclareAsNativeTool
Fields.Description: Whether   this   Action   may   be   declared   as   a   native   tool   for   this   agent  ( 1 ,  default ).  0   keeps   it   out   of   the   tool   set   on   native   turns ;  because   the   prose   catalog   is   not   rendered   in   native   mode ,  the   action   is   then   unavailable   on   those   turns .  Use   for   actions   an   agent   holds   but   should   rarely   reach   for   on   its   own .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Artifact   Types
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   AI   Agents   to   the   artifact   types   they   can   produce .  An   agent   can   produce   zero   to   many   artifact   types .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: AI   Agent   that   can   produce   this   artifact   type

Fields.Name: ArtifactTypeID
Fields.Description: Artifact   type   that   this   agent   can   produce

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Optional   sequence   for   ordering   multiple   artifact   types   for   an   agent

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Categories
entities.Description: Hierarchical   organizational   grouping   for   AI   agents .  Categories   form   a   tree   via   the   ParentID   self - referencing   foreign   key   and   can   carry   inherited   assignment   strategies .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   for   the   AIAgentCategory   record .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   display   name   for   the   category  ( e . g .,  Research ,  Customer   Support ,  Data   Processing ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   explaining   the   purpose   and   scope   of   this   category .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Self - referencing   foreign   key   to   the   parent   category ,  forming   a   tree   hierarchy .  NULL   for   root   categories .

Fields.Name: AssignmentStrategy
Fields.Description: JSON - serialized   AgentRequestAssignmentStrategy   defining   who   receives   feedback   requests   for   agents   in   this   category .  Inherited   by   child   categories   that   do   not   define   their   own   strategy .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Whether   this   category   is   Active ,  Disabled ,  or   Pending .

Fields.Name: DefaultStorageAccountID
Fields.Description: Default   file   storage   account   for   agents   in   this   category .  Inherited   by   child   categories   that   do   not   define   their   own   value  —  resolution   walks   up   the   ParentID   tree   until   a   non - null   value   is   found .  Overrides   the   Type - level   default .  FK   to   FileStorageAccount .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   channel   definition   name  ( e . g .  VoiceAudio ,  TextChat ,  ClientControl ,  Whiteboard ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   human - readable   description   of   what   the   channel   surface   does .

Fields.Name: ServerPluginClass
Fields.Description: Driver   key   resolved   at   runtime   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance   on   the   server .  MUST   match   the  @ RegisterClass   key   on   the   concrete   server - side   channel   plugin .

Fields.Name: ClientPluginClass
Fields.Description: Driver   key   resolved   at   runtime   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance   on   the   client .  MUST   match   the  @ RegisterClass   key   on   the   concrete   client - side   channel   plugin  ( typically   an   Angular   component ).

Fields.Name: TransportType
Fields.Description: Which   transport   plane   this   channel   rides :  PubSub  ( the   shared   control   plane ),  WebRTC  ( binary   media ),  or   WebSocket .

Fields.Name: ConfigSchema
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   Schema   used   to   validate   the   per - instance   channel   configuration  ( AIAgentSessionChannel . Config ).

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   channel   definition   is   available   for   use .  Inactive   channels   cannot   be   attached   to   a   session .

Fields.Name: IsHeadless
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   channel   has   no   visible   surface   and   is   never   mounted   as   a   tab  —  it   is   a   live   wire  ( e . g .  the   headless   ClientContextChannel   that   streams   app   context  +  capability   manifest   to   the   co - agent ).  When   0  ( default ),  the   channel   renders   a   surface .

Fields.Name: UIConfig
Fields.Description: Channel - definition - level   presentation / chrome   config   JSON  ( shape  =  IChannelUIConfig ):  tab   DisplayName ,  GroupName ,  Color  ( prefer   a   design - token   name ),  Icon ,  SortOrder .  Distinct   from   ConfigSchema ,  which   validates   per - session   AIAgentSessionChannel . Config   state - of - record .  Null  =  host   defaults .

Fields.Name: IsRequired
Fields.Description: When   true ,  the   agent   expects   this   tool   to   always   be   available   on   the   client .  If   the   client   has   not   registered   a   handler ,  agent   execution   may   warn   or   fail   depending   on   configuration .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Sort   order   for   tool   listing   in   prompts .  Lower   numbers   appear   first .  Tools   with   the   same   priority   are   listed   alphabetically .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Co   Agents
entities.Description: Agent - to - agent   affinity   registry .  Today :  OPT - IN   co - agent   pairings  —  which   underlying   agents  ( or   whole   agent   types )  a   Realtime - type   co - agent   can   front   in   live   sessions .  A   co - agent   with   NO   rows   is   universal  ( fronts   any   single   agent   supplied   at   runtime  —  the   zero - config   default );  rows   restrict   the   co - agent   to   a   prebuilt   target   list .  The   Type   column   reserves   future   relationship   natures  ( Peer / Delegate / Fallback / Reviewer / Observer ).  Distinct   from   AIAgentRelationship ,  which   wires   agent - to - SUB - AGENT   invocation  ( mappings ,  message   modes );  this   table   is   peer   affinity   with   no   invocation   config .

Fields.Name: CoAgentID
Fields.Description: The   relationship   OWNER .  For   Type = CoAgent   this   is   the   Realtime - type   co - agent  ( the   live   voice );  it   must   be   an   Active   agent   of   the   Realtime   type  ( enforced   server - side ).  For   reserved   future   types ,  the   agent   the   relationship   is   read   FROM .

Fields.Name: TargetAgentID
Fields.Description: A   specific   paired   agent  —  for   Type = CoAgent ,  an   underlying   agent   this   co - agent   can   front .  Exactly   one   of   TargetAgentID  /  TargetAgentTypeID   is   set   per   row .

Fields.Name: TargetAgentTypeID
Fields.Description: A   whole   agent   TYPE   as   the   paired   side  —  for   Type = CoAgent ,  this   co - agent   applies   to   every   agent   of   the   type  ( with   IsDefault = 1 ,  it   is   the   type - level   default   co - agent ,  replacing   a   column - based   default   that   would   create   an   AIAgent ↔ AIAgentType   FK   cycle ).  Exactly   one   of   TargetAgentID  /  TargetAgentTypeID   is   set   per   row .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Nature   of   the   relationship ,  read   CoAgentID  →  target   side .  CoAgent  =  the   owner   can   front   the   target   in   realtime   sessions  ( the   ONLY   type   implemented   today ).  Peer  ( agent - to - agent   conversation   partners ),  Delegate  ( handoff / escalation ),  Fallback  ( substitute   when   owner   unavailable ),  Reviewer  ( target   reviews   owner   output ),  Observer  ( target   observes   owner   sessions )  are   RESERVED   for   future   features  —  the   vocabulary   ships   now   so   generated   string - union   types   stay   stable .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: When   1 :  for   a   TargetAgentID   row ,  this   target   is   the   co - agent ' s   default   underlying   agent  ( used   when   a   session   starts   against   the   co - agent   without   an   explicit   runtime   target );  for   a   TargetAgentTypeID   row ,  this   co - agent   is   the   default   co - agent   for   agents   of   that   type .  At   most   one   default   per  ( CoAgentID ,  Type )  is   enforced   server - side .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display / priority   order   of   this   pairing   in   target - agent   pickers   and   resolution   ties  ( ascending ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Whether   this   pairing   participates   in   resolution .  Disabled   rows   are   kept   for   audit / toggling   but   ignored   by   the   resolution   chain   and   pickers .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Optional   per - relationship   configuration   JSON  ( shape   owned   by   the   Type ,  e . g .  a   future   Peer   arena ' s   turn   budget ).  NULL   for   plain   pairings .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Configurations
entities.Description: Defines   semantic   configuration   presets   for   agents ,  allowing   users   to   select   between   different   AI   model   configurations  ( e . g .,  Fast ,  Balanced ,  High   Quality )  when   executing   an   agent .  Each   preset   maps   to   an   AI   Configuration   which   controls   model   selection   across   all   prompts .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   Key  -  Unique   identifier   for   the   agent   configuration   preset

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   Key  -  The   agent   this   configuration   preset   belongs   to

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Code - friendly   name   for   the   preset  ( e . g .,  HighPower ,  Fast ,  Balanced ).  Used   in   API   calls   and   metadata   references .

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: User - friendly   display   name   shown   in   UI  ( e . g ., " High   Quality ", " Quick   Draft ", " Maximum   Detail ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   shown   to   users   explaining   what   this   configuration   does  ( e . g ., " Uses   Claude   Opus   for   highest   quality   results ")

Fields.Name: AIConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   Key  -  Optional   AI   Configuration   to   use   for   this   preset .  If   NULL ,  uses   default   configuration  ( prompts   with   ConfigurationID   IS   NULL )

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   the   default   preset   for   the   agent .  Should   have   exactly   one   default   per   agent .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Display   order   for   UI .  Lower   numbers   appear   first .  Typical   values :  100  ( Default ),  200  ( Fast ),  300  ( Balanced ),  400  ( High   Quality )

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   preset :  Pending  ( being   configured ),  Active  ( available   for   use ),  Revoked  ( no   longer   available )

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Credentials
entities.Description: Credentials   an   agent   carries   into   its   harness   sandbox ,  injected   as   environment   variables   at   session   creation .  Custody   of   the   secret   itself   stays   in   Credential / CredentialEngine  -  this   table   records   only   the   GRANT   EDGE ,  in   the   same   reviewable   style   as   AIAgentAction .  Distinct   from   AICredentialBinding ,  which   is   inference - selection   plumbing   for   AIPromptRunner   failover   when   MJ   itself   executes   a   prompt .

Fields.Name: Purpose
Fields.Description: What   this   credential   is   for .  HarnessLLM   is   the   API   key   the   harness   uses   to   reach   its   own   model   vendor ;  when   absent ,  the   runtime   falls   back   to   vendor - scoped   AICredentialBinding   rows   for   AIAgentHarness . AIVendorID .  Integration   is   any   other   granted   secret   the   agent   needs   inside   the   sandbox ,  such   as   a   source - control   or   ticketing   token .

Fields.Name: EnvVariableName
Fields.Description: Environment   variable   the   adapter   sets   inside   the   sandbox   for   this   credential ,  e . g .  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY   or   GITHUB_TOKEN .  NULL   lets   the   adapter   choose ,  which   is   the   normal   case   for   HarnessLLM   because   the   adapter   knows   its   own   vendor ' s   variable   name .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Failover   ordering   within   a   Purpose  -  lower   runs   first .  Lets   an   agent   carry   a   primary   and   a   standby   key   for   the   same   purpose   without   a   schema   change .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Whether   this   grant   is   live .  Revoked   withdraws   the   credential   from   future   sessions   while   preserving   the   record   that   it   was   once   granted ,  which   is   the   point   of   auditing   a   credential   grant   at   all .  Pending   stages   a   grant   that   is   not   yet   in   force .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Data   Sources
entities.Description: Defines   data   sources   that   should   be   preloaded   into   the   data   parameter   before   agent   execution .  Supports   both   RunView   and   RunQuery   sources   with   configurable   caching .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Variable   name   for   the   data   in   the   data   parameter  ( e . g ., " ALL_ENTITIES ").  Must   be   unique   within   an   agent .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   what   this   data   source   provides

Fields.Name: SourceType
Fields.Description: Type   of   data   source :  RunView   or   RunQuery .  Determines   which   parameters   are   used .

Fields.Name: EntityName
Fields.Description: Entity   name   for   RunView   data   sources  ( e . g ., " Entities ", " AI   Models ")

Fields.Name: ExtraFilter
Fields.Description: SQL   WHERE   clause   filter   for   RunView   data   sources

Fields.Name: OrderBy
Fields.Description: SQL   ORDER   BY   clause   for   RunView   data   sources

Fields.Name: FieldsToRetrieve
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   field   names   to   return   for   RunView   data   sources  ( e . g ., [" ID ", " Name ", " Description "])

Fields.Name: ResultType
Fields.Description: Result   type   for   RunView :  simple  ( default )  or   entity_object

Fields.Name: QueryName
Fields.Description: Query   name   for   RunQuery   data   sources

Fields.Name: CategoryPath
Fields.Description: Category   path   for   RunQuery   data   sources  ( e . g ., "/ MJ / AI / Agents /")

Fields.Name: Parameters
Fields.Description: JSON   object   of   parameters   for   RunQuery   data   sources  ( e . g ., {" organizationId ": " 123 "})

Fields.Name: MaxRows
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   rows   to   return .  Applies   to   both   RunView   and   RunQuery .

Fields.Name: ExecutionOrder
Fields.Description: Execution   order   when   multiple   data   sources   are   defined   for   an   agent  ( lower   numbers   execute   first )

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   data   source :  Active   or   Disabled

Fields.Name: CachePolicy
Fields.Description: Cache   policy :  None  ( no   caching ),  PerRun  ( cache   for   duration   of   agent   run ),  PerAgent  ( cache   across   runs   with   timeout )

Fields.Name: CacheTimeoutSeconds
Fields.Description: Time - to - live   in   seconds   for   PerAgent   cache   policy .  Ignored   for   other   cache   policies .

Fields.Name: DestinationType
Fields.Description: Destination   for   the   preloaded   data :  Data  ( for   Nunjucks   templates   in   prompts ),  Context  ( for   actions   only ),  or   Payload  ( for   agent   state )

Fields.Name: DestinationPath
Fields.Description: Path   within   the   destination   where   data   should   be   injected .  Supports   nested   paths   using   dot   notation  ( e . g ., " config . api . endpoints ", " analysis . orders . recent ").  If   null ,  uses   Name   as   root - level   key .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Examples
entities.Description: Stores   example   input / output   pairs   for   AI   agents   to   learn   from   successful   interactions .  Examples   are   always   agent - specific   and   support   optional   user / company   scoping   for   personalized   examples .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: The   AI   agent   this   example   is   associated   with .  Examples   are   always   agent - specific .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: Optional   user   scope .  When   populated ,  this   example   is   specific   to   this   user .

Fields.Name: CompanyID
Fields.Description: Optional   company   scope .  When   populated ,  this   example   is   specific   to   this   company .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Quick   categorization   of   the   example :  Preference  ( demonstrates   user   preference ),  Constraint  ( shows   constraint   compliance ),  Context  ( provides   contextual   example ),  Example  ( typical   successful   interaction  -  most   common ),  or   Issue  ( demonstrates   handling   of   known   issue ).

Fields.Name: ExampleInput
Fields.Description: The   input   text   or   prompt   that   was   provided   in   this   example   interaction .

Fields.Name: ExampleOutput
Fields.Description: The   successful   output   or   response   that   the   agent   provided   for   this   example .

Fields.Name: IsAutoGenerated
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   example   was   automatically   captured  ( 1 )  or   manually   created  ( 0 ).

Fields.Name: SourceConversationID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   conversation   where   this   example   originated .

Fields.Name: SourceConversationDetailID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   specific   conversation   message   that   represents   this   example .

Fields.Name: SourceAIAgentRunID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   AI   agent   run   that   generated   this   example .

Fields.Name: SuccessScore
Fields.Description: Optional   success   score  ( 0 - 100 )  indicating   the   quality   or   effectiveness   of   this   example   based   on   user   feedback   or   metrics .

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Internal   comments   about   this   example ,  not   included   in   agent   context   injection .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   example :  Pending  ( awaiting   review ),  Active  ( in   use ),  or   Revoked  ( disabled ).

Fields.Name: EmbeddingVector
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   embedding   vector   for   semantic   search   on   ExampleInput   field .  Auto - generated   when   ExampleInput   changes .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AI   model   used   to   generate   the   embedding   vector .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeEntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Entity   table   identifying   which   entity   type   is   used   for   primary   scoping .  NULL   means   this   is   a   global   example .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: The   record   ID   within   the   primary   scope   entity .  NULL   means   global   example .  When   set   with   empty   SecondaryScopes ,  indicates   primary - scope - only   example .

Fields.Name: SecondaryScopes
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   additional   scope   dimensions .  Empty / NULL   with   PrimaryScopeRecordID   set  =  org - level   example .  Populated  =  fully - scoped   example .

Fields.Name: LastAccessedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   this   example   was   last   accessed / used   for   agent   context .  Used   for   lifecycle   management   and   cleanup .

Fields.Name: AccessCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   times   this   example   has   been   accessed / used .  Used   for   analytics   and   determining   example   value .

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Optional   expiration   timestamp .  Examples   past   this   date   are   candidates   for   archival .  NULL   means   no   expiration .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Harnesses
entities.Description: Registry   of   external   agent   harnesses   this   installation   can   launch   as   the   reasoning   substrate   for   an   MJ   agent  ( Claude   Code ,  Codex   CLI ,  OpenCode ,  Pi ,  Cline ).  A   row   makes   a   harness   AVAILABLE ;  an   agent   opts   in   by   naming   it   in   AIAgent . TypeConfiguration .  Empty   table  =  no   agent   can   run   on   a   harness ,  which   is   the   pre - migration   behaviour .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   of   the   harness ,  e . g .  Claude   Code ,  Codex   CLI ,  OpenCode ,  Pi ,  Cline .  This   is   a   LOOKUP   KEY ,  not   a   label :  an   agent   selects   its   harness   by   this   name   in   AIAgent . TypeConfiguration  (" harnessName "),  so   duplicates   would   make   selection   ambiguous   at   run   time .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   of   the   harness  -  what   it   is   good   at ,  what   it   requires   to   be   installed ,  and   any   deployment   caveats .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: ClassFactory   registration   key   for   the   BaseHarnessAdapter   subclass   that   drives   this   harness  ( e . g .  ClaudeCodeAdapter ,  CodexAdapter ,  StdioJsonAdapter ).  Resolved   at   run   time ,  so   a   customer   can   register   a   proprietary   adapter   without   forking   core  -  the   same   extension   mechanism   AI   model   vendor   drivers   use .

Fields.Name: ExecutablePath
Fields.Description: Path   to   the   harness   CLI   binary   or   entry   point   when   the   adapter   shells   out .  NULL   when   the   adapter   embeds   a   vendor   SDK   and   therefore   launches   nothing .

Fields.Name: DefaultModel
Fields.Description: Default   model   passed   to   the   harness   where   the   harness   supports   being   told   which   model   to   use .  NULL   leaves   the   harness   on   its   own   default .

Fields.Name: CapabilitySettings
Fields.Description: Strongly - typed   JSON   of   what   this   harness   can   do  ( the   IHarnessCapabilitySettings   interface ,  bound   via   JSONType   metadata ):  session   continuity  ( SessionResume ),  turn - protocol   support  ( StructuredOutput ),  in - sandbox   permission   interception  ( PermissionHooks ),  and   whether   the   harness   can   act   as   an   MCP   client   for   the   read - only   loopback  ( McpClient ).  The   runtime   gates   behaviour   on   these  -  when   SessionResume   is   false   the   adapter   must   replay   prior   context   into   a   fresh   invocation   each   turn ,  which   costs   extra   tokens   and   has   to   be   budgeted   for .  Held   as   JSON   so   a   new   capability   needs   no   schema   migration ,  just   an   added   property   on   the   interface .  NULL / omitted  =  not   supported .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Whether   this   harness   may   be   launched .  Inactive   keeps   the   row   and   its   history   for   auditing   while   taking   the   harness   out   of   service  -  preferable   to   deleting   it ,  which   would   orphan   agents   configured   to   use   it .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Learning   Cycles
entities.Description: Tracks   the   learning   cycles   for   AI   Agents   where   the   Agent   does   offline   reasoning ,  reflection ,  learning ,  and   updates   metadata .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Unique   identifier   for   the   learning   cycle .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Identifier   for   the   AI   Agent   associated   with   this   learning   cycle .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   indicating   when   the   learning   cycle   started .

Fields.Name: EndedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   indicating   when   the   learning   cycle   ended .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   learning   cycle  ( In - Progress ,  Complete ,  or   Failed ).

Fields.Name: AgentSummary
Fields.Description: Text   summary   provided   by   the   agent   about   what   it   learned   and   any   changes   it   requested   for   stored   metadata .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Modalities
entities.Description: Agent - level   modality   configuration .  Allows   agents   to   restrict   or   customize   modality   settings   beyond   what   the   model   supports .  Absence   of   a   record   means   the   agent   uses   model   defaults  ( Text   in / out   assumed   if   no   records   exist ).

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   an   Input   or   Output   modality   for   the   agent .

Fields.Name: IsAllowed
Fields.Description: Whether   this   modality   is   allowed   for   this   agent .  Set   to   FALSE   to   disable   a   modality   even   if   the   underlying   model   supports   it .

Fields.Name: MaxSizeBytes
Fields.Description: Agent - specific   maximum   size   in   bytes .  Overrides   model   and   system   defaults .  Must   be   less   than   or   equal   to   model   limit .

Fields.Name: MaxCountPerMessage
Fields.Description: Agent - specific   maximum   count   per   message .  Overrides   model   and   system   defaults .  Must   be   less   than   or   equal   to   model   limit .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Models
entities.Description: Table   to   store   the   relationship   between   AI   agents   and   AI   models .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: The   unique   identifier   for   each   AI   agent - model   mapping .  Serves   as   the   primary   key .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: References   the   unique   identifier   of   the   associated   AI   agent   from   AIAgent   table .

Fields.Name: ModelID
Fields.Description: The   unique   identifier   of   the   associated   AI   model .

Fields.Name: Active
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   specific   agent - model   combination   is   currently   enabled   for   use   in   AI   operations .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: The   priority   level   of   the   AI   model   for   the   agent ,  where   higher   values   indicate   higher   priority .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Note   Types
entities.Description: Defines   categories   and   types   for   AI   agent   notes ,  enabling   classification   and   organization   of   agent - generated   observations ,  recommendations ,  and   learnings .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Priority   for   injection   ordering .  Lower   numbers   are   injected   first  ( 0   is   highest   priority ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   note   type :  Pending  ( awaiting   approval ),  Active  ( available   for   use ),  or   Revoked  ( deprecated ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Notes
entities.Description: Stores   notes ,  observations ,  and   learnings   for   AI   agents   with   multi - dimensional   scoping  ( Agent ,  User ,  company ).  Scoping   is   determined   by   which   FK   fields   are   populated :  all   NULL  =  global ,  AgentID   only  =  agent - specific ,  UserID   only  =  user - specific   across   all   agents ,  etc .

Fields.Name: Note
Fields.Description: The   content   of   the   note ,  observation ,  or   learning   captured   by   the   AI   agent   during   its   execution .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   referencing   the   ID   column   in   the   User   table ,  indicating   the   user   associated   with   the   note .  Used   when   Type = User

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Quick   categorization   of   the   note   content :  Preference  ( user   preferences ),  Constraint  ( hard   rules / requirements ),  Context  ( background   information ),  Example  ( sample   interactions ),  or   Issue  ( known   problems / limitations ).  Complements   the   more   detailed   AIAgentNoteType   categorization .

Fields.Name: IsAutoGenerated
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   note   was   automatically   generated   by   an   AI   agent  ( 1 )  or   manually   created  ( 0 ).

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Internal   comments   about   this   note ,  not   included   in   agent   context   injection .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status   of   the   note .  Pending  =  awaiting   approval ,  Active  =  vetted   and   injectable ,  Provisional  =  written   in - flight   by   an   agent  ( immediately   injectable ,  awaiting   Memory   Manager   hardening   to   Active ),  Revoked  =  superseded / withdrawn ,  Archived  =  retired   by   consolidation   or   decay .

Fields.Name: SourceConversationID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   conversation   that   inspired   or   generated   this   note .

Fields.Name: SourceConversationDetailID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   specific   conversation   message   that   inspired   this   note .

Fields.Name: SourceAIAgentRunID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   AI   agent   run   that   generated   this   note .

Fields.Name: CompanyID
Fields.Description: Optional   company   scope   for   this   note .  When   populated   with   UserID ,  creates   org + user   specific   notes .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingVector
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   embedding   vector   for   semantic   search   on   Note   field .  Auto - generated   when   Note   changes .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AI   model   used   to   generate   the   embedding   vector .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeEntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Entity   table   identifying   which   entity   type   is   used   for   primary   scoping .  NULL   means   this   is   a   global   note .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: The   record   ID   within   the   primary   scope   entity .  NULL   means   global   note .  When   set   with   empty   SecondaryScopes ,  indicates   primary - scope - only   note .

Fields.Name: SecondaryScopes
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   additional   scope   dimensions .  Empty / NULL   with   PrimaryScopeRecordID   set  =  org - level   note .  Populated  =  fully - scoped   note .

Fields.Name: LastAccessedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   this   note   was   last   accessed / injected   into   agent   context .  Used   for   lifecycle   management   and   cleanup .

Fields.Name: AccessCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   times   this   note   has   been   accessed / injected   into   agent   context .  Used   for   analytics   and   determining   note   value .

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Optional   expiration   timestamp .  Notes   past   this   date   are   candidates   for   archival .  NULL   means   no   expiration .

Fields.Name: ConsolidatedIntoNoteID
Fields.Description: Self - referential   FK .  Points   to   the   consolidated   note   that   replaced   this   one   when   revoked   during   consolidation   or   contradiction   resolution .

Fields.Name: ConsolidationCount
Fields.Description: Tracks   re - summarization   depth .  0 = raw   extraction ,  1 = first   consolidation ,  etc .  Capped   at   3   to   prevent   semantic   drift .

Fields.Name: DerivedFromNoteIDs
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   source   note   IDs   that   were   consolidated   into   this   note .  Enables   provenance   chain   resolution   and   rollback .

Fields.Name: ProtectionTier
Fields.Description: Protection   level :  Immutable  ( never   consolidated / archived ),  Protected  ( no   consolidation ,  extended   365 - day   retention ),  Standard  ( default ),  Ephemeral  ( aggressive   consolidation ,  2x   decay   rate ).

Fields.Name: ImportanceScore
Fields.Description: Composite   importance   score  ( 0 - 10 )  computed   from   7   signals :  recency ,  LLM - importance ,  relevance ,  uniqueness ,  correction   boost ,  goal   alignment ,  user   mark .  Replaces   raw   AccessCount   for   authority   and   retention   decisions .

Fields.Name: AuthorType
Fields.Description: Type   of   author   that   created   the   note :  Agent  =  written   in - flight   during   an   agent   run ,  MemoryManager  =  extracted / consolidated   by   the   scheduled   Memory   Manager ,  User  =  manually   created   by   a   person .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Permissions
entities.Description: Defines   access   control   permissions   for   AI   agents   using   an   ACL  ( Access   Control   List )  model .  Permissions   can   be   granted   to   individual   users   or   roles .

Fields.Name: RoleID
Fields.Description: The   role   this   permission   is   granted   to .  Either   RoleID   or   UserID   must   be   specified ,  but   not   both .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   user   this   permission   is   granted   to .  Either   RoleID   or   UserID   must   be   specified ,  but   not   both .

Fields.Name: CanView
Fields.Description: Grants   permission   to   view   the   agent   configuration   and   details .

Fields.Name: CanRun
Fields.Description: Grants   permission   to   execute / run   the   agent .  Typically   implies   CanView   as   well .

Fields.Name: CanEdit
Fields.Description: Grants   permission   to   modify   the   agent   configuration ,  prompts ,  and   settings .  Typically   implies   CanView   and   CanRun   as   well .

Fields.Name: CanDelete
Fields.Description: Grants   permission   to   delete   the   agent .  Typically   implies   all   other   permissions   as   well .

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Optional   comments   explaining   why   this   permission   was   granted   or   any   special   notes .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Personas
entities.Description: Configures   which   personas   an   AI   agent   is   permitted   to   wear ,  their   preference   order ,  and   which   persona   serves   as   the   agent ' s   default   identity .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   persona   is   the   default   presentation   for   the   agent   when   none   is   explicitly   requested .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ordering   sequence   for   displaying   available   personas   in   user   interfaces .

Fields.Name: IsAllowed
Fields.Description: Whether   the   agent   is   allowed   to   use   this   persona .  Set   to   0   to   explicitly   disable   or   veto   a   persona .

Fields.Name: StyleOverride
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   payload   overriding   or   refining   persona   presentation   specifically   for   this   agent  ( e . g .  Tone   or   SpeakingStyle   adjustments ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Prompts
entities.Description: Links   AI   agents   with   the   prompts   they   use ,  including   execution   order   and   context   handling .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: References   the   agent   this   prompt   is   associated   with .

Fields.Name: PromptID
Fields.Description: References   the   prompt   to   be   used   by   the   agent .

Fields.Name: Purpose
Fields.Description: The   functional   purpose   of   this   prompt   within   the   agent ,  such   as  " Initialize ", " ProcessData ",  or  " Summarize ".

Fields.Name: ExecutionOrder
Fields.Description: The   sequence   order   in   which   this   prompt   should   be   executed   within   the   agent ' s   workflow .

Fields.Name: ConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   a   specific   configuration   to   use   for   this   prompt .  If   NULL ,  uses   the   default   configuration .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: The   current   status   of   this   agent - prompt   mapping .  Values   include   Active ,  Inactive ,  Deprecated ,  and   Preview .

Fields.Name: ContextBehavior
Fields.Description: Determines   how   conversation   context   is   filtered   for   this   prompt :  Complete ,  Smart ,  None ,  RecentMessages ,  InitialMessages ,  or   Custom .

Fields.Name: ContextMessageCount
Fields.Description: The   number   of   messages   to   include   when   ContextBehavior   is   set   to   RecentMessages   or   InitialMessages .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Relationships
entities.Description: Tracks   relationships   between   AI   agents   for   sub - agent   orchestration

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   for   AI   agent   relationships

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   parent   AIAgent   that   can   invoke   the   sub - agent

Fields.Name: SubAgentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   sub - agent   AIAgent   that   can   be   invoked

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   relationship :  Pending  ( awaiting   approval ),  Active  ( can   invoke ),  or   Revoked  ( no   longer   allowed )

Fields.Name: SubAgentOutputMapping
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   mapping   sub - agent   result   payload   paths   to   parent   agent   payload   paths .  Enables   controlled   merging   of   sub - agent   results .  Format : {" subAgentPath ": " parentPath ", "*": " captureAllPath "}.  If   null ,  sub - agent   results   are   not   automatically   merged   into   parent   payload .

Fields.Name: SubAgentInputMapping
Fields.Description: JSON   mapping   of   parent   payload   paths   to   sub - agent   initial   payload   paths .  Enables   structural   data   transfer   from   parent   to   related   sub - agent .  Format : {" parentPath ": " subAgentPath ", " parent . nested ": " subAgent . field "}.  Example : {" searchQuery ": " query ", " maxResults ": " limit "}.  If   null ,  sub - agent   starts   with   empty   payload  ( default   behavior ).

Fields.Name: SubAgentContextPaths
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   parent   payload   paths   to   send   as   LLM   context   to   related   sub - agent .  Sub - agent   receives   this   data   in   a   formatted   context   message   before   its   task   message .  Format : [" path1 ", " path2 . nested ", " path3 .*", "*"].  Use  "*"  to   send   entire   parent   payload .  Example : [" userPreferences ", " priorFindings . summary ", " sources [*]"].  If   null ,  no   parent   context   is   sent  ( default   behavior ).

Fields.Name: MessageMode
Fields.Description: Specifies   how   conversation   messages   are   passed   from   parent   agent   to   related   sub - agent .  Valid   values : ' None ' ( fresh   start  -  only   context   and   task   message ,  default ), ' All ' ( all   parent   conversation   history ), ' Latest ' ( most   recent   MaxMessages   messages ), ' Bookend ' ( first   2   messages  +  most   recent   MaxMessages - 2   messages   with   indicator   between ).  Stored   on   relationship   because   related   sub - agents   can   have   multiple   parents   with   different   message   passing   needs .

Fields.Name: MaxMessages
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   conversation   messages   to   include   when   MessageMode   is  ' Latest '  or  ' Bookend '.  NULL   means   no   limit  ( ignored   for  ' None '  and  ' All '  modes ).  Must   be   greater   than   0   if   specified .  For  ' Latest ':  keeps   most   recent   N   messages .  For  ' Bookend ':  keeps   first   2  +  most   recent  ( N - 2 )  messages .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Request   Types
entities.Description: Lookup   table   categorizing   the   types   of   requests   an   agent   can   make   to   a   human  ( e . g .,  Approval ,  Information ,  Choice ,  Review ,  Custom ).

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   for   the   AIAgentRequestType   record .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   display   name   for   the   request   type  ( e . g .,  Approval ,  Information ,  Choice ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Explains   when   and   how   this   request   type   should   be   used   by   agents .

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   for   UI   rendering   of   this   request   type .

Fields.Name: DefaultAssignmentStrategy
Fields.Description: JSON - serialized   AgentRequestAssignmentStrategy   defining   the   default   assignment   strategy   for   requests   of   this   type .  Used   as   the   lowest - priority   fallback   in   the   resolution   chain .

Fields.Name: DefaultPriority
Fields.Description: Default   priority  ( 1 - 100 )  for   requests   of   this   type   when   no   explicit   priority   is   provided .  NULL   means   use   the   system   default   of   50 .

Fields.Name: DefaultExpirationMinutes
Fields.Description: Default   expiration   time   in   minutes   for   requests   of   this   type .  NULL   means   requests   do   not   expire   by   default .

Fields.Name: RequiresResponse
Fields.Description: Whether   requests   of   this   type   require   a   structured   response   from   the   human   before   the   agent   can   resume .  When   0 ,  the   agent   may   proceed   with   just   an   acknowledgment .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Requests
entities.Description: Table   to   log   AI   Agent   requests ,  responses ,  and   their   statuses .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   for   the   AIAgentRequest   table ,  uniquely   identifies   each   record .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   referencing   the   ID   column   in   the   AIAgent   table .

Fields.Name: RequestedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   request   was   made   by   the   agent .

Fields.Name: RequestForUserID
Fields.Description: Optional ,  a   user   that   the   AI   specifically   is   directing   the   request   to ,  if   null   intended   for   general   system   owner .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   the   request  ( Requested ,  Approved ,  Rejected ,  Canceled ).

Fields.Name: Request
Fields.Description: Details   of   what   the   AI   Agent   is   requesting .

Fields.Name: Response
Fields.Description: Response   provided   by   the   human   to   the   agent   request .

Fields.Name: ResponseByUserID
Fields.Description: Populated   when   a   user   responds   indicating   which   user   responded   to   the   request .

Fields.Name: RespondedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   response   was   provided   by   the   human .

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Additional   comments   about   the   request .  Not   shared   with   the   agent ,  purely   record   keeping .

Fields.Name: RequestTypeID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   AIAgentRequestType .  Categorizes   the   purpose   of   this   request  ( Approval ,  Information ,  Choice ,  Review ,  Custom ).

Fields.Name: ResponseSchema
Fields.Description: JSON - serialized   AgentResponseForm   defining   the   structured   input   form   the   agent   presents   to   the   human .  Uses   the   same   form   types   as   ConversationDetail . ResponseForm .

Fields.Name: ResponseData
Fields.Description: JSON   structured   response   data   provided   by   the   human ,  conforming   to   the   ResponseSchema   definition .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Urgency   level   of   the   request   as   an   integer   from   1  ( lowest )  to   100  ( highest ).  Default   is   50 .  Suggested   ranges :  1 - 25   Low ,  26 - 50   Normal ,  51 - 75   High ,  76 - 100   Critical .  Used   for   notification   routing   and   dashboard   sorting .

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Optional   deadline   for   the   human   to   respond .  After   this   time   the   request   may   be   marked   Expired   by   a   background   process .

Fields.Name: OriginatingAgentRunID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   AIAgentRun .  The   agent   run   that   created   this   request .  Used   to   trace   request   origin   in   run   chains .

Fields.Name: OriginatingAgentRunStepID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   AIAgentRunStep .  The   specific   execution   step   that   triggered   this   request .

Fields.Name: ResumingAgentRunID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   AIAgentRun .  The   new   agent   run   spawned   after   the   human   responds .  NULL   until   a   response   triggers   a   resuming   run .

Fields.Name: ResponseSource
Fields.Description: Identifies   where   the   response   originated :  Conversation  ( handled   by   chat   resolver ),  Dashboard  ( slide - in   panel ),  or   API  ( external   integration ).  Used   by   the   server - side   entity   subclass   to   determine   whether   agent   resumption   is   needed .

Fields.Name: OriginatingTaskID
Fields.Description: The   workflow   step  ( MJ :  Tasks   row )  waiting   on   this   request ,  when   it   came   from   a   task   graph   rather   than   from   a   running   agent .  Distinct   from   OriginatingAgentRunStepID :  a   task   graph   outlives   the   agent   run   that   submitted   it ,  so   the   task  —  not   the   run  —  is   what   resumes   when   a   person   answers .  NULL   for   requests   raised   by   a   run   directly .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Agent   notes   describing   what   this   media   represents .  Used   for   internal   tracking   and   can   be   displayed   in   UI .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Run   Steps
entities.Description: Provides   basic ,  step - by - step   tracking   of   agent   execution .  Each   step   represents   a   discrete   action   within   an   agent   run ,  such   as   prompt   execution ,  tool   usage ,  decision   making ,  or   sub - agent   coordination .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Unique   identifier   for   this   execution   step

Fields.Name: AgentRunID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   parent   AIAgentRun   that   contains   this   step

Fields.Name: StepNumber
Fields.Description: Sequential   number   of   this   step   within   the   agent   run ,  starting   from   1

Fields.Name: StepType
Fields.Description: Type   of   execution   step :  Prompt ,  Actions ,  Sub - Agent ,  Decision ,  Chat ,  Validation ,  ForEach ,  While ,  Tool

Fields.Name: StepName
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   of   what   this   step   accomplishes

Fields.Name: TargetID
Fields.Description: ID   of   the   specific   target   being   executed  ( AIPrompt . ID ,  AIAction . ID ,  AIAgent . ID ,  etc .).  NULL   for   steps   that   don ' t   target   a   specific   entity .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   execution   status   of   this   step :  Running ,  Completed ,  Failed ,  Cancelled

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   step   began   execution

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   step   completed .  NULL   while   still   running .

Fields.Name: Success
Fields.Description: Whether   this   step   completed   successfully .  NULL   while   running ,  TRUE / FALSE   when   completed .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   message   if   this   step   failed .  NULL   for   successful   steps .

Fields.Name: InputData
Fields.Description: JSON   serialization   of   input   data   passed   to   this   step   for   execution

Fields.Name: OutputData
Fields.Description: JSON   serialization   of   the   output   data   produced   by   this   step

Fields.Name: TargetLogID
Fields.Description: ID   of   the   execution   log / run   record   created   for   this   step  ( ActionExecutionLog . ID   for   action   steps ,  AIAgentRun . ID   for   subagent   steps ,  AIPromptRun . ID   for   prompt   steps )

Fields.Name: PayloadAtStart
Fields.Description: JSON   serialization   of   the   Payload   state   at   the   start   of   this   step

Fields.Name: PayloadAtEnd
Fields.Description: JSON   serialization   of   the   Payload   state   at   the   end   of   this   step

Fields.Name: FinalPayloadValidationResult
Fields.Description: Result   of   the   final   payload   validation   for   this   step .  Pass   indicates   successful \bnvalidation ,  Retry   means   validation   failed   but   will   retry ,  Fail   means   validation   failed \bnpermanently ,  Warn   means   validation   failed   but   execution   continues .

Fields.Name: FinalPayloadValidationMessages
Fields.Description: Validation   error   messages   or   warnings   from   final   payload   validation .  Contains \bndetailed   information   about   what   validation   rules   failed .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   parent   step   for   tracking   hierarchical   relationships   like   code -> test -> fix -> code   cycles

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Human - readable   notes   and   comments   about   this   agent   run   step

Fields.Name: Skills
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   skill - invocation   records  ( AgentSkillInvocation [])  associating   this   step   with   the   skills   involved   in   it ,  or   NULL   when   no   skills   are   in   play .  Each   record   carries   SkillID ,  SkillName ,  ActivationType  ( requested  =  user  / skill   mention ;  auto  =  agent   self - activation ),  Provenance   of   authority  ( the   gate   values   that   admitted   the   skill :  AcceptsSkills ,  both   ActivationMode   dials ,  and   who   requested   it ),  and   an   optional   agent - stated   Reason   when   self - activated .  Population :  Skill   steps   record   the   activation ( s )  they   performed ;  Prompt   steps   record   the   full   set   of   skills   in   effect   for   that   turn ;  Actions   and   Sub - Agent   steps   record   the   skill ( s )  through   which   the   executed   tool   became   available  ( NULL   means   the   tool   was   a   native   grant ).

Fields.Name: ToolCallingMode
Fields.Description: Which   tool - calling   path   this   step ' s   model   call   took :  Native  ( Actions   as   tools ,  envelope   control   flow ),  NativeImplicit  ( Actions ,  sub - agents ,  payload   changes   and   ask_user   as   tools ;  plain   text   ends   the   turn ),  Envelope  ( prose   action   catalog  +  JSON   envelope ),  or   NativeFallback  ( a   native   attempt   failed   in   a   tools - specific   way   and   completed   via   an   envelope   retry ).  NULL   for   steps   that   never   reached   a   model   call ,  and   for   rows   predating   the   feature .

Fields.Name: NativeToolCallCount
Fields.Description: How   many   native   tool   calls   the   model   made   on   this   step .  0   on   a   native - mode   step   where   the   model   chose   to   answer   with   the   envelope   instead ;  NULL   when   the   step   took   the   envelope   path   or   never   reached   a   model   call .

Fields.Name: NativeDualChannel
Fields.Description: On   a   native - mode   step   where   the   model   made   tool   calls :  1   when   the   same   turn   also   carried   a   parseable   JSON   Loop   envelope  ( the   model   answered   on   both   channels ;  the   loop   dispatched   the   tool   call   and   discarded   the   envelope ),  0   when   the   tool   calls   came   alone .  NULL   when   the   step   made   no   tool   calls   or   took   the   envelope   path .

Fields.Name: NativeToolResultsSent
Fields.Description: For   native   tool - calling   steps :  1  =  the   results   of   this   step ' s   tool   calls   were   returned   to   the   model   as   native   tool - result   turns ,  0  =  as   the   markdown   action - results   user   message .  NULL   for   envelope   steps   and   for   rows   predating   the   feature .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   individual   execution   runs   of   AI   agents ,  including   hierarchical   sub - agent   runs .  Provides   basic   logging ,  state   persistence ,  and   resource   tracking   for   agent   executions .  Supports   pause / resume   functionality   through   state   serialization .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Unique   identifier   for   this   agent   run

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AIAgent   that   is   being   executed   in   this   run

Fields.Name: ParentRunID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   parent   agent   run   if   this   is   a   sub - agent   execution .  NULL   for   root - level   agent   runs .  Enables   hierarchical   execution   tracking .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   the   agent   run .  Running  ->  Completed / Failed / Cancelled

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   agent   run   began   execution

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   agent   run   completed  ( successfully   or   with   failure ).  NULL   while   running .

Fields.Name: Success
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   the   agent   run   completed   successfully .  NULL   while   running ,  TRUE / FALSE   when   completed .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   message   if   the   agent   run   failed .  NULL   for   successful   runs .

Fields.Name: ConversationID
Fields.Description: Identifier   linking   multiple   agent   runs   that   are   part   of   the   same   conversation   or   user   session

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: User   context   identifier   for   authentication   and   permissions   during   the   agent   run

Fields.Name: Result
Fields.Description: Final   result   or   output   from   the   agent   execution ,  stored   as   JSON   or   text

Fields.Name: AgentState
Fields.Description: JSON   serialization   of   the   complete   agent   state ,  including   conversation   context ,  variables ,  and   execution   state .  Enables   pause / resume   functionality .

Fields.Name: TotalTokensUsed
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   tokens   consumed   by   all   LLM   calls   during   this   agent   run

Fields.Name: TotalCost
Fields.Description: Total   estimated   cost   for   all   AI   model   usage   during   this   agent   run

Fields.Name: TotalPromptTokensUsed
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   prompt / input   tokens   used   across   all   AIPromptRun   executions   during   this   agent   run .  This   provides   a   breakdown   of   the   TotalTokensUsed   field   to   help   analyze   the   ratio   of   input   vs   output   tokens   consumed   by   the   agent .

Fields.Name: TotalCompletionTokensUsed
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   completion / output   tokens   generated   across   all   AIPromptRun   executions   during   this   agent   run .  This   provides   a   breakdown   of   the   TotalTokensUsed   field   to   help   analyze   the   ratio   of   input   vs   output   tokens   consumed   by   the   agent .

Fields.Name: TotalTokensUsedRollup
Fields.Description: Total   tokens   used   including   this   agent   run   and   all   sub - agent   runs .  For   leaf   agents  ( no   sub - agents ),  this   equals   TotalTokensUsed .  For   parent   agents ,  this   includes   the   sum   of   all   descendant   agent   tokens .  Calculated   as   TotalPromptTokensUsedRollup  +  TotalCompletionTokensUsedRollup .

Fields.Name: TotalPromptTokensUsedRollup
Fields.Description: Total   prompt / input   tokens   including   this   agent   run   and   all   sub - agent   runs .  For   leaf   agents  ( no   sub - agents ),  this   equals   TotalPromptTokensUsed .  For   parent   agents ,  this   includes   the   sum   of   all   descendant   agent   prompt   tokens .

Fields.Name: TotalCompletionTokensUsedRollup
Fields.Description: Total   completion / output   tokens   including   this   agent   run   and   all   sub - agent   runs .  For   leaf   agents  ( no   sub - agents ),  this   equals   TotalCompletionTokensUsed .  For   parent   agents ,  this   includes   the   sum   of   all   descendant   agent   completion   tokens .

Fields.Name: TotalCostRollup
Fields.Description: Total   cost   including   this   agent   run   and   all   sub - agent   runs .  For   leaf   agents  ( no   sub - agents ),  this   equals   TotalCost .  For   parent   agents ,  this   includes   the   sum   of   all   descendant   agent   costs .  Note :  This   assumes   all   costs   are   in   the   same   currency   for   accurate   rollup .

Fields.Name: ConversationDetailID
Fields.Description: Optional   tracking   of   a   specific   conversation   detail  ( e . g .  a   specific   message )  that   spawned   this   agent   run

Fields.Name: ConversationDetailSequence
Fields.Description: If   a   conversation   detail   spawned   multiple   agent   runs ,  tracks   the   order   of   their   spawn / execution

Fields.Name: CancellationReason
Fields.Description: Reason   for   cancellation   if   the   agent   run   was   cancelled

Fields.Name: FinalStep
Fields.Description: The   final   step   type   that   concluded   the   agent   run

Fields.Name: FinalPayload
Fields.Description: JSON   serialization   of   the   final   Payload   state   at   the   end   of   the   agent   run

Fields.Name: Message
Fields.Description: Final   message   from   the   agent   to   the   end   user   at   the   end   of   a   run

Fields.Name: LastRunID
Fields.Description: Links   to   the   previous   run   in   a   chain .  Different   from   ParentRunID   which   is   for   sub - agent   hierarchy .

Fields.Name: StartingPayload
Fields.Description: The   initial   payload   provided   at   the   start   of   this   run .  Can   be   populated   from   the   FinalPayload   of   the   LastRun .

Fields.Name: TotalPromptIterations
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   prompt   iterations   executed   during   this   agent   run .  Incremented \bneach   time   the   agent   processes   a   prompt   step .

Fields.Name: ConfigurationID
Fields.Description: The   AI   Configuration   used   for   this   agent   execution .  When   set ,  this   configuration   was   used   for   all   prompts   executed   by   this   agent   and   its   sub - agents .

Fields.Name: OverrideModelID
Fields.Description: Runtime   model   override   that   was   used   for   this   execution .  When   set ,  this   model   took   precedence   over   all   other   model   selection   methods .

Fields.Name: OverrideVendorID
Fields.Description: Runtime   vendor   override   that   was   used   for   this   execution .  When   set   along   with   OverrideModelID ,  this   vendor   was   used   to   provide   the   model .

Fields.Name: Data
Fields.Description: JSON   serialized   data   that   was   passed   for   template   rendering   and   prompt   execution .  This   data   was   passed   to   the   agent ' s   prompt   as   well   as   all   sub - agents .

Fields.Name: Verbose
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   verbose   logging   was   enabled   during   this   agent   execution .  When   true ,  detailed   decision - making   and   execution   flow   was   logged .

Fields.Name: EffortLevel
Fields.Description: Effort   level   that   was   actually   used   during   this   agent   run   execution  ( 1 - 100 ,  where   1 = minimal   effort ,  100 = maximum   effort ).  This   is   the   resolved   effort   level   after   applying   the   precedence   hierarchy :  runtime   override  >  agent   default  >  prompt   defaults .

Fields.Name: RunName
Fields.Description: Optional   name   for   the   agent   run   to   help   identify   and   tag   runs   for   easier   reference

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Human - readable   notes   and   comments   about   this   agent   run

Fields.Name: ScheduledJobRunID
Fields.Description: Links   to   the   scheduled   job   run   that   triggered   this   agent   execution .  NULL   for   manually - triggered   agent   runs .  Enables   tracking   which   scheduled   jobs   spawned   which   agent   executions .

Fields.Name: TestRunID
Fields.Description: Optional   Foreign   Key  -  Links   this   agent   run   to   a   test   run   if   this   execution   was   part   of   a   test .  Allows   navigation   from   agent   execution   to   test   context .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeEntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Entity   table   identifying   which   entity   type   is   used   for   primary   scoping  ( e . g .,  Organizations ,  Tenants )

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: The   record   ID   within   the   primary   scope   entity  ( e . g .,  the   specific   OrganizationID ).  Indexed   for   fast   multi - tenant   filtering .

Fields.Name: SecondaryScopes
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   additional   scope   dimensions   beyond   the   primary   scope .  Example : {" ContactID ":" abc - 123 "," TeamID ":" team - 456 "}

Fields.Name: ExternalReferenceID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   ID   from   an   external   system   that   initiated   this   agent   run .  Enables   correlation   between   the   caller ' s   agent   run   and   this   execution .  For   example ,  when   Skip   SaaS   is   called   via   SkipProxyAgent ,  this   stores   the   MJ - side   Agent   Run   ID .

Fields.Name: CompanyID
Fields.Description: Optional   company   scope   for   multi - tenant   memory .  When   populated ,  Memory   Manager   uses   this   to   scope   extracted   notes   to   the   company .  Flows   from   ExecuteAgentParams . companyId   at   agent   invocation   time .

Fields.Name: TotalCacheReadTokensUsed
Fields.Description: Total   input   tokens   served   from   the   AI   provider ' s   prompt   cache  ( cache   reads  /  hits )  across   this   agent   run ,  summed   from   child   prompt   runs '  TokensCacheReadRollup   and   sub - agent   runs '  TotalCacheReadTokensUsed .  Counts   only ;  the   cost   impact  ( cache   reads   are   billed   at   a   steep   discount )  is   reflected   in   TotalCost .  The   cache   counterpart   of   TotalPromptTokensUsed .

Fields.Name: TotalCacheWriteTokensUsed
Fields.Description: Total   input   tokens   written   to   the   AI   provider ' s   prompt   cache  ( cache   writes  /  creation )  across   this   agent   run ,  summed   from   child   prompt   runs '  TokensCacheWriteRollup   and   sub - agent   runs '  TotalCacheWriteTokensUsed .  Populated   for   providers   that   bill   cache   creation  ( e . g .  Anthropic );  0   or   NULL   otherwise .  The   cache   counterpart   of   TotalCompletionTokensUsed .

Fields.Name: LastHeartbeatAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   most   recent   liveness   heartbeat   written   by   the   owning   process   while   this   run   is   in   progress .  Used   by   the   agent - run   watchdog   to   detect   runs   orphaned   by   a   process   restart / crash   or   a   failed   terminal - state   write :  a   Running   row   whose   LastHeartbeatAt   has   gone   stale  ( or   is   NULL   with   an   old   StartedAt )  is   force - failed .  Always   stamped   on   the   database   clock  ( GETUTCDATE ),  never   process   time .

Fields.Name: AgentSessionID
Fields.Description: Links   this   run   to   the   long - lived   AIAgentSession   it   executed   within .  NULL   for   runs   outside   any   real - time   session .  This   is   the   persisted   session   reference   and   is   distinct   from   the   per - connection   transport   sessionID .

Fields.Name: PlanMode
Fields.Description: 1   when   this   run   executed   under   plan   mode  ( whether   via   the   per - request   planMode   flag   or   the   agent ' s   RequirePlanMode   setting ).  Drives   plan - mode   indicators   in   the   run   UX   and   supports   plan - drift   auditing  ( comparing   the   approved   plan   against   the   steps   that   actually   executed ).

Fields.Name: ExternalSessionID
Fields.Description: Session   identifier   reported   by   the   external   harness   backing   this   run .  Kept   for   two   reasons   that   outlive   the   run :  resuming   the   session   across   turns ,  and   correlating   this   run   with   the   vendor ' s   own   session   logs   when   diagnosing   behaviour   INSIDE   the   sandbox ,  where   MJ ' s   audit   trail   necessarily   stops   at   the   turn   boundary .  NULL   for   every   run   not   backed   by   a   harness .

Fields.Name: ContinuationDepth
Fields.Description: How   many   task - graph   continuations   led   to   this   run .  0  ( the   default ,  and   the   value   every   ordinary   run   carries )  means   the   run   was   not   started   by   a   finished   graph .  A   run   started   because   a   graph   declared   continuation =' reinvoke '  records   its   source   graph ' s   depth   plus   one ,  and   any   graph   that   run   subsequently   submits   inherits   that   value  —  which   is   what   allows   MAX_REINVOKE_DEPTH   to   bound   a   chain   of   graph - reinvokes - agent - emits - graph .  Without   a   durable   value   here   the   cap   could   never   fire ,  because   a   reinvoked   agent   has   no   other   way   to   learn   it   was   a   continuation .  Distinct   from   ParentRunID ,  which   tracks   sub - agent   lineage   within   a   single   turn ;  a   continuation   is   a   NEW   top - level   turn   caused   by   work   that   already   completed .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Search   Scopes
entities.Description: Many - to - many   between   agents   and   search   scopes ,  with   phase   and   scheduling   control .  Drives   both   pre - execution   RAG   and   agent - invoked   scoped   search .

Fields.Name: Phase
Fields.Description: When   this   scope   is   used :  PreExecution  ( injected   as   retrieved   context   before   the   agent   runs ),  AgentInvoked  ( callable   via   the   scoped   search   Action ),  or   Both .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status .  Only   Active   rows   are   considered   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Time - windowed   activation   for   this   agent - scope   assignment .  NULL  =  immediately   active .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: Time - windowed   deactivation   for   this   agent - scope   assignment .  NULL  =  no   expiry .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Ordering   within   Phase .  Lower  =  higher   priority .  Used   for   pre - execution   ordering   and   as   default   preference   for   agent - invoked   scope   selection .

Fields.Name: MaxResults
Fields.Description: Override   max   results   for   this   scope   when   used   by   this   agent .  NULL  =  use   scope / engine   default .

Fields.Name: MinScore
Fields.Description: Override   min   score   threshold  ( 0 . 0000 – 1 . 0000 ).  NULL  =  use   engine   default .

Fields.Name: QueryTemplateID
Fields.Description: FK   to   Templates .  MJ   Template   used   to   generate   the   search   query   from   conversation   context  ( lastUserMessage ,  recentMessages ,  payload ,  etc .).  NULL  =  use   lastUserMessage   as - is .  Can   be   further   specialized   per - provider   via   SearchScopeProvider . QueryTransformTemplateID .

Fields.Name: FusionWeightsOverride
Fields.Description: JSON   override   for   RRF   per - provider   fusion   weights   when   this   agent   uses   this   scope .  Resolution   order :  AIAgentSearchScope . FusionWeightsOverride  >  SearchScope . ScopeConfig . fusionWeights  >  engine   defaults .  Example : { " vector ":  2 . 0 , " fulltext ":  1 . 0 , " entity ":  1 . 0  }.

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   is   the   agent ' s   default   scope   when   no   scope   is   specified   in   a   tool   call .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Session   Bridge   Participants

Fields.Name: ExternalParticipantID
Fields.Description: The   platform ' s   participant   identifier  ( used   to   map   diarized   audio   to   a   person ).

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: The   participant ' s   display   name   as   shown   on   the   platform .

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: The   participant ' s   role   in   the   meeting / call :  Host ,  CoHost ,  Participant ,  or   Agent  ( the   AI   bot ).

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   matched   MJ   user ,  when   the   participant   can   be   identified  ( NULL   for   external / anonymous   participants ).

Fields.Name: IsAgent
Fields.Description: True   when   this   participant   is   the   bridged   AI   agent   bot   itself .

Fields.Name: JoinedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   participant   joined   the   meeting / call .

Fields.Name: LeftAt
Fields.Description: When   the   participant   left .  NULL   while   still   present .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Direction   of   the   connection :  Outbound  ( the   agent   goes   to   a   meeting  /  places   a   call )  or   Inbound  ( a   meeting / call   routes   to   the   agent ).

Fields.Name: JoinMethod
Fields.Description: How   the   agent   connected :  OnDemand ,  Scheduled ,  Invite  ( calendar ),  NativeInvite  ( platform   UI ),  InboundRoute  ( call / invite   to   the   agent ' s   identity ),  or   InMeetingCommand  ( chat   command ).

Fields.Name: TurnMode
Fields.Description: Turn - taking   mode   for   this   bridged   session :  Passive  ( speak   only   when   addressed  —  default ),  Active  ( proactive   in   silence   windows ),  or   Hybrid  ( passive   voice  +  post - to - chat   hand - raise ).

Fields.Name: ExternalConnectionID
Fields.Description: The   platform ' s   identifier   for   the   connection  ( meeting   id  /  call   SID ),  set   once   connecting .

Fields.Name: Address
Fields.Description: The   endpoint   address :  a   meeting   join   URL  ( meetings )  or   a   phone   number  ( telephony ).

Fields.Name: BotParticipantID
Fields.Description: The   agent   bot ' s   own   participant   id   within   the   meeting / call   once   admitted .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Bridge   connection   lifecycle :  Pending ,  Scheduled ,  Connecting ,  Connected ,  Disconnecting ,  Disconnected ,  or   Failed .

Fields.Name: ScheduledStartTime
Fields.Description: For   scheduled / invite   joins :  when   the   bridge   should   connect .  NULL   for   immediate  ( on - demand / inbound ).

Fields.Name: ConnectedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   bridge   became   Connected  ( media   flowing ).  NULL   until   connected .

Fields.Name: DisconnectedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   bridge   disconnected .  NULL   while   still   connected .

Fields.Name: CloseReason
Fields.Description: Why   the   bridge   closed :  Explicit ,  HostEnded  ( the   meeting / call   ended ),  Janitor  ( orphan   sweep ),  Error ,  or   Shutdown .  NULL   while   active .

Fields.Name: HostInstanceID
Fields.Description: Identifier   of   the   server   node   currently   hosting   this   bridge ' s   bot   connection  ( hostname : pid : bootId ).  Used   for   affinity   and   janitor   orphan   reconciliation ,  mirroring   AIAgentSession .

Fields.Name: Config
Fields.Description: Per - session   bridge   configuration / state   JSON  ( validated   against   the   provider   ConfigSchema ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Connection   status   of   this   channel   instance   within   the   session .

Fields.Name: SocketUrl
Fields.Description: Socket   URL   handed   to   the   client   for   this   channel .  NULL   for   PubSub   channels ,  which   ride   the   shared   session   subscription   rather   than   a   dedicated   socket .

Fields.Name: Config
Fields.Description: JSON   of   per - instance   channel   configuration / state ,  validated   against   the   channel   definitions   ConfigSchema .

Fields.Name: LastActiveAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   activity  ( or   heartbeat )  on   this   channel   instance .

Fields.Name: DisconnectedAt
Fields.Description: When   this   channel   instance   disconnected .  NULL   while   still   connected .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status   of   the   session .  Active  =  traffic   flowing ;  Idle  =  connected   but   quiet   beyond   the   idle   threshold ;  Closed  =  terminal  ( ClosedAt   set ,  channels   disconnected ).

Fields.Name: HostInstanceID
Fields.Description: Identifier   of   the   server   node   currently   hosting   this   sessions   in - memory   sockets  ( e . g .  hostname : pid : bootId ).  Used   for   affinity   and   janitor   orphan   reconciliation .

Fields.Name: Config
Fields.Description: JSON   block   for   free - form ,  low - traffic   session - specific   state   and   variables .

Fields.Name: LastActiveAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   activity   on   the   session .  Bubbled   up   from   the   most - recently - active   channel ;  used   by   the   heartbeat   and   staleness   sweep .

Fields.Name: ClosedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   session   was   closed  ( terminal ).  NULL   while   the   session   is   Active   or   Idle .

Fields.Name: CloseReason
Fields.Description: Why   the   session   was   closed :  Explicit  ( user   hang - up  /  deliberate   API   close ),  Janitor  ( orphan   or   staleness   sweep ),  Shutdown  ( graceful   server   shutdown ),  Error  ( session   failure ).  NULL   while   the   session   is   Active / Idle .

Fields.Name: RecordingMedia
Fields.Description: The   media   actually   captured   for   this   session ,  resolved   at   session   start  ( runtime   param  >  agent - level   RecordingDefault  >  OFF ).  Values :  None ,  Audio ,  AudioVideo .  NULL / None  =  not   recorded .

Fields.Name: RecordingStartedAt
Fields.Description: Recording   alignment   origin  ( t0 ):  the   wall - clock   moment   audio   capture   began   for   this   session .  Per - turn   ConversationDetail   timestamps   are   converted   to   audio   seek   offsets   relative   to   this   value .

Fields.Name: LinkedEntityID
Fields.Description: Polymorphic   counterparty - identity   entity .  Foreign   key   to   Entity  —  identifies   WHICH   entity   this   realtime   session ' s   counterparty   resolved   to  ( e . g .  User ,  a   member / contact   record ,  BizAppsCommon   Person ).  Paired   with   LinkedRecordID   via   the   CK_AIAgentSession_LinkBinding   both - or - neither   check ,  mirroring   Conversation ' s   linked   pair .  NULL   while   the   session ' s   counterparty   is   anonymous / unresolved .

Fields.Name: LinkedRecordID
Fields.Description: Polymorphic   counterparty - identity   record   key .  The   primary - key   value   of   the   record  ( within   LinkedEntityID ' s   entity )  this   session   resolved   to ,  serialized   as   a   string   so   any   entity   type   can   be   referenced   regardless   of   PK   shape  ( UUID ,  int ,  composite ).  NVARCHAR ( 500 ),  intentionally   NOT   FK - constrained .  Used   together   with   LinkedEntityID  —  see   CK_AIAgentSession_LinkBinding .  NULL   while   the   session ' s   counterparty   is   anonymous / unresolved .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Agent   the   skill   is   assigned   to .  Used   when   the   agent ' s   AcceptsSkills  =  Limited .

Fields.Name: SkillID
Fields.Description: Skill   assigned   to   the   agent .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Per - assignment   status :  Active ,  Pending ,  or   Revoked .  Lets   an   assignment   be   disabled   without   unlinking .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Step   Paths
entities.Description: Defines   paths  ( edges )  between   steps   in   a   flow - based   AI   agent   execution   graph

Fields.Name: Condition
Fields.Description: Boolean   expression   to   evaluate .  If   null ,  path   is   always   taken .  Evaluated   against   payload   and   step   results .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Path   evaluation   priority .  Higher   values   are   evaluated   first .  Use   0   or   negative   values   for   default / fallback   paths   that   execute   when   no   other   conditions   match .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Steps
entities.Description: Defines   individual   steps  ( nodes )  in   a   flow - based   AI   agent   execution   graph

Fields.Name: StepType
Fields.Description: Type   of   step :  Action  ( execute   an   action ),  Sub - Agent  ( delegate   to   another   agent ),  or   Prompt  ( run   an   AI   prompt )

Fields.Name: StartingStep
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   step   is   executed   when   the   agent   starts

Fields.Name: ActionOutputMapping
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   mapping   action   output   parameters   to   payload   paths .  Example : {" outputParam1 ": " payload . customer . status ", "*": " payload . lastResult "}

Fields.Name: Status
