Fields.Description: Controls   whether   this   step   is   executed .  Active = normal   execution ,  Pending = skip   but   may   activate   later ,  Disabled = never   execute

Fields.Name: ActionInputMapping
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   mapping   static   values   or   payload   paths   to   action   input   parameters .  Example : {" param1 ": " staticValue ", " param2 ": " payload . dynamicValue "}

Fields.Name: LoopBodyType
Fields.Description: Specifies   what   type   of   operation   executes   in   the   loop   body .  Values :  Action ,  Sub - Agent ,  Prompt .  Only   used   when   StepType   is   ForEach   or   While .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   object   for   step - specific   settings .  For   loop   steps : {  type : " ForEach "|" While ",  collectionPath ?,  itemVariable ?,  indexVariable ?,  maxIterations ?,  continueOnError ?,  condition ? }.  For   other   step   types :  reserved   for   future   use .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Types
entities.Description: Defines   types   of   AI   agents   with   their   system   prompts   and   behavioral   characteristics .  Each   agent   type   represents   a   category   of   agents   that   share   common   system - level   instructions   and   capabilities .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Unique   identifier   for   the   agent   type

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   of   the   agent   type  ( e . g ., " Base ", " CustomerSupport ", " DataAnalysis ").  Used   for   programmatic   identification   and   factory   instantiation .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   agent   type ,  its   purpose ,  and   typical   use   cases

Fields.Name: SystemPromptID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AI   Prompt   that   contains   the   system - level   instructions   for   all   agents   of   this   type .  This   prompt   will   be   blended   with   individual   agent   prompts .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   agent   type   is   available   for   use .  Inactive   types   cannot   be   assigned   to   new   agents .

Fields.Name: AgentPromptPlaceholder
Fields.Description: The   placeholder   name   used   in   the   system   prompt   template   where   the   agent   prompt   result   should   be   injected .  For   example ,  if   the   system   prompt   contains  "{{  agentPrompt  }}",  this   field   should   contain  " agentPrompt ".  This   enables   proper   hierarchical   prompt   execution   where   the   agent   type ' s   system   prompt   acts   as   the   parent   and   the   agent ' s   specific   prompt   acts   as   the   child .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: The   class   name   used   by   the   MemberJunction   class   factory   to   instantiate   the   specific   agent   type   implementation .  For   example , " LoopAgentType "  for   a   looping   agent   pattern .  If   not   specified ,  defaults   to   using   the   agent   type   Name   for   the   DriverClass   lookup   key .

Fields.Name: UIFormSectionKey
Fields.Description: Optional   Angular   component   key   name   for   a   subclass   of   BaseFormSectionComponent   that   provides   a   custom   form   section   for   this   agent   type .  When   specified ,  this   component   will   be   dynamically   loaded   and   displayed   as   the   first   expandable   section   in   the   AI   Agent   form .  This   allows   agent   types   to   have   specialized   UI   elements .  The   class   must   be   registered   with   the   MemberJunction   class   factory   via  @ RegisterClass

Fields.Name: UIFormKey
Fields.Description: Optional   Angular   component   key   name   for   a   subclass   of   BaseFormComponent   that   will   completely   overrides   the   default   AI   Agent   form   for   this   agent   type .  When   specified ,  this   component   will   be   used   instead   of   the   standard   AI   Agent   form ,  allowing   for   completely   custom   form   implementations .  The   class   must   be   registered   with   the   MemberJunction   class   factory   via  @ RegisterClass .  If   both   UIFormClass   and   UIFormSectionClass   are   specified ,  UIFormClass   takes   precedence .

Fields.Name: UIFormSectionExpandedByDefault
Fields.Description: Determines   whether   the   custom   form   section  ( specified   by   UIFormSectionClass )  should   be   expanded   by   default   when   the   AI   Agent   form   loads .  True   means   the   section   starts   expanded ,  False   means   it   starts   collapsed .  Only   applies   when   UIFormSectionClass   is   specified .  Defaults   to   1  ( expanded ).

Fields.Name: PromptParamsSchema
Fields.Description: JSON   Schema   defining   the   available   prompt   parameters   for   this   agent   type .  Includes   property   definitions   with   types ,  defaults ,  and   descriptions .  Used   by   agents   of   this   type   to   customize   which   prompt   sections   are   included   in   the   system   prompt .  The   schema   follows   JSON   Schema   draft - 07   format .

Fields.Name: AssignmentStrategy
Fields.Description: JSON - serialized   AgentRequestAssignmentStrategy   defining   the   default   assignment   strategy   for   all   agents   of   this   type .  Overridden   by   per - invocation   or   category - level   strategies   in   the   resolution   chain .

Fields.Name: DefaultStorageAccountID
Fields.Description: Default   file   storage   account   for   agents   of   this   type .  Lowest   priority   in   the   resolution   chain  ( Type  →  Category   tree  →  Agent  →  Runtime   override ).  When   set ,  all   agents   of   this   type   use   this   storage   account   unless   overridden   at   a   more   specific   level .  FK   to   FileStorageAccount .

Fields.Name: ConfigSchema
Fields.Description: JSON   Schema  ( draft - 07 )  describing   the   shape   of   TypeConfiguration   payloads   on   agents   of   this   type .  When   present ,  agent   saves   validate   their   TypeConfiguration   against   it   server - side  ( MJAIAgentEntityServer . ValidateAsync );  null  =  TypeConfiguration   is   freeform   for   this   type .

Fields.Name: DefaultConfiguration
Fields.Description: Type - level   DEFAULT   configuration   JSON   for   agents   of   this   type  —  the   base   layer   of   the   effective - configuration   merge :  type   DefaultConfiguration  <-  agent   TypeConfiguration  <-  runtime   overrides  ( later   layers   win   per   key ,  deep - merged ).  Must   itself   conform   to   ConfigSchema   when   one   is   published .  Null  =  no   type   defaults .

Fields.Name: ContextCompressionMessageThreshold
Fields.Description: Type - level   default   for   the   in - turn   context - compression   message - count   threshold .  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . ContextCompressionMessageThreshold .

Fields.Name: ContextCompressionPromptID
Fields.Description: Type - level   default   prompt   used   for   in - turn   context   compression .  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . ContextCompressionPromptID .

Fields.Name: ContextCompressionMessageRetentionCount
Fields.Description: Type - level   default   for   the   number   of   most - recent   messages   kept   uncompressed  ( the  " hot   tail ")  when   context   compression   is   applied .  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . ContextCompressionMessageRetentionCount .

Fields.Name: ContextWindowMaxTokens
Fields.Description: Type - level   default   effective   working - context   budget ,  in   tokens .  Null   means   use   the   selected   model ' s   MaxInputTokens .  The   resolved   value   is   clamped   to   the   model ' s   limit   at   runtime  ( a   warning   is   logged   if   it   would   exceed   it ).  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . ContextWindowMaxTokens .

Fields.Name: CompactionTriggerPercent
Fields.Description: Type - level   default :  the   percentage   of   the   effective   context   budget   at   which   cross - turn   conversation   compaction   is   triggered .  Defaults   to   75 .  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . CompactionTriggerPercent .

Fields.Name: CompactionTargetPercent
Fields.Description: Type - level   default :  the   target   percentage   of   the   effective   context   budget   to   reduce   to   after   a   cross - turn   compaction .  Defaults   to   30 .  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . CompactionTargetPercent .

Fields.Name: ConversationSummaryPromptID
Fields.Description: Type - level   default   prompt   used   for   cross - turn   conversation   compaction  ( the   durable   summary   baseline ).  Distinct   from   ContextCompressionPromptID ,  which   governs   in - turn   compression .  Overridable   per   agent   via   AIAgent . ConversationSummaryPromptID .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agents
entities.Description: Table   to   store   information   about   AI   agents .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: The   unique   identifier   for   each   AI   agent .  Serves   as   the   primary   key .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   AI   agent .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: A   detailed   description   of   the   AI   agent .

Fields.Name: LogoURL
Fields.Description: URL   to   an   image   file   or   base64   data   URI  ( e . g .,  data : image / png ; base64 ,...)  for   the   agent   logo .  Takes   precedence   over   IconClass   in   UI   display .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: References   the   parent   agent   in   the   hierarchical   structure .  If   NULL ,  this   is   a   root  ( top - level )  agent .

Fields.Name: ExposeAsAction
Fields.Description: When   true ,  this   agent   can   be   exposed   as   an   action   for   use   by   other   agents .  Only   valid   for   root   agents .

Fields.Name: ExecutionOrder
Fields.Description: The   order   in   which   this   agent   should   be   executed   among   its   siblings   under   the   same   parent .

Fields.Name: ExecutionMode
Fields.Description: Controls   how   this   agent ' s   child   agents   are   executed .  Sequential   runs   children   in   order ,  Parallel   runs   them   simultaneously .

Fields.Name: EnableContextCompression
Fields.Description: When   true ,  enables   automatic   compression   of   conversation   context   when   the   message   threshold   is   reached .

Fields.Name: ContextCompressionMessageThreshold
Fields.Description: Number   of   messages   that   triggers   context   compression   when   EnableContextCompression   is   true .

Fields.Name: ContextCompressionMessageRetentionCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   recent   messages   to   keep   uncompressed   when   context   compression   is   applied .

Fields.Name: TypeID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AIAgentType   that   defines   the   category   and   system - level   behavior   for   this   agent .  Cannot   be   null .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   the   AI   agent .  Active   agents   can   be   executed ,  Disabled   agents   are   inactive ,  and   Pending   agents   are   awaiting   configuration   or   approval .  Allowed   values :  Active ,  Disabled ,  Pending .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Optional   override   for   the   class   name   used   by   the   MemberJunction   class   factory   to   instantiate   this   specific   agent .  If   specified ,  this   overrides   the   agent   type ' s   DriverClass .  Useful   for   specialized   agent   implementations .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class  ( e . g .,  fa - robot ,  fa - brain )  for   the   agent .  Used   as   fallback   when   LogoURL   is   not   set   or   fails   to   load .

Fields.Name: ModelSelectionMode
Fields.Description: Controls   whether   model   selection   is   driven   by   the   Agent   Type ' s   system   prompt   or   the   Agent ' s   specific   prompt .  Default   is   Agent   Type   for   backward   compatibility .

Fields.Name: PayloadDownstreamPaths
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   paths   that   define   which   parts   of   the   payload   should   be   sent   downstream   to   sub - agents .  Use  ["*"]  to   send   entire   payload ,  or   specify   paths   like  [" customer . id ", " campaign .*", " analysis . sentiment "]

Fields.Name: PayloadUpstreamPaths
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   paths   that   define   which   parts   of   the   payload   sub - agents   are   allowed   to   write   back   upstream .  Use  ["*"]  to   allow   all   writes ,  or   specify   paths   like  [" analysis . results ", " recommendations .*"]

Fields.Name: PayloadSelfReadPaths
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   paths   that   specify   what   parts   of   the   payload   the   agent ' s   own   prompt   can   read .  Controls   downstream   data  \bnflow   when   the   agent   executes   its   own   prompt   step .

Fields.Name: PayloadSelfWritePaths
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   paths   that   specify   what   parts   of   the   payload   the   agent ' s   own   prompt   can   write   back .  Controls   upstream  \bndata   flow   when   the   agent   executes   its   own   prompt   step .

Fields.Name: PayloadScope
Fields.Description: Defines   the   scope / path   within   the   parent   payload   that   this   sub - agent   operates   on .  When   set ,  the   sub - agent   receives   only   this   portion   of   the   payload   and   all   change   requests   are   relative   to   this   scope .  Format : / path / to / scope  ( e . g . / PropA / SubProp1 )

Fields.Name: FinalPayloadValidation
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   schema   or   requirements   that   define   the   expected   structure   and   content   of   the   agent ' s   final   payload .  Used   to   validate   the   output   when   the   agent   declares   success .  Similar   to   OutputExample   in   AI   Prompts .

Fields.Name: FinalPayloadValidationMode
Fields.Description: Determines   how   to   handle   validation   failures   when   FinalPayloadValidation   is   specified .  Options :  Retry  ( default ) -  retry   the   agent   with   validation   feedback ,  Fail  -  fail   the   agent   run   immediately ,  Warn  -  log   a   warning   but   allow   success .

Fields.Name: FinalPayloadValidationMaxRetries
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   retry   attempts   allowed   when   FinalPayloadValidation   fails   with \bnRetry   mode .  After   reaching   this   limit ,  the   validation   will   fail   permanently .

Fields.Name: MaxCostPerRun
Fields.Description: Maximum   cost   in   dollars   allowed   for   a   single   agent   run .  Run   will   be   terminated \bnif   this   limit   is   exceeded .

Fields.Name: MaxTokensPerRun
Fields.Description: Maximum   total   tokens  ( input  +  output )  allowed   for   a   single   agent   run .  Run   will \bnbe   terminated   if   this   limit   is   exceeded .

Fields.Name: MaxIterationsPerRun
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   prompt   iterations   allowed   for   a   single   agent   run .  Run   will   be \bnterminated   if   this   limit   is   exceeded .

Fields.Name: MaxTimePerRun
Fields.Description: Maximum   time   in   seconds   allowed   for   a   single   agent   run .  Run   will   be   terminated \bnif   this   limit   is   exceeded .

Fields.Name: MinExecutionsPerRun
Fields.Description: When   acting   as   a   sub - agent ,  minimum   number   of   times   this   agent   must   be   executed   per   parent   agent   run

Fields.Name: MaxExecutionsPerRun
Fields.Description: When   acting   as   a   sub - agent ,  maximum   number   of   times   this   agent   can   be   executed   per   parent   agent   run

Fields.Name: StartingPayloadValidation
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   schema   validation   to   apply   to   the   input   payload   before   agent   execution   begins .  Uses   the   same   JSONValidator   format   as   FinalPayloadValidation .

Fields.Name: StartingPayloadValidationMode
Fields.Description: Determines   how   to   handle   StartingPayloadValidation   failures .  Fail  =  reject   invalid   input ,  Warn  =  log   warning   but   proceed .

Fields.Name: DefaultPromptEffortLevel
Fields.Description: Default   effort   level   for   all   prompts   executed   by   this   agent  ( 1 - 100 ,  where   1 = minimal   effort ,  100 = maximum   effort ).  Takes   precedence   over   individual   prompt   EffortLevel   settings   but   can   be   overridden   by   runtime   parameters .  Inherited   by   sub - agents   unless   explicitly   overridden .

Fields.Name: ChatHandlingOption
Fields.Description: Controls   how   Chat   next   steps   are   handled .  When   null  ( default ),  Chat   propagates   to   caller .  When   set   to   Success ,  Failed ,  or   Retry ,  Chat   steps   are   remapped   to   that   value   and   re - validated .

Fields.Name: DefaultArtifactTypeID
Fields.Description: Default   artifact   type   produced   by   this   agent .  This   is   the   primary   artifact   type ;  additional   artifact   types   can   be   linked   via   AIAgentArtifactType   junction   table .  Can   be   NULL   if   agent   does   not   produce   artifacts   by   default .

Fields.Name: OwnerUserID
Fields.Description: The   user   who   owns   and   created   this   AI   agent .  Automatically   set   to   the   current   user   if   not   specified .  Owner   has   full   permissions  ( view ,  run ,  edit ,  delete )  regardless   of   ACL   entries .

Fields.Name: InvocationMode
Fields.Description: Controls   how   the   agent   can   be   invoked :  Any  ( default  -  can   be   top - level   or   sub - agent ),  Top - Level  ( only   callable   as   primary   agent ),  Sub - Agent  ( only   callable   as   sub - agent ).  Used   to   filter   available   agents   in   tools   like   Sage .

Fields.Name: ArtifactCreationMode
Fields.Description: Controls   how   artifacts   are   created   from   this   agent ' s   payloads . " Always "  creates   visible   artifacts , " Never "  skips   artifact   creation , " System   Only "  creates   hidden   system   artifacts .

Fields.Name: FunctionalRequirements
Fields.Description: Detailed   markdown   formatted   requirements   that   explain   the   business   goals   of   the   agent   without   specific   technical   implementation   details .

Fields.Name: TechnicalDesign
Fields.Description: Detailed   markdown   that   explains   the   structure   of   the   agent   including   agent   architecture ,  actions ,  sub - agents ,  prompts ,  and   payload   structure .

Fields.Name: InjectNotes
Fields.Description: When   enabled ,  agent   notes   will   be   automatically   injected   into   the   agent   context   based   on   scoping   rules .

Fields.Name: MaxNotesToInject
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   notes   to   inject   into   agent   context   per   request .

Fields.Name: NoteInjectionStrategy
Fields.Description: Strategy   for   selecting   which   notes   to   inject :  Relevant  ( semantic   search ),  Recent  ( most   recent   first ),  or   All  ( up   to   max   limit ).

Fields.Name: InjectExamples
Fields.Description: When   enabled ,  agent   examples   will   be   automatically   injected   into   the   agent   context   based   on   scoping   rules .

Fields.Name: MaxExamplesToInject
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   examples   to   inject   into   agent   context   per   request .

Fields.Name: ExampleInjectionStrategy
Fields.Description: Strategy   for   selecting   which   examples   to   inject :  Semantic  ( vector   similarity ),  Recent  ( most   recent   first ),  or   Rated  ( highest   success   score   first ).

Fields.Name: IsRestricted
Fields.Description: When   true ,  agent   is   restricted   to   system / scheduled   use   only   and   hidden   from   user   selection ,  Agent   Manager ,  and   MCP / A2A   discovery .

Fields.Name: MessageMode
Fields.Description: Specifies   how   conversation   messages   are   passed   from   parent   agent   to   this   child   sub - agent  ( when   this   agent   is   a   child   via   ParentID ).  Valid   values : ' None ' ( fresh   start  -  only   context   and   task   message ,  default ), ' All ' ( all   parent   conversation   history ), ' Latest ' ( most   recent   MaxMessages   messages ), ' Bookend ' ( first   2   messages  +  most   recent   MaxMessages - 2   messages   with   indicator   between ).  Stored   on   child   agent   because   each   child   has   only   one   parent   relationship .

Fields.Name: MaxMessages
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   conversation   messages   to   include   when   MessageMode   is  ' Latest '  or  ' Bookend '.  NULL   means   no   limit  ( ignored   for  ' None '  and  ' All '  modes ).  Must   be   greater   than   0   if   specified .  For  ' Latest ':  keeps   most   recent   N   messages .  For  ' Bookend ':  keeps   first   2  +  most   recent  ( N - 2 )  messages .

Fields.Name: AttachmentStorageProviderID
Fields.Description: File   storage   provider   for   large   attachments .  Overrides   the   default   from   AIConfiguration .  NULL   uses   system   default .

Fields.Name: AttachmentRootPath
Fields.Description: Base   path   within   the   storage   provider   for   this   agent ' s   attachments .  Agent   run   ID   and   sequence   number   are   appended   to   create   unique   paths .  Format : / folder / subfolder

Fields.Name: InlineStorageThresholdBytes
Fields.Description: File   size   threshold   for   inline   storage .  Files  <=  this   size   are   stored   as   base64   inline ,  larger   files   use   MJStorage .  NULL   uses   system   default  ( 1MB ).  Set   to   0   to   always   use   MJStorage .

Fields.Name: AgentTypePromptParams
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   parameter   values   that   customize   how   this   agent ' s   type - level   system   prompt   is   rendered .  The   schema   is   defined   by   the   agent   type ' s   PromptParamsSchema   field .  Allows   per - agent   control   over   which   prompt   sections   are   included ,  enabling   token   savings   by   excluding   unused   documentation .

Fields.Name: ScopeConfig
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   defining   scope   dimensions   for   multi - tenant   deployments .  Example : {" dimensions ":[{" name ":" OrganizationID "," entityId ":"..."," isPrimary ": true ," required ": true },{" name ":" ContactID "," entityId ":"..."," isPrimary ": false ," required ": false }]," inheritanceMode ":" cascading "}

Fields.Name: NoteRetentionDays
Fields.Description: Number   of   days   to   retain   notes   before   archiving   due   to   inactivity .  Default   90 .  NULL   means   use   system   default .

Fields.Name: ExampleRetentionDays
Fields.Description: Number   of   days   to   retain   examples   before   archiving   due   to   inactivity .  Default   180 .  NULL   means   use   system   default .

Fields.Name: AutoArchiveEnabled
Fields.Description: Whether   automatic   archival   of   stale   notes / examples   is   enabled   for   this   agent .  Default   true .

Fields.Name: RerankerConfiguration
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   optional   reranking   of   retrieved   memory   items .  Schema : {  enabled :  boolean ,  rerankerModelId :  string ,  retrievalMultiplier :  number  ( default   3 ),  minRelevanceThreshold :  number  ( default   0 . 5 ),  rerankPromptId ?:  string ,  contextFields ?:  string [],  fallbackOnError :  boolean  ( default   true ) }.  When   null   or   disabled ,  vector   search   results   are   used   directly   without   reranking .

Fields.Name: CategoryID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   AIAgentCategory .  Assigns   this   agent   to   an   organizational   category   for   grouping ,  filtering ,  and   inherited   assignment   strategy   resolution .

Fields.Name: AllowEphemeralClientTools
Fields.Description: When   true  ( default ),  this   agent   accepts   runtime - registered   ephemeral   client   tools   that   are   not   defined   in   metadata .  Set   to   false   for   agents   that   require   strict   tool   governance .

Fields.Name: DefaultStorageAccountID
Fields.Description: Default   file   storage   account   for   this   specific   agent .  Overrides   both   Type - level   and   Category - level   defaults .  Can   be   further   overridden   at   runtime   via   ExecuteAgentParams . override . storageAccountId .  FK   to   FileStorageAccount .

Fields.Name: SearchScopeAccess
Fields.Description: Controls   the   agent ' s   search   capability .  All  =  may   use   any   scope   including   Global ;  search   action   does   not   restrict .  Assigned  =  may   use   ONLY   scopes   explicitly   linked   via   AIAgentSearchScope ;  scoped   search   action   enforces   this .  None  =  agent   has   no   search   capability ;  the   scoped   search   action   rejects   all   requests .

Fields.Name: AcceptUnregisteredFiles
Fields.Description: Per - agent   opt - in   to   a   Generic   Binary   fallback   for   file   uploads   whose   MIME   type   does   not   match   any   registered   Artifact   Type .  When   false  ( default ),  unrecognized   uploads   are   rejected   at   upload   time   with   an   actionable   error .  When   true ,  unrecognized   uploads   resolve   to   the   Generic   Binary   artifact   type ,  exposing   only   get_full   and   get_metadata   tools .  Scoped   per   agent  —  there   is   no   system - wide   global   flag .

Fields.Name: DefaultCoAgentID
Fields.Description: Default   co - agent  ( a   Realtime - type   AI   Agent )  that   voices   THIS   agent   in   real - time   sessions  —  a   per - agent   persona .  Overridden   by   the   runtime   coAgentId   parameter ;  NULL   falls   through   to   a   type - level   AIAgentCoAgent   default   row ,  then   the   global   default   co - agent .

Fields.Name: TypeConfiguration
Fields.Description: Agent - type - specific   configuration   JSON ,  validated   against   the   agent   type ' s   ConfigSchema  ( when   one   is   published )  in   the   server - side   entity   subclass .  For   Realtime - type   co - agents   this   holds   the   realtime   profile :  preferred   model ,  per - provider   voice   settings ,  tone / speaking   style  ( folded   into   the   session   system   prompt   at   mint ),  user - override   policy ,  and   narration   pacing .  Null  =  type   defaults   apply .

Fields.Name: AllowMemoryWrite
Fields.Description: When   enabled ,  the   agent   may   commit   durable   memories   mid - run   via   the   memoryWrites   loop - response   field .  Writes   are   framework - guarded  ( type   restriction ,  scope   clamp ,  near - duplicate   check ,  per - run   cap )  and   land   as   Provisional   notes   pending   Memory   Manager   hardening .  On   by   default ;  disable   for   restricted   or   experimental   agents .

Fields.Name: RecordingDefault
Fields.Description: Agent - level   default   recording   media   for   realtime   sessions :  None ,  Audio ,  or   AudioVideo .  Overridden   per   session   by   a   runtime   parameter ;  if   unset ,  recording   is   OFF .  Capture   only   runs   when   a   storage   provider   is   resolvable  ( RecordingStorageProviderID ,  else   the   agent ' s   AttachmentStorageProviderID )  AND   consent   is   satisfied .

Fields.Name: RecordingStorageProviderID
Fields.Description: OPTIONAL   override   for   where   session   recordings   are   stored .  When   NULL ,  recordings   fall   back   to   the   agent ' s   AttachmentStorageProviderID .  Set   this   only   when   recordings   must   live   in   a   different   storage   account   than   attachments .

Fields.Name: DefaultMediaCollectionID
Fields.Description: OPTIONAL   default   media   kit   for   this   agent :  a   Collection   of   Artifacts   the   agent   may   show   on   the   realtime   Media   channel   during   a   conversation .  Resolved   per   session   as   runtime - override  >  this   agent   default  >  none .  When   set ,  the   agent   is   given   a   manifest  ( each   item ' s   display   name ,  media   type ,  when - to - show   ContextDescription   and   Preload   flag )  so   it   can   surface   items   via   the   Media_ShowMedia   tool .  When   NULL   the   agent   has   no   curated   kit  ( ad - hoc   Media_ShowMedia   still   works ).

Fields.Name: SupportsPlanMode
Fields.Description: Whether   this   agent   supports   Plan   Mode .  Defaults   ON  ( opt - out ).  Plan - mode   instructions   are   only   injected   when   this   is   on   AND   plan   mode   is   enabled   per - request ,  so   default   runtime   behavior   is   unchanged .  Realtime   agents   are   seeded   to   0  ( they   skip   plan   mode   structurally );  Remote   Proxy   agents   will   be   seeded   when   that   type   ships .

Fields.Name: AcceptsSkills
Fields.Description: Whether   this   agent   accepts   skills :  None  ( no   skills  —  default ),  All  ( any   Active   skill ),  or   Limited  ( only   skills   assigned   via   AIAgentSkill ).  This   is   the   per - agent   gate ;  AISkill . Status   and   AIAgentSkill . Status   provide   catalog -  and   assignment - level   gating   on   top .

Fields.Name: SkillActivationMode
Fields.Description: Controls   whether   this   agent   may   ever   self - activate   skills   from   its   prompt   catalog .  Auto :  the   agent   sees   its   allowed   skills   whose   own   ActivationMode   is   Auto  ( double   gate )  and   may   activate   them   mid - run   on   its   own   judgment .  RequestedOnly  ( default ):  the   agent ' s   prompt   catalog   is   empty   and   skills   only   enter   a   run   via   an   explicit   user   request  (/ skill   mention ).  Orthogonal   to   AcceptsSkills ,  which   governs   which   skills   are   available   at   all ;  this   governs   who   may   pull   the   activation   trigger .

Fields.Name: RequirePlanMode
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  every   root - level   run   of   this   agent   executes   in   plan   mode   regardless   of   the   per - request   planMode   flag  —  the   agent   must   present   a   plan   and   receive   human   approval   before   any   Actions   or   Sub - Agent   steps   execute .  SupportsPlanMode   is   irrelevant   when   this   is   set .  Use   for   high - consequence   agents  ( e . g .  ones   with   outbound - communication   capabilities )  where   human - in - the - loop   review   is   mandatory .

Fields.Name: ContextWindowMaxTokens
Fields.Description: Per - agent   override   for   the   effective   working - context   budget ,  in   tokens .  Null   inherits   the   agent   type ' s   value  ( which ,  if   also   null ,  falls   back   to   the   selected   model ' s   MaxInputTokens ).  The   resolved   value   is   clamped   to   the   model ' s   limit   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: CompactionTriggerPercent
Fields.Description: Per - agent   override   for   the   cross - turn   compaction   trigger   percentage .  Null   inherits   the   agent   type ' s   value .

Fields.Name: CompactionTargetPercent
Fields.Description: Per - agent   override   for   the   cross - turn   compaction   target   percentage .  Null   inherits   the   agent   type ' s   value .

Fields.Name: ConversationSummaryPromptID
Fields.Description: Per - agent   override   for   the   cross - turn   conversation   compaction   prompt .  Null   inherits   the   agent   type ' s   value .

Fields.Name: DeclareActionsAsNativeTools
Fields.Description: When   native   tool   calling   is   in   effect   for   a   run ,  whether   this   agent ' s   Actions   are   declared   as   native   tools  ( 1 ,  default )  or   withheld   so   the   agent   runs   on   the   envelope   path   with   the   prose   action   catalog  ( 0 ).  Set   0   for   coordinator   agents   whose   prompt   forbids   doing   work   themselves .  Controls   supply   only :  capability   and   preference   on   the   model   and   prompt   still   decide   whether   declared   tools   are   used .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Architectures
entities.Description: Master   table   of   AI   model   architectures  ( Transformer ,  Diffusion ,  MoE ,  etc .)  for   model   catalog   enrichment   and   eval   reporting .

Fields.Name: ParentArchitectureID
Fields.Description: Hierarchical   relationship   to   parent   architecture .  Used   for   variants   like   Sparse   Transformer   being   a   child   of   Transformer .

Fields.Name: IdentityType
Fields.Description: The   kind   of   address :  Email  ( a   calendar   mailbox   organizers   invite ),  PhoneNumber  ( an   inbound   DID ),  or   AccountID  ( a   platform - native   bot / user   account ).

Fields.Name: IdentityValue
Fields.Description: The   address   value   itself  ( e . g .  sage @ customer . com , + 15551234567 ,  or   a   platform   account   id ).  Unique   per   provider .

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: Friendly   display   name   shown   to   other   participants  ( e . g . " Sage  ( AI )").

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   identity   is   active .  Inactive   identities   are   ignored   by   invite   watchers   and   inbound   routing .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Identity - level   configuration   JSON  ( e . g .  tenant / mailbox   references ,  calendar - watch   scopes ).  Credentials   resolve   via   the   MJ   credential   system ;  never   inline .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  this   channel   is   auto - attached   to   a   new   bridge   session   on   this   provider ;  when   0 ,  it   is   available   but   attached   on   demand .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display / attachment   order   of   this   channel   for   the   provider  ( ascending ).

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Optional   per - provider   configuration   JSON   for   this   channel   contribution  ( e . g .  mapping   platform   tool   names   to   the   channel ' s   tool   vocabulary ).

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   platform   name  ( e . g .  Zoom ,  Microsoft   Teams ,  Google   Meet ,  Webex ,  Slack ,  Discord ,  RingCentral ,  Twilio ,  Vonage ,  LiveKit ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   human - readable   description   of   the   platform  /  driver .

Fields.Name: BridgeType
Fields.Description: The   family   of   endpoint   this   bridge   connects   to :  Meeting  ( a   conferencing   room )  or   Telephony  ( a   phone   call ).  LiveKit  ( MJ - native   multi - party   room )  is   a   Meeting .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Driver   key   resolved   at   runtime   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance ( BaseRealtimeBridge ,  DriverClass ).  MUST   match   the  @ RegisterClass   key   on   the   concrete   bridge   driver .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   is   available   for   use .  Inactive   providers   cannot   start   new   bridge   sessions .

Fields.Name: SupportedFeatures
Fields.Description: Strongly - typed   JSON   of   the   platform ' s   supported   features  ( the   IBridgeProviderFeatures   interface ,  bound   via   JSONType   metadata ):  join   methods  ( OnDemandJoin ,  ScheduledJoin ,  InviteJoin ,  NativeInvite ,  InboundRouting ,  OutboundDial ),  directional   media   tracks  ( AudioIn / Out ,  VideoIn / Out ,  ScreenIn / Out ),  and   signals  ( SpeakerDiarization ,  DTMF ,  CallTransfer ,  Recording ).  The   engine   gates   optional   driver   calls   on   these   flags ;  the   base   driver   throws   BridgeCapabilityNotSupportedError   when   a   feature   is   claimed   but   unimplemented .  Held   as   JSON   so   new   features   need   no   schema   change .  NULL / omitted  =  unsupported .

Fields.Name: ConfigSchema
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   Schema   validating   the   provider   Configuration   and   per - session   bridge   Config   payloads .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Provider - level   configuration   JSON  ( e . g .  credential   references   resolved   via   the   MJ   credential   system ,  region ,  bot   display   name ).  Never   store   secrets   inline .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   identifier   for   the   client   tool  ( e . g .,  NavigateToApp ,  NavigateToRecord ).  Used   to   match   tool   invocations   from   the   LLM   to   registered   handlers   on   the   client .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   of   what   the   tool   does .  This   text   is   injected   into   the   LLM   system   prompt   so   it   knows   when   and   how   to   use   the   tool .

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: Tool   category   for   grouping   and   filtering  ( e . g .,  navigation ,  form ,  display ,  data ).

Fields.Name: InputSchemaJSON
Fields.Description: JSON   Schema   defining   the   input   parameters   the   tool   accepts .  Included   in   the   LLM   prompt   so   it   generates   valid   parameter   objects .

Fields.Name: OutputSchemaJSON
Fields.Description: JSON   Schema   describing   the   return   value   from   the   tool .  Optional  —  used   for   documentation   and   LLM   context .

Fields.Name: DefaultTimeoutMs
Fields.Description: Default   timeout   in   milliseconds   for   this   tool .  Can   be   overridden   per - invocation   by   the   LLM   or   per - run   by   execution   params .  Default   is   30000ms  ( 30   seconds ).

Fields.Name: RequiresContextType
Fields.Description: When   set ,  the   client   only   sends   this   tool   to   the   server   when   the   user   is   in   the   specified   context  ( e . g .,  entity - form ,  dashboard ,  search ).  Null   means   the   tool   is   always   available .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Configuration   Params
entities.Description: Stores   configuration   parameters   that   can   be   referenced   by   prompts   and   used   to   control   execution   behavior .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   configuration   parameter .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: The   data   type   of   the   parameter  ( string ,  number ,  boolean ,  date ,  object ).

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: The   value   of   the   parameter ,  stored   as   a   string   but   interpreted   according   to   the   Type .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   parameter   and   its   usage .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Configurations
entities.Description: Stores   configurations   for   AI   prompt   execution   environments   and   settings .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   configuration .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   configuration .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   is   the   default   configuration   to   use   when   none   is   specified .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: The   current   status   of   the   configuration .  Values   include   Active ,  Inactive ,  Deprecated ,  and   Preview .

Fields.Name: DefaultPromptForContextCompressionID
Fields.Description: Default   prompt   to   use   for   context   compression   when   not   specified   at   the   agent   level .

Fields.Name: DefaultPromptForContextSummarizationID
Fields.Description: Default   prompt   to   use   for   context   summarization   when   not   specified   at   the   agent   level .

Fields.Name: DefaultStorageProviderID
Fields.Description: Default   file   storage   provider   for   agent   attachments .  Used   when   an   agent   does   not   specify   its   own   AttachmentStorageProviderID .

Fields.Name: DefaultStorageRootPath
Fields.Description: Default   root   path   within   the   storage   provider   for   agent   attachments .  Used   when   an   agent   does   not   specify   its   own   AttachmentRootPath .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   a   parent   configuration .  When   set ,  this   configuration   inherits   prompt - model   mappings   and   parameters   from   its   parent .  Child   configurations   can   override   specific   settings   while   inheriting   defaults   from   the   parent   chain .  Supports   N - level   deep   inheritance .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Credential   Bindings
entities.Description: Junction   table   that   binds   credentials   to   AI   entities  ( Vendors ,  ModelVendors ,  PromptModels ).  Decouples   credential   assignments   from   core   AI   entities   to   prevent   MJ   updates   from   overwriting   customer   configurations .  Supports   priority - based   failover   with   multiple   credentials   per   binding   level .

Fields.Name: CredentialID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   credential   being   bound .

Fields.Name: BindingType
Fields.Description: The   type   of   AI   entity   this   credential   is   bound   to :  Vendor  ( broadest ),  ModelVendor  ( model + vendor   specific ),  or   PromptModel  ( most   specific ).  Resolution   follows   prompt  →  model  →  vendor   hierarchy .

Fields.Name: AIVendorID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   AIVendor   when   BindingType   is   Vendor .  NULL   otherwise .

Fields.Name: AIModelVendorID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   AIModelVendor   when   BindingType   is   ModelVendor .  NULL   otherwise .

Fields.Name: AIPromptModelID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   AIPromptModel   when   BindingType   is   PromptModel .  NULL   otherwise .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Priority   for   credential   selection   when   multiple   bindings   exist   at   the   same   level .  Lower   values   have   higher   priority  ( 0   is   highest ).  Enables   failover   when   primary   credentials   are   unavailable .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: When   false ,  this   binding   is   ignored   during   credential   resolution .  Allows   temporary   disabling   without   deletion .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Modalities
entities.Description: Master   list   of   AI   content   modalities  ( Text ,  Image ,  Audio ,  Video ,  etc .)  that   models   can   accept   as   input   or   produce   as   output .  New   modalities   can   be   added   via   INSERT   without   schema   changes .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   modality  ( e . g .,  Text ,  Image ,  Audio ,  Video ,  File ,  Embedding ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   this   modality   and   its   use   cases .

Fields.Name: ContentBlockType
Fields.Description: Maps   to   ChatMessageContentBlock . type   values :  text ,  image_url ,  video_url ,  audio_url ,  file_url ,  embedding .  Must   match   the   TypeScript   type   definition .

Fields.Name: MIMETypePattern
Fields.Description: MIME   type   pattern   for   this   modality  ( e . g .,  image /*,  audio /*,  video /*,  text /*,  application /*).  Used   for   file   type   validation .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Classification   type :  Content  ( human - readable   text ),  Structured  ( JSON / embeddings ),  Binary  ( media   files   like   images ,  audio ,  video ).

Fields.Name: DefaultMaxSizeBytes
Fields.Description: System - wide   default   maximum   size   in   bytes   for   this   modality .  Can   be   overridden   at   model   or   agent   level .  NULL   means   no   size   limit .

Fields.Name: DefaultMaxCountPerMessage
Fields.Description: System - wide   default   maximum   count   per   message   for   this   modality .  Can   be   overridden   at   model   or   agent   level .  NULL   means   no   count   limit .

Fields.Name: DisplayOrder
Fields.Description: Display   order   for   UI   presentation .  Lower   numbers   appear   first .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Actions
entities.Description: Tracks   the   actions   supported   by   each   AI   Model

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Determines   if   this   specific   action   is   currently   enabled   for   the   associated   AI   model .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Architectures
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   AI   models   to   their   underlying   architectures .  Supports   multiple   architectures   per   model   with   ranking .

Fields.Name: Rank
Fields.Description: Ranking   of   this   architecture   for   the   model .  1 = Primary   architecture ,  2 = Secondary ,  etc .  Lower   numbers   indicate   more   dominant   role .

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Optional   weight  ( 0 . 0 - 1 . 0 )  indicating   the   mix   ratio   for   hybrid   architectures .  E . g .,  0 . 7   for   70 %  contribution .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Costs
entities.Description: Stores   historical   and   current   pricing   information   for   AI   models   across   different   vendors ,  with   optional   temporal   tracking   and   support   for   different   processing   types

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Date   and   time   with   timezone   when   this   pricing   became   effective .  NULL   disables   temporal   tracking .  Defaults   to   current   UTC   time   when   record   is   created

Fields.Name: EndedAt
Fields.Description: Date   and   time   with   timezone   when   this   pricing   expired   or   will   expire .  NULL   indicates   currently   active   pricing

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   this   pricing   record .  Active = currently   in   use ,  Pending = scheduled   for   future ,  Expired = no   longer   valid ,  Invalid = data   error

Fields.Name: Currency
Fields.Description: ISO   4217   three - letter   currency   code  ( e . g .,  USD ,  EUR ,  GBP )  in   uppercase

Fields.Name: PriceTypeID
Fields.Description: DEPRECATED  —  descriptive   only ;  nothing   prices ,  filters   or   branches   on   it .  The   authority   on   what   a   cost   row   measures   is   UnitTypeID  ->  AIModelPriceUnitType . UsageTypeID .  Retained   only   so   existing   configurations   still   validate   and   historical   spCreateAIModelCost   calls   keep   working ;  do   not   populate   it   for   new   cost   rows .

Fields.Name: InputPricePerUnit
Fields.Description: Price   per   unit   for   input   tokens / requests .  Must   be   non - negative .  Precision   allows   for   micro - pricing   scenarios

Fields.Name: OutputPricePerUnit
Fields.Description: Price   per   unit   for   output   tokens / responses .  Must   be   non - negative .  Often   higher   than   input   pricing

Fields.Name: UnitTypeID
Fields.RelatedEntity: MJ :  AI   Model   Price   Unit   Types

Fields.Name: ProcessingType
Fields.Description: Processing   method   that   affects   pricing .  Realtime = immediate   response ,  Batch = delayed   processing   often   with   discounts

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Optional   notes   about   pricing   context ,  source ,  special   conditions ,  or   vendor - specific   details

Fields.Name: CacheReadPricePerUnit
Fields.Description: Optional   price   per   unit   for   input   tokens   served   from   the   AI   provider ' s   prompt   cache  ( cache   reads  /  hits ),  expressed   in   the   same   currency   and   UnitType  ( e . g .  per   1M   tokens )  as   InputPricePerUnit .  When   NULL ,  cache - read   tokens   are   priced   at   InputPricePerUnit .  Cache   reads   are   usually   far   cheaper   than   uncached   input  ( e . g . ~ 0 . 1x   for   Anthropic / Gemini , ~ 0 . 5x   for   OpenAI ).

Fields.Name: CacheWritePricePerUnit
Fields.Description: Optional   price   per   unit   for   input   tokens   written   to   the   AI   provider ' s   prompt   cache  ( cache   writes  /  creation ),  expressed   in   the   same   currency   and   UnitType   as   InputPricePerUnit .  When   NULL ,  cache - write   tokens   are   priced   at   InputPricePerUnit .  Populated   for   providers   that   bill   cache   creation   separately  ( e . g .  Anthropic , ~ 1 . 25x   input );  leave   NULL   for   providers   that   do   not  ( OpenAI ,  Gemini ),  which   also   report   0   cache - write   tokens .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Modalities
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   AI   models   to   their   supported   input   and   output   modalities   with   model - specific   configuration .  Used   to   extend   beyond   the   default   modalities   inherited   from   AIModelType .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   an   Input   or   Output   modality   for   the   model .

Fields.Name: IsSupported
Fields.Description: Whether   this   modality   is   supported .  Can   be   set   to   FALSE   to   explicitly   disable   an   inherited   modality .

Fields.Name: IsRequired
Fields.Description: For   input   modalities :  whether   this   modality   is   required  ( e . g .,  text   is   usually   required   for   LLMs ).  For   outputs :  not   typically   applicable .

Fields.Name: SupportedFormats
Fields.Description: Comma - separated   list   of   supported   file   formats / extensions  ( e . g .,  png , jpg , webp , gif   for   images   or   mp3 , wav , m4a   for   audio ).

Fields.Name: MaxSizeBytes
Fields.Description: Model - specific   maximum   size   in   bytes .  Overrides   AIModality . DefaultMaxSizeBytes .  NULL   means   use   system   default .

Fields.Name: MaxCountPerMessage
Fields.Description: Model - specific   maximum   count   per   message .  Overrides   AIModality . DefaultMaxCountPerMessage .  NULL   means   use   system   default .

Fields.Name: MaxDimension
Fields.Description: For   image / video   modalities :  maximum   dimension  ( width   or   height )  in   pixels   supported   by   this   model .

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Additional   notes   or   documentation   about   this   model - modality   configuration .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Personas
entities.Description: Specifies   per - model   persona   availability   overrides   where   a   model ' s   supported   personas   differ   from   its   vendor ' s   default   catalog .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Deterministic   ordering   sequence   for   persona   priority   at   the   model   level .

Fields.Name: IsSupported
Fields.Description: Whether   this   persona   is   supported   by   the   specific   model .  Set   to   0   to   explicitly   disable   an   inherited   vendor   persona   for   this   model .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Price   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   different   types   of   pricing   metrics   used   by   AI   model   vendors  ( e . g .,  Tokens ,  Minutes ,  Characters ,  API   Calls )

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Short ,  descriptive   name   for   the   price   type  ( e . g ., " Tokens ", " Minutes ", " Characters ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   what   this   price   type   represents   and   how   it   is   measured

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Price   Unit   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   unit   scales   used   for   pricing  ( e . g .,  Per   1M   Tokens ,  Per   1K   Tokens ,  Per   Minute ).  Includes   driver   class   for   normalization   calculations

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   pricing   unit  ( e . g ., " Per   1M   Tokens ", " Per   1K   Tokens ", " Per   Minute ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   explanation   of   the   unit   scale   and   any   special   considerations   for   this   pricing   unit

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Fully   qualified   class   name   that   handles   cost   calculations   and   unit   normalization   for   this   pricing   unit  ( e . g ., " TokenPer1M ", " TokenPer1K ")

Fields.Name: UsageTypeID
Fields.Description: The   base   measure   this   billing   unit   is   a   quantity   of  —  Tokens   for   a   per - 1M - tokens   rate ,  Seconds   for   a   per - minute   or   per - hour   rate ,  Images   for   a   per - image   rate .  This   is   the   authority   on   what   a   cost   row   priced   by   this   unit   type   measures :  AIModelCost   deliberately   does   NOT   carry   its   own   copy ,  because   two   copies   can   disagree   and   nothing   would   arbitrate .

Fields.Name: UnitsPerBillingUnit
Fields.Description: How   many   units   of   the   base   measure   make   ONE   billed   unit :  1000000   for   a   per - 1M - tokens   rate ,  3600   for   per - hour ,  60   for   per - minute ,  1   for   per - image .  Cost   is  ( quantity  /  UnitsPerBillingUnit ) *  PricePerUnit .  Holding   the   divisor   as   DATA   is   what   lets   a   new   linear   billing   unit   ship   by   seeding   a   row ,  with   no   driver   class   and   no   build  —  the   code - only   requirement   is   what   made   bug   B60   possible .  DriverClass   remains   for   non - linear   pricing  ( tiered   rates ,  per - image - by - resolution ,  minimum - billing   increments ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Types
entities.Description: Types   of   AI   Models

Fields.Name: DefaultInputModalityID
Fields.Description: Default   input   modality   for   this   model   type .  Models   of   this   type   inherit   this   as   their   primary   input   modality   unless   overridden .

Fields.Name: DefaultOutputModalityID
Fields.Description: Default   output   modality   for   this   model   type .  Models   of   this   type   inherit   this   as   their   primary   output   modality   unless   overridden .

Fields.Name: SupportsPrefill
Fields.Description: Whether   models   of   this   type   generally   support   assistant   prefill .  This   is   a   default   value   that   individual   AI   Model   Vendor   records   can   override .  For   LLM   types ,  many   providers   support   prefill ;  for   image / audio   types ,  this   is   typically   false .

Fields.Name: PrefillFallbackText
Fields.Description: Default   fallback   instruction   text   used   when   PrefillFallbackMode   is   SystemInstruction   and   the   provider   does   not   support   native   prefill .  Use  {{ prefill }}  as   a   placeholder   for   the   actual   prefill   text .  Example : " IMPORTANT :  You   must   begin   your   response   with   exactly : {{ prefill }}".  Individual   AI   Model   Vendor   records   can   override   this .  If   null ,  a   generic   fallback   is   used .

Fields.Name: ModelConfiguration
Fields.Description: Type - wide   default   of   the   per - modality   model - configuration   bag  ( JSON ,  IAIModelConfiguration   shape :  LLM  /  Realtime  /  Vision  /  Audio   sections ).  Base   layer   of   the   ModelConfiguration   cascade  —  AIModel   and   AIModelVendor   rows   inherit   from   it   per   key   and   may   override .  NULL  =  contributes   nothing .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Vendors
entities.Description: Associates   AI   models   with   vendors   providing   them ,  including   vendor - specific   implementation   details .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Determines   the   priority   rank   of   this   vendor   for   the   model .  Higher   values   indicate   higher   priority .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: The   current   status   of   this   model - vendor   combination .  Values   include   Active ,  Inactive ,  Deprecated ,  and   Preview .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   driver   class   implementing   this   model - vendor   combination .

Fields.Name: DriverImportPath
Fields.Description: The   import   path   for   the   driver   class .

Fields.Name: APIName
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   model   to   use   with   API   calls ,  which   might   differ   from   the   model   name .  If   not   provided ,  the   model   name   will   be   used .

Fields.Name: MaxInputTokens
Fields.Description: The   maximum   number   of   input   tokens   supported   by   this   model - vendor   implementation .

Fields.Name: MaxOutputTokens
Fields.Description: The   maximum   number   of   output   tokens   supported   by   this   model - vendor   implementation .

Fields.Name: SupportedResponseFormats
Fields.Description: A   comma - delimited   string   indicating   the   supported   response   formats   for   this   model - vendor   implementation .  Options   include   Any ,  Text ,  Markdown ,  JSON ,  and   ModelSpecific .

Fields.Name: SupportsEffortLevel
Fields.Description: Specifies   if   this   model - vendor   implementation   supports   the   concept   of   an   effort   level .

Fields.Name: SupportsStreaming
Fields.Description: Specifies   if   this   model - vendor   implementation   supports   streaming   responses .

Fields.Name: TypeID
Fields.Description: References   the   type / role   of   the   vendor   for   this   model  ( e . g .,  model   developer ,  inference   provider )

Fields.Name: SupportsPrefill
Fields.Description: Whether   this   specific   model - vendor   implementation   supports   assistant   prefill .  Overrides   the   AI   Model   Type   default   when   set .  NULL   means   inherit   from   the   AI   Model   Type .  For   example ,  Claude   via   Anthropic   supports   prefill  ( true ),  but   GPT - 4   via   OpenAI   does   not  ( false ).

Fields.Name: PrefillFallbackText
Fields.Description: Model - specific   fallback   instruction   text   used   when   PrefillFallbackMode   is   SystemInstruction   and   the   provider   does   not   support   native   prefill .  Overrides   the   AI   Model   Type   default .  Use  {{ prefill }}  as   a   placeholder .  Allows   tuning   the   fallback   instruction   per   model   since   different   models   respond   better   to   different   phrasing .

Fields.Name: ModelConfiguration
Fields.Description: Most - specific   layer   of   the   per - modality   model - configuration   bag  ( JSON ,  IAIModelConfiguration   shape ) —  configuration   for   THIS   model   on   THIS   provider .  Deep - merges   per   key   over   the   model   and   type   layers .  NULL  =  inherit   the   merged   model / type   configuration   unchanged .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Models
entities.Description: Catalog   of   all   AI   Models   configured   in   the   system

Fields.Name: PowerRank
Fields.Description: Optional   column   that   ranks   the   power   of   the   AI   model .  Default   is   0   and   should   be   non - negative .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Controls   whether   this   AI   model   is   available   for   use   in   the   system .

Fields.Name: SpeedRank
Fields.Description: Optional   column   that   ranks   the   speed   of   the   AI   model .  Default   is   0   and   should   be   non - negative .

Fields.Name: CostRank
Fields.Description: Optional   column   that   ranks   the   cost   of   the   AI   model .  Default   is   0   and   should   be   non - negative .

Fields.Name: ModelSelectionInsights
Fields.Description: This   column   stores   unstructured   text   notes   that   provide   insights   into   what   the   model   is   particularly   good   at   and   areas   where   it   may   not   perform   as   well .  These   notes   can   be   used   by   a   human   or   an   AI   to   determine   if   the   model   is   a   good   fit   for   various   purposes .

Fields.Name: InheritTypeModalities
Fields.Description: When   TRUE  ( default ),  the   model   inherits   default   input / output   modalities   from   its   AIModelType   AND   can   extend   with   additional   modalities   via   AIModelModality   records .  When   FALSE ,  only   modalities   explicitly   defined   in   AIModelModality   are   used .

Fields.Name: PriorVersionID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   previous   version   of   this   model ,  creating   a   version   lineage   chain .  For   example ,  GPT - 4   Turbo   might   reference   GPT - 4   as   its   prior   version .

Fields.Name: SupportsPrefill
Fields.Description: Whether   this   model   supports   assistant   prefill .  Overrides   the   AI   Model   Type   default   when   set .  NULL   means   inherit   from   the   AI   Model   Type .  Can   be   further   overridden   per - vendor   in   AI   Model   Vendor .

Fields.Name: PrefillFallbackText
Fields.Description: Model - level   fallback   instruction   text   used   when   PrefillFallbackMode   is   SystemInstruction   and   the   provider   does   not   support   native   prefill .  Overrides   the   AI   Model   Type   default ,  can   be   further   overridden   per - vendor   in   AI   Model   Vendor .  Use  {{ prefill }}  as   a   placeholder .

Fields.Name: ModelConfiguration
Fields.Description: Per - model   layer   of   the   per - modality   model - configuration   bag  ( JSON ,  IAIModelConfiguration   shape ).  Deep - merges   per   key   over   the   AIModelType   default ;  AIModelVendor   rows   may   override   per   key   on   top .  NULL  =  inherit   the   type   default   unchanged .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Persona   Vendors
entities.Description: Concrete   vendor   and   modality   binding   for   a   persona ,  mapping   the   abstract   persona   to   a   provider - specific   wire   asset   identifier  ( voice   ID   or   avatar   ID ).

Fields.Name: APIName
Fields.Description: Vendor - specific   asset   name   or   identifier   passed   over   the   wire  ( e . g .,  alloy ,  sage ,  an   ElevenLabs   voice_id ,  or   a   HeyGen   avatar_id ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   operational   status   of   this   vendor   persona   binding .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Selection   priority   when   multiple   vendor   bindings   qualify   for   a   given   persona   and   modality .  Higher   numbers   indicate   higher   priority .

Fields.Name: VendorSettings
Fields.Description: Provider - specific   configuration   JSON  ( e . g .,  ElevenLabs   stability ,  similarityBoost ,  style ,  useSpeakerBoost ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Personas
entities.Description: Abstract ,  provider - agnostic   presentational   identity  ( voice   and / or   visual   appearance )  that   AI   agents   can   assume   when   interacting   with   users .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   display   name   identifying   this   persona  ( e . g .,  Alloy ,  Aria ,  Sage ).  Globally   unique   across   all   sources   to   maintain   deterministic   cross - modality   catalog   curation .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   the   persona ,  its   characteristics ,  and   intended   personality .

Fields.Name: PerceivedGender
Fields.Description: The   perceived   gender   presentation   of   this   persona  ( e . g .,  Male ,  Female ,  Neutral ,  Non - Binary ).

Fields.Name: Locale
Fields.Description: BCP   47   language   and   locale   tag   primarily   associated   with   this   persona  ( e . g .,  en - US ,  es - ES ).

Fields.Name: PerceivedAgeRangeMin
Fields.Description: Approximate   minimum   perceived   age   for   this   persona ,  enabling   numerical   filtering .

Fields.Name: PerceivedAgeRangeMax
Fields.Description: Approximate   maximum   perceived   age   for   this   persona ,  enabling   numerical   filtering .

Fields.Name: Tone
Fields.Description: Core   tonal   quality   for   this   persona  ( e . g .,  Warm ,  Authoritative ,  Enthusiastic ,  Calm ).  Injected   into   prompt   context   for   conversational   delivery .

Fields.Name: SpeakingStyle
Fields.Description: Stylistic   manner   of   speaking  ( e . g .,  Casual   and   conversational ,  Direct   and   concise ,  Academic ).

Fields.Name: StyleDescriptors
Fields.Description: Additional   descriptive   keywords   or   JSON   metadata   capturing   nuanced   personality   and   presentation   traits .

Fields.Name: PreviewAudioURL
Fields.Description: URL   to   a   sample   audio   file   demonstrating   this   persona ' s   voice .

Fields.Name: PreviewImageURL
Fields.Description: URL   to   a   preview   avatar   image   for   this   persona .

Fields.Name: PreviewVideoURL
Fields.Description: URL   to   a   preview   video   demonstrating   this   persona ' s   visual   animation   or   avatar .

Fields.Name: Source
Fields.Description: Origin   of   this   persona :  BuiltIn  ( provided   by   system / catalog ),  Custom  ( user - defined ),  or   Cloned  ( derived / voice - cloned ).

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   persona   is   currently   active   and   available   for   selection .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Categories
entities.Description: Categories   for   organizing   AI   prompts   in   a   hierarchical   structure .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Parent   category   ID   for   hierarchical   organization .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Models
entities.Description: Associates   AI   prompts   with   specific   models   and   configurations ,  including   execution   details .

Fields.Name: PromptID
Fields.Description: References   the   AI   prompt   this   model   association   applies   to .

Fields.Name: ModelID
Fields.Description: References   the   AI   model   to   use   for   this   prompt .

Fields.Name: VendorID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   a   specific   vendor   for   the   model .  If   NULL ,  uses   the   highest   priority   vendor   for   the   model .

Fields.Name: ConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   a   specific   configuration .  If   NULL ,  this   model   is   available   in   all   configurations .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Priority   of   this   model   for   the   prompt .  Higher   values   indicate   higher   priority .

Fields.Name: ExecutionGroup
Fields.Description: Execution   group   for   parallel   processing .  Models   with   the   same   group   are   executed   in   parallel .

Fields.Name: ModelParameters
Fields.Description: JSON - formatted   parameters   specific   to   this   model  ( temperature ,  max   tokens ,  etc .).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: The   current   status   of   this   model   configuration .  Values   include   Active ,  Inactive ,  Deprecated ,  and   Preview .

Fields.Name: ParallelizationMode
Fields.Description: Controls   how   this   model   participates   in   parallelization :  None ,  StaticCount ,  or   ConfigParam .

Fields.Name: ParallelCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   parallel   executions   to   perform   with   this   model   when   ParallelizationMode   is   StaticCount .

Fields.Name: ParallelConfigParam
Fields.Description: Name   of   a   configuration   parameter   that   contains   the   parallel   count   when   ParallelizationMode   is   ConfigParam .

Fields.Name: EffortLevel
Fields.Description: Model - specific   effort   level   override  ( 1 - 100 ,  where   1 = minimal   effort ,  100 = maximum   effort ).  Allows   customizing   effort   level   per   model  -  useful   when   a   more   capable   model   can   use   lower   effort   for   tasks   that   require   higher   effort   from   lesser   models .  Takes   precedence   over   agent   and   prompt   effort   levels   but   can   be   overridden   by   runtime   parameters .

Fields.Name: PromptConfiguration
Fields.Description: Most - specific   layer   of   the   prompt   configuration   bag  ( JSON ,  IAIPromptModelConfiguration   shape ) —  configuration   for   THIS   prompt   on   THIS   model .  Deep - merges   per   key   over   the   AIPrompt   layer ,  which   in   turn   sits   above   the   model - catalog   ModelConfiguration   cascade .  NULL  =  inherit   the   merged   configuration   unchanged .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   the   media   generated   during   prompt   execution .  Provides   context   for   audit   trail .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   AI   prompt   executions   including   timings ,  inputs ,  outputs ,  and   performance   metrics .

Fields.Name: PromptID
Fields.Description: The   prompt   that   was   executed .

Fields.Name: ModelID
Fields.Description: The   AI   model   used   for   execution .

Fields.Name: VendorID
Fields.Description: The   vendor   providing   the   model / inference .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: If   this   prompt   was   run   as   part   of   an   agent ,  references   the   agent .

Fields.Name: ConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Optional   configuration   used   for   this   execution .

Fields.Name: RunAt
Fields.Description: When   the   prompt   run   started ,  with   timezone   offset   information .

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   prompt   run   completed ,  with   timezone   offset   information .

Fields.Name: ExecutionTimeMS
Fields.Description: Total   execution   time   in   milliseconds .

Fields.Name: Messages
Fields.Description: The   input   messages   sent   to   the   model ,  typically   in   JSON   format .

Fields.Name: Result
Fields.Description: The   output   result   from   the   model .

Fields.Name: TokensUsed
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   tokens   used  ( prompt  +  completion ).

Fields.Name: TokensPrompt
Fields.Description: Number   of   tokens   in   the   prompt .

Fields.Name: TokensCompletion
Fields.Description: Number   of   tokens   in   the   completion / result .

Fields.Name: TotalCost
Fields.Description: Total   cost   of   this   prompt   run   including   its   own   cost   plus   all   descendant   costs .  Calculated   as   Cost  +  DescendantCost .  This   value   is   stored  ( not   computed )  for   query   performance .  Currency   is   specified   in   CostCurrency   field .

Fields.Name: Success
Fields.Description: Whether   the   execution   was   successful .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   message   if   the   execution   failed .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: References   the   parent   AIPromptRun . ID   for   hierarchical   execution   tracking .  NULL   for   top - level   runs ,  populated   for   parallel   children   and   result   selector   runs .

Fields.Name: RunType
Fields.Description: Type   of   prompt   run   execution :  Single  ( standard   single   prompt ),  ParallelParent  ( coordinator   for   parallel   execution ),  ParallelChild  ( individual   parallel   execution ),  ResultSelector  ( result   selection   prompt   that   chooses   best   result )

Fields.Name: ExecutionOrder
Fields.Description: Execution   order   for   parallel   child   runs   and   result   selector   runs .  Used   to   track   the   sequence   of   execution   within   a   parallel   run   group .  NULL   for   single   runs   and   parallel   parent   runs .

Fields.Name: Cost
Fields.Description: The   cost   of   this   specific   prompt   execution   as   reported   by   the   AI   provider .  This   does   not   include   costs   from   child   executions .  The   currency   is   specified   in   CostCurrency   field .

Fields.Name: CostCurrency
Fields.Description: ISO   4217   currency   code   for   the   Cost   field  ( e . g .,  USD ,  EUR ,  GBP ).  Different   AI   providers   may   use   different   currencies .

Fields.Name: TokensUsedRollup
Fields.Description: Total   tokens   used   including   this   execution   and   all   child / grandchild   executions .  This   provides   a   complete   view   of   token   usage   for   hierarchical   prompt   trees .  Calculated   as   TokensPromptRollup  +  TokensCompletionRollup .

Fields.Name: TokensPromptRollup
Fields.Description: Total   prompt / input   tokens   including   this   execution   and   all   child / grandchild   executions .  For   leaf   nodes  ( no   children ),  this   equals   TokensPrompt .  For   parent   nodes ,  this   includes   the   sum   of   all   descendant   prompt   tokens .

Fields.Name: TokensCompletionRollup
Fields.Description: Total   completion / output   tokens   including   this   execution   and   all   child / grandchild   executions .  For   leaf   nodes  ( no   children ),  this   equals   TokensCompletion .  For   parent   nodes ,  this   includes   the   sum   of   all   descendant   completion   tokens .

Fields.Name: Temperature
Fields.Description: The   temperature   parameter   used   for   this   prompt   run ,  controlling   randomness   in   the   output  ( 0 . 0  =  deterministic ,  2 . 0  =  very   random )

Fields.Name: TopP
Fields.Description: Top - p  ( nucleus )  sampling   parameter   used   for   this   run .  Considers   tokens   with   cumulative   probability   up   to   this   value  ( 0 - 1 )

Fields.Name: TopK
Fields.Description: Top - k   sampling   parameter   used   for   this   run .  Limits   sampling   to   the   top   K   most   likely   tokens

Fields.Name: MinP
Fields.Description: Minimum   probability   threshold   used   for   token   sampling  ( 0 - 1 ).  Tokens   below   this   probability   are   filtered   out

Fields.Name: FrequencyPenalty
Fields.Description: Frequency   penalty   parameter   used  (- 2 . 0   to   2 . 0 ).  Positive   values   reduce   repetition   of   tokens   based   on   their   frequency   in   the   output

Fields.Name: PresencePenalty
Fields.Description: Presence   penalty   parameter   used  (- 2 . 0   to   2 . 0 ).  Positive   values   encourage   the   model   to   talk   about   new   topics

Fields.Name: Seed
Fields.Description: Random   seed   used   for   reproducible   outputs .  When   set ,  the   same   seed   with   identical   inputs   should   produce   the   same   output

Fields.Name: StopSequences
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   stop   sequences   used .  The   model   stops   generating   when   any   of   these   sequences   are   encountered

Fields.Name: ResponseFormat
Fields.Description: The   response   format   requested   for   this   run  ( e . g ., ' JSON ', ' Text ', ' Markdown ')

Fields.Name: LogProbs
Fields.Description: Whether   log   probabilities   were   requested   for   this   run

Fields.Name: TopLogProbs
Fields.Description: Number   of   top   log   probabilities   requested   per   token  ( if   LogProbs   is   true )

Fields.Name: DescendantCost
Fields.Description: The   total   cost   of   all   descendant  ( child   and   grandchild )  prompt   runs ,  excluding   this   run ' s   own   cost .  For   leaf   nodes  ( no   children ),  this   is   0 .  Updated   when   child   costs   change .

Fields.Name: ValidationAttemptCount
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   validation   attempts   made  ( including   the   initial   attempt )

Fields.Name: SuccessfulValidationCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   validation   attempts   that   passed   validation

Fields.Name: FinalValidationPassed
Fields.Description: Whether   validation   ultimately   passed  ( 1 )  or   failed  ( 0 )

Fields.Name: ValidationBehavior
Fields.Description: Validation   behavior   used :  Strict ,  Warn ,  or   None

Fields.Name: RetryStrategy
Fields.Description: Retry   strategy   used :  Fixed ,  Linear ,  or   Exponential

Fields.Name: MaxRetriesConfigured
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   retries   configured   on   the   prompt

Fields.Name: FinalValidationError
Fields.Description: The   final   validation   error   message   if   validation   failed

Fields.Name: ValidationErrorCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   validation   errors   on   the   final   attempt

Fields.Name: CommonValidationError
Fields.Description: Most   frequent   validation   error   across   all   attempts

Fields.Name: FirstAttemptAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   first   validation   attempt

Fields.Name: LastAttemptAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   validation   attempt

Fields.Name: TotalRetryDurationMS
Fields.Description: Total   time   spent   on   retries   in   milliseconds  ( excluding   first   attempt )

Fields.Name: ValidationAttempts
Fields.Description: JSON   array   containing   detailed   information   about   each   validation   attempt

Fields.Name: ValidationSummary
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   summary   information   about   the   validation   process

Fields.Name: FailoverAttempts
Fields.Description: Number   of   failover   attempts   made   during   this   prompt   run

Fields.Name: FailoverErrors
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   error   details   from   each   failover   attempt

Fields.Name: FailoverDurations
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   duration   in   milliseconds   for   each   failover   attempt

Fields.Name: OriginalModelID
Fields.Description: The   AI   Model   ID   that   was   originally   attempted   before   any   failovers

Fields.Name: OriginalRequestStartTime
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   original   request   started ,  before   any   failovers

Fields.Name: TotalFailoverDuration
Fields.Description: Total   time   spent   in   failover   attempts   in   milliseconds

Fields.Name: RerunFromPromptRunID
Fields.Description: If   this   run   was   initiated   as   a   re - run   of   another   prompt   run ,  this   field   links   back   to   the   original   run   ID

Fields.Name: ModelSelection
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   detailed   model   selection   information   including   all   models   considered ,  their   scores ,  and   the   selection   rationale

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   execution   status   of   the   prompt   run .  Valid   values :  Pending ,  Running ,  Completed ,  Failed ,  Cancelled

Fields.Name: Cancelled
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   prompt   run   was   cancelled   before   completion

Fields.Name: CancellationReason
Fields.Description: Detailed   reason   for   cancellation   if   the   prompt   run   was   cancelled .  Could   be   user_requested ,  timeout ,  error ,  or   resource_limit

Fields.Name: ModelPowerRank
Fields.Description: Power   rank   of   the   model   that   was   selected   for   this   run .  Lower   numbers   indicate   more   powerful   models

Fields.Name: SelectionStrategy
Fields.Description: Strategy   used   for   model   selection .  Valid   values :  Default  ( system   default ),  Specific  ( specific   models   configured ),  ByPower  ( based   on   power   ranking )

Fields.Name: CacheHit
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   result   was   served   from   cache   rather   than   executing   a   new   model   call

Fields.Name: CacheKey
Fields.Description: Unique   key   used   for   caching   this   prompt   result ,  typically   a   hash   of   the   prompt   and   parameters

Fields.Name: JudgeID
Fields.Description: ID   of   the   AIPrompt   used   as   a   judge   to   evaluate   and   rank   multiple   parallel   execution   results

Fields.Name: JudgeScore
Fields.Description: Score   assigned   by   the   judge   prompt   when   evaluating   multiple   results .  Higher   scores   indicate   better   results

Fields.Name: WasSelectedResult
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   result   was   selected   as   the   best   result   when   multiple   models   were   run   in   parallel

Fields.Name: StreamingEnabled
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   streaming   was   enabled   for   this   prompt   execution

Fields.Name: FirstTokenTime
