Fields.Description: Time   in   milliseconds   from   request   initiation   to   receiving   the   first   token   from   the   model

Fields.Name: ErrorDetails
Fields.Description: Detailed   error   information   in   JSON   format   if   the   prompt   execution   failed ,  including   stack   traces   and   error   codes

Fields.Name: ChildPromptID
Fields.Description: References   the   specific   child   prompt   that   was   executed   as   part   of   hierarchical   prompt   composition .  NULL   for   regular   prompts   or   parent   prompts   that   don ' t   directly   execute   a   child .

Fields.Name: QueueTime
Fields.Description: Queue   time   in   milliseconds   before   the   model   started   processing   the   request .  Provider - specific   timing   metric .

Fields.Name: PromptTime
Fields.Description: Time   in   milliseconds   for   the   model   to   ingest   and   process   the   prompt .  Provider - specific   timing   metric .

Fields.Name: CompletionTime
Fields.Description: Time   in   milliseconds   for   the   model   to   generate   the   completion / response   tokens .  Provider - specific   timing   metric .

Fields.Name: ModelSpecificResponseDetails
Fields.Description: JSON   field   containing   provider - specific   response   metadata   and   details   not   captured   in   standard   fields .  Structure   varies   by   AI   provider .

Fields.Name: EffortLevel
Fields.Description: Effort   level   that   was   actually   used   during   this   prompt   run   execution  ( 1 - 100 ,  where   1 = minimal   effort ,  100 = maximum   effort ).  This   is   the   resolved   effort   level   after   applying   the   precedence   hierarchy :  runtime   override  >  agent   default  >  prompt   default  >  provider   default .

Fields.Name: RunName
Fields.Description: Optional   name   for   the   prompt   run   to   help   identify   and   tag   runs   for   easier   reference

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Human - readable   notes   and   comments   about   this   prompt   run

Fields.Name: TestRunID
Fields.Description: Optional   Foreign   Key  -  Links   this   prompt   run   to   a   test   run   if   this   prompt   execution   was   part   of   a   test .  Enables   testing   individual   prompts   for   quality   and   consistency   before   agent   integration .

Fields.Name: AssistantPrefill
Fields.Description: The   assistant   prefill   text   that   was   used   during   this   prompt   execution .  Records   whether   native   prefill   or   fallback   was   applied .  NULL   means   no   prefill   was   used .

Fields.Name: TokensCacheRead
Fields.Description: Number   of   input   tokens   served   from   the   AI   provider ' s   prompt   cache  ( a   cache   READ  /  hit )  for   this   run ,  as   reported   by   the   provider .  Counts   only ;  no   cost   is   derived   here .  NULL   if   the   provider   did   not   report   cache   reads   or   caching   did   not   engage .  Distinct   from   CacheHit / CacheKey ,  which   track   MemberJunction ' s   own   result   cache .

Fields.Name: TokensCacheWrite
Fields.Description: Number   of   input   tokens   written   to   the   AI   provider ' s   prompt   cache  ( a   cache   WRITE  /  creation )  for   this   run ,  as   reported   by   the   provider .  Populated   for   providers   that   report   cache   writes  ( e . g .  Anthropic   cache_creation_input_tokens );  NULL   or   0   for   providers   that   do   not   bill / report   writes  ( OpenAI ,  Gemini ,  Groq ,  Cerebras ).  Counts   only ;  no   cost   is   derived   here .

Fields.Name: TokensCacheReadRollup
Fields.Description: Rollup   of   TokensCacheRead   across   this   prompt   run   and   all   of   its   descendant   prompt   runs  ( e . g .  the   individual   attempts   behind   a   parallel  /  multi - attempt  /  failover   consolidation ).  For   a   leaf   run   this   equals   TokensCacheRead .  Use   this  ( not   TokensCacheRead )  when   aggregating   cache   reads   up   a   prompt - run   or   agent - run   hierarchy   so   fan - out   provider   calls   are   not   under - counted .

Fields.Name: TokensCacheWriteRollup
Fields.Description: Rollup   of   TokensCacheWrite   across   this   prompt   run   and   all   of   its   descendant   prompt   runs .  For   a   leaf   run   this   equals   TokensCacheWrite .  Mirrors   TokensUsedRollup / TokensPromptRollup ;  populated   for   providers   that   report   cache   writes  ( e . g .  Anthropic ),  otherwise   0   or   NULL .

Fields.Name: InputUnitsUsed
Fields.Description: Quantity   of   continuous   input   consumed   by   this   run ,  expressed   in   the   base   measure   named   by   UsageTypeID  ( e . g .  seconds   of   audio   submitted   for   transcription ).  NULL   for   token - billed   runs ,  which   use   the   Tokens *  columns   instead .

Fields.Name: OutputUnitsUsed
Fields.Description: Quantity   of   continuous   output   produced   by   this   run ,  expressed   in   the   base   measure   named   by   UsageTypeID  ( e . g .  seconds   of   audio   synthesized ,  or   images   generated ).  NULL   for   token - billed   runs .

Fields.Name: UsageTypeID
Fields.Description: The   base   measure   this   run ' s   quantities   are   counted   in .  Defaults   to   Tokens ,  where   the   Tokens *  columns   carry   the   quantity   and   the   units   columns   are   unused ;  a   continuous - media   run   sets   it   to   Seconds ,  Characters   or   Images   and   populates   InputUnitsUsed  /  OutputUnitsUsed .  Always   the   base   measure ,  never   the   billing   measure :  audio   billed   per   hour   is   still   recorded   as   Seconds ,  and   the   price   unit   type   converts .  NULL   means   token - billed ,  which   is   what   every   row   predating   this   column   is ;  it   is   read   as   Tokens   at   one   seam   in   MJAIPromptRunEntityServer ,  and   becomes   NOT   NULL   in   the   release   after   the   AI   Usage   Types   seed   ships .

Fields.Name: ToolCallingMode
Fields.Description: Which   tool - calling   path   this   run   actually   took . ' Native ' =  Actions   declared   as   tools ,  control   flow   in   the   JSON   envelope  ( the   hybrid ). ' NativeImplicit ' =  Actions ,  sub - agents ,  payload_change_request   and   ask_user   declared   as   tools ;  a   tool   call   continues   the   loop   and   plain   text   ends   the   turn . ' Envelope ' =  no   tools   declared  —  the   vendor - agnostic   JSON - envelope   path ,  including   a   prompt   that   asked   for   native   mode   on   a   model / vendor   without   the   capability  ( also   logs   a   warning ). ' NativeFallback ' =  a   native   attempt   failed   in   a   tools - specific   way   and   completed   via   a   single   envelope   retry .  NULL  =  pre - feature   rows   or   a   run   that   never   reached   a   model   call .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   user   on   whose   behalf   this   prompt   was   executed ,  written   when   the   run   is   created .  NULL   for   automated / unauthenticated   runs   and   for   runs   that   pre - date   this   column .  For   an   agent - driven   run   the   agent   run ' s   user   is   also   reachable   through   AIAgentRunStep . TargetLogID ,  which   vwAIUsageFacts   falls   back   to .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Types
entities.Description: Types   of   AI   prompts   such   as   Chat ,  Text - to - Image ,  Text - to - Video ,  etc .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompts
entities.Description: Stores   AI   prompts ,  including   references   to   categories ,  types ,  and   templates .

Fields.Name: TemplateID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   template   used   for   the   prompt .

Fields.Name: CategoryID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   category   the   prompt   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: TypeID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   type   of   the   prompt .

Fields.Name: ResponseFormat
Fields.Description: Specifies   the   expected   response   format   for   the   AI   model .  Options   include   Any ,  Text ,  Markdown ,  JSON ,  and   ModelSpecific .  Defaults   to   Any   if   not   specified .

Fields.Name: ModelSpecificResponseFormat
Fields.Description: A   JSON - formatted   string   containing   model - specific   response   format   instructions .  This   will   be   parsed   and   provided   as   a   JSON   object   to   the   model .

Fields.Name: AIModelTypeID
Fields.Description: References   the   type   of   AI   model   this   prompt   is   designed   for  ( LLM ,  Image ,  Audio ,  etc .).

Fields.Name: MinPowerRank
Fields.Description: The   minimum   power   rank   required   for   models   to   be   considered   for   this   prompt .

Fields.Name: SelectionStrategy
Fields.Description: Determines   how   models   are   selected   for   this   prompt  ( Default ,  Specific ,  ByPower ).

Fields.Name: PowerPreference
Fields.Description: When   using   ByPower   selection   strategy ,  determines   whether   to   prefer   highest ,  lowest ,  or   balanced   power   models .

Fields.Name: ParallelizationMode
Fields.Description: Controls   parallelization :  None  ( no   parallelization ),  StaticCount  ( use   AIPrompt . ParallelCount   for   total   runs ),  ConfigParam  ( use   config   param   specified   in   ParallelConfigParam   for   total   runs ),  or   ModelSpecific  ( check   each   AIPromptModel ' s   individual   settings ).

Fields.Name: ParallelCount
Fields.Description: When   ParallelizationMode   is   StaticCount ,  specifies   the   number   of   parallel   executions .

Fields.Name: ParallelConfigParam
Fields.Description: When   ParallelizationMode   is   ConfigParam ,  specifies   the   name   of   the   configuration   parameter   that   contains   the   parallel   count .

Fields.Name: OutputType
Fields.Description: The   expected   data   type   of   the   prompt   output :  string ,  number ,  boolean ,  date ,  or   object .

Fields.Name: OutputExample
Fields.Description: JSON   example   output   when   OutputType   is  " object ",  used   for   validating   structured   outputs .

Fields.Name: ValidationBehavior
Fields.Description: Determines   how   validation   failures   are   handled :  Strict  ( fail ),  Warn  ( log   warning ),  or   None  ( ignore ).

Fields.Name: MaxRetries
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   retry   attempts   for   API   failures .

Fields.Name: RetryDelayMS
Fields.Description: Delay   between   retry   attempts   in   milliseconds .

Fields.Name: RetryStrategy
Fields.Description: Strategy   for   calculating   retry   delays :  Fixed  ( same   delay   each   time ),  Exponential  ( doubling   delay ),  or   Linear  ( linearly   increasing   delay ).

Fields.Name: ResultSelectorPromptID
Fields.Description: References   another   prompt   that   selects   the   best   result   from   multiple   parallel   executions .

Fields.Name: EnableCaching
Fields.Description: When   true ,  results   from   this   prompt   will   be   cached   for   potential   reuse .

Fields.Name: CacheTTLSeconds
Fields.Description: Time - to - live   in   seconds   for   cached   results .  NULL   means   results   never   expire .

Fields.Name: CacheMatchType
Fields.Description: Method   for   matching   cached   results :  Exact  ( string   matching )  or   Vector  ( embedding   similarity ).

Fields.Name: CacheSimilarityThreshold
Fields.Description: Threshold  ( 0 - 1 )  for   vector   similarity   matching .  Higher   values   require   closer   matches .

Fields.Name: CacheMustMatchModel
Fields.Description: When   true ,  the   AI   model   must   match   for   a   cache   hit .  When   false ,  results   from   any   model   can   be   used .

Fields.Name: CacheMustMatchVendor
Fields.Description: When   true ,  the   vendor   must   match   for   a   cache   hit .  When   false ,  results   from   any   vendor   can   be   used .

Fields.Name: CacheMustMatchAgent
Fields.Description: When   true ,  the   agent   context   must   match   for   a   cache   hit .  When   false ,  agent - specific   and   non - agent   results   can   be   used   interchangeably .

Fields.Name: CacheMustMatchConfig
Fields.Description: When   true ,  the   configuration   must   match   for   a   cache   hit .  When   false ,  results   from   any   configuration   can   be   used .

Fields.Name: PromptRole
Fields.Description: Determines   how   the   prompt   is   used   in   conversation :  System  ( always   first   message ),  User  ( positioned   by   PromptPosition ),  Assistant  ( positioned   by   PromptPosition ),  or   SystemOrUser  ( try   system   first ,  fallback   to   user   last   if   system   slot   taken )

Fields.Name: PromptPosition
Fields.Description: Controls   message   placement   for   User   and   Assistant   role   prompts :  First  ( beginning   of   conversation )  or   Last  ( end   of   conversation ).  Not   used   for   System   role   prompts   which   are   always   first

Fields.Name: Temperature
Fields.Description: Default   temperature   setting   for   this   prompt .  Controls   randomness   in   the   output .  0  =  more   focused   and   deterministic ,  2  =  more   random   and   creative .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: TopP
Fields.Description: Default   TopP  ( nucleus   sampling )  for   this   prompt .  Only   consider   tokens   with   cumulative   probability   up   to   this   value .  1  =  consider   all   tokens .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: TopK
Fields.Description: Default   TopK   sampling   for   this   prompt .  Only   sample   from   the   top   K   tokens .  Lower   values   reduce   randomness .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: MinP
Fields.Description: Default   MinP  ( minimum   probability )  for   this   prompt .  Tokens   with   probability   below   this   threshold   are   filtered   out .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: FrequencyPenalty
Fields.Description: Default   frequency   penalty   for   this   prompt .  Penalizes   tokens   based   on   their   frequency   in   the   text .  Positive   values   decrease   likelihood   of   repetition .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: PresencePenalty
Fields.Description: Default   presence   penalty   for   this   prompt .  Penalizes   tokens   that   have   appeared   in   the   text .  Positive   values   increase   topic   diversity .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: Seed
Fields.Description: Default   random   seed   for   this   prompt .  Used   for   deterministic   generation .  Same   seed   produces   same   output .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: StopSequences
Fields.Description: Default   stop   sequences   for   this   prompt .  Comma - delimited   list   of   sequences   that   will   stop   generation   when   encountered .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: IncludeLogProbs
Fields.Description: Default   setting   for   including   log   probabilities   in   the   response .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: TopLogProbs
Fields.Description: Default   number   of   top   log   probabilities   to   include   when   IncludeLogProbs   is   true .  Can   be   overridden   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: FailoverStrategy
Fields.Description: Failover   strategy   to   use   when   the   primary   model   fails .  Options :  SameModelDifferentVendor ,  NextBestModel ,  PowerRank ,  None

Fields.Name: FailoverMaxAttempts
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   failover   attempts   before   giving   up

Fields.Name: FailoverDelaySeconds
Fields.Description: Initial   delay   in   seconds   between   failover   attempts

Fields.Name: FailoverModelStrategy
Fields.Description: Strategy   for   selecting   failover   models .  Options :  PreferSameModel ,  PreferDifferentModel ,  RequireSameModel

Fields.Name: FailoverErrorScope
Fields.Description: Types   of   errors   that   should   trigger   failover .  Options :  All ,  NetworkOnly ,  RateLimitOnly ,  ServiceErrorOnly

Fields.Name: EffortLevel
Fields.Description: Effort   level   for   this   specific   prompt  ( 1 - 100 ,  where   1 = minimal   effort ,  100 = maximum   effort ).  Higher   values   request   more   thorough   reasoning   and   analysis .  Can   be   overridden   by   agent   DefaultPromptEffortLevel   or   runtime   parameters .

Fields.Name: AssistantPrefill
Fields.Description: Optional   text   to   prefill   the   assistant   response .  The   model   will   continue   generating   from   where   this   text   ends .  Used   with   StopSequences   for   structured   output   extraction  ( e . g .,  prefill   with  ``` json   to   get   raw   JSON ).  Only   effective   with   providers   that   support   prefill   natively ;  see   PrefillFallbackMode   for   non - supporting   providers .

Fields.Name: PrefillFallbackMode
Fields.Description: Controls   behavior   when   the   selected   provider   does   not   support   native   assistant   prefill .  Ignore  =  silently   skip   prefill ,  SystemInstruction  =  inject   a   system   message   instructing   the   model   to   start   its   response   with   the   prefill   text  ( uses   fallback   text   from   AI   Model   Vendor   or   AI   Model   Type ),  None  =  no   fallback  ( prefill   only   works   with   supported   providers ).

Fields.Name: RequireSpecificModels
Fields.Description: Only   applies   when   SelectionStrategy   is   Specific .  When   0  ( default ),  if   none   of   the   explicitly   configured   AIPromptModel   entries   have   valid   API   credentials   the   system   automatically   falls   back   to   Default / ByPower   model   selection   across   all   active   models   matching   the   prompt   AIModelTypeID .  When   1 ,  the   system   will   hard - fail   with   an   error   instead   of   falling   back ,  ensuring   only   the   explicitly   configured   models   are   ever   used .

Fields.Name: PromptConfiguration
Fields.Description: Per - prompt   call - time   configuration   bag  ( JSON ,  IAIPromptConfiguration   shape :  LLM  /  Realtime  /  Vision  /  Audio   sections ).  Base   layer   of   the   prompt   Configuration   cascade  —  AIPromptModel   rows   inherit   from   it   per   key   and   may   override  —  and   itself   layered   on   top   of   the   resolved   AIModel / AIModelVendor   ModelConfiguration .  NULL  =  contributes   nothing .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   backend   name  ( e . g .  Self - Hosted   Chrome ,  Browserbase ,  Steel ,  Browserless ,  Hyperbrowser ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   human - readable   description   of   the   backend  /  driver .

Fields.Name: ProviderType
Fields.Description: How   the   browser   is   hosted :  SelfHost  ( MJ   orchestrates   a   lightweight   headless - Chrome   container   we   connect   to   over   CDP )  or   Service  ( a   browser - as - a - service   such   as   Browserbase / Steel / Browserless / Hyperbrowser   exposes   a   CDP   connect   endpoint ).

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Driver   key   resolved   at   runtime   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance ( BaseRemoteBrowserProvider ,  DriverClass ).  MUST   match   the  @ RegisterClass   key   on   the   concrete   provider   driver .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Whether   this   backend   is   available   for   use .  Disabled   backends   cannot   start   new   remote - browser   sessions .

Fields.Name: SupportedFeatures
Fields.Description: Strongly - typed   JSON   of   the   backend ' s   supported   features  ( the   IRemoteBrowserProviderFeatures   interface ,  bound   via   JSONType   metadata ):  the   universal   CDP - control   substrate  ( RawCdpControl ),  an   optional   provider - native   AI - control   harness  ( NativeAIControl ,  e . g .  Browserbase   Stagehand ),  LiveView ,  HumanTakeover ,  ScreenStreaming ,  and   operational   capabilities  ( Stealth ,  ProxyEgress ,  SessionRecording ,  PersistentContext ,  MultiTab ,  FileDownloads ,  CaptchaSolving ).  The   engine   gates   optional   driver   calls   on   these   flags ;  the   base   driver   throws   RemoteBrowserCapabilityNotSupportedError   when   a   feature   is   claimed   but   unimplemented .  Held   as   JSON   so   new   features   need   no   schema   change .  NULL / omitted  =  unsupported .

Fields.Name: DefaultControlMode
Fields.Description: Default   control   mode   for   channels   using   this   backend ,  overridable   per - channel   and   at   runtime :  AgentOnly  ( only   the   agent   drives  —  e . g .  a   sales   demo ),  ViewOnly  ( the   agent   drives   while   humans   watch   the   live   view   but   cannot   take   over ),  or   Collaborative  ( a   human   can   grab   the   wheel  —  e . g .  a   trainer   agent   that   demonstrates   then   watches   the   user   try ).  The   backend   must   support   the   capabilities   a   mode   requires  ( HumanTakeover   for   Collaborative ,  LiveView   for   ViewOnly / Collaborative ).

Fields.Name: ConfigSchema
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   Schema   validating   the   backend   Configuration   and   per - session   remote - browser   Config   payloads .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Backend - level   configuration   JSON  ( e . g .  API   region ,  default   Chrome   container   image   for   SelfHost ,  credential   references   resolved   via   the   MJ   credential   system ,  egress   proxy   settings ).  Never   store   secrets   inline .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Result   Cache
entities.Description: Stores   cached   results   of   AI   prompts ,  including   multiple   runs   for   history   and   tracking   purposes .

Fields.Name: AIPromptID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AI   prompt   this   result   corresponds   to .

Fields.Name: AIModelID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AI   model   that   generated   this   result .

Fields.Name: RunAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   this   result   was   generated .

Fields.Name: PromptText
Fields.Description: The   prompt   text   used   to   generate   this   result .

Fields.Name: ResultText
Fields.Description: The   text   of   the   result   generated   by   the   AI   model .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: The   status   of   this   result ,  indicating   whether   it   is   currently   active   or   expired .

Fields.Name: ExpiredOn
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   this   result   was   marked   as   expired .

Fields.Name: VendorID
Fields.Description: The   vendor   that   provided   this   result .

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: The   agent   that   initiated   the   request ,  if   any .

Fields.Name: ConfigurationID
Fields.Description: The   configuration   used   for   this   execution .

Fields.Name: PromptEmbedding
Fields.Description: Vector   representation   of   the   prompt   for   similarity   matching .

Fields.Name: PromptRunID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   AIPromptRun   that   created   this   cache   entry .

Fields.Name: SkillID
Fields.Description: Skill   that   bundles   this   action .

Fields.Name: ActionID
Fields.Description: Action   made   available   to   the   agent   while   the   skill   is   active .  Whether   and   how   often   the   model   invokes   it   is   governed   by   the   skill ' s   Instructions ,  not   by   a   hard   execution   count .

Fields.Name: ExposeToModel
Fields.Description: Whether   activating   the   skill   puts   this   action   into   the   agent ' s   run .  1  ( default ):  the   action   is   described   to   the   model   and   callable   during   the   run ,  today ' s   behaviour .  0 :  the   action   stays   bundled   with   the   skill  ( SKILL . md   export ,  tooling )  but   is   left   out   of   the   run   entirely :  not   described   to   the   model   and   not   executable   by   the   agent ;  only   application   code   invokes   it ,  through   the   Actions   API .  Use   0   for   actions   a   person   triggers   through   the   UI   on   a   later   turn ,  such   as   a   menu   button   in   the   skill ' s   reply .

Fields.Name: SkillID
Fields.Description: Skill   this   permission   grant   applies   to .

Fields.Name: RoleID
Fields.Description: Role   this   grant   is   for .  Mutually   exclusive   with   UserID  —  exactly   one   of   the   two   is   set   per   row .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: User   this   grant   is   for .  Mutually   exclusive   with   RoleID  —  exactly   one   of   the   two   is   set   per   row .

Fields.Name: CanView
Fields.Description: Grants   viewing   the   skill   in   catalogs / pickers .  Maps   to   the   normalized   Read   action .

Fields.Name: CanRun
Fields.Description: Grants   requesting / activating   the   skill   at   agent   runtime .  Maps   to   the   normalized   Execute   action .

Fields.Name: CanEdit
Fields.Description: Grants   editing   the   skill   definition   and   its   bundled   actions / sub - agents .  Maps   to   the   normalized   Update   action .

Fields.Name: CanDelete
Fields.Description: Grants   deleting   the   skill .  Maps   to   the   normalized   Delete   action .

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Optional   free - text   note   explaining   why   the   grant   exists .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Skill   Search   Scopes
entities.Description: Search   Scopes   an   AI   Skill   may   reach   when   activated ,  honoured   when   AISkill . SearchScopeAccess  = ' Assigned '.  Mirrors   AIAgentSearchScope :  Status   plus   an   optional   StartAt / EndAt   window   time - box   a   grant ,  and   Priority / IsDefault   pick   among   several .  An   empty   table   means   no   skill   grants   any   scope  -  the   pre - migration   behaviour .

Fields.Name: SkillID
Fields.Description: The   skill   this   grant   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: SearchScopeID
Fields.Description: The   Search   Scope   this   skill   may   reach .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Active   or   Inactive .  Inactive   rows   are   ignored   during   resolution .

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Optional   start   of   the   window   in   which   this   grant   is   honoured .  NULL  =  no   lower   bound .  Evaluated   against   the   current   time   on   every   resolution ,  so   a   window   opening   or   closing   needs   no   cache   invalidation .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: Optional   end   of   the   window   in   which   this   grant   is   honoured .  NULL  =  no   upper   bound .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Lower   numbers   win   when   several   granted   scopes   are   candidates   and   none   is   marked   IsDefault .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: When   set ,  this   scope   is   chosen   for   the   skill   ahead   of   Priority   ordering .

Fields.Name: SkillID
Fields.Description: Skill   that   bundles   this   sub - agent .

Fields.Name: SubAgentID
Fields.Description: Sub - agent   made   available   to   the   agent   while   the   skill   is   active .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Skill   name .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Short   description   shown   in   the   skill   catalog  ( used   for   progressive - disclosure   exposure   to   agents  —  name  +  description   only   are   injected   until   the   skill   is   activated ).

Fields.Name: Instructions
Fields.Description: Instruction   text   appended   to   an   accepting   agent ' s   system   prompt   when   the   skill   is   activated .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status .  Only   Active   skills   can   be   activated   by   agents .  Defaults   to   Active   so   a   freshly   authored   skill   is   usable   by   its   owner   immediately ;  set   to   Deprecated   to   retire   without   deleting .

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: Optional   grouping   category .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Optional   Font   Awesome   icon   class  ( e . g . " fa - solid   fa - wand - magic - sparkles ")  shown   for   this   skill   in   the  / skill   picker   and   skill   catalog .  When   null ,  the   UI   falls   back   to   a   derived   default .

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Optional   accent   color  ( hex   or   CSS   color   token )  for   this   skill ' s   chip / badge   in   the   composer   and   catalog   UI .  When   null ,  the   UI   falls   back   to   a   derived   default .

Fields.Name: CreatedByUserID
Fields.Description: User   who   authored   the   skill  ( owner ).  Authoring   is   open   to   self   by   default ;  sharing   requires   the   Can   Share   Skills   privilege .

Fields.Name: ActivationMode
Fields.Description: Controls   whether   this   skill   may   ever   be   self - activated   by   an   agent .  Auto :  the   skill   may   appear   in   accepting   agents '  prompt   catalogs   and   be   activated   mid - run   on   agent   judgment  —  but   only   for   agents   whose   own   SkillActivationMode   is   also   Auto  ( double   gate ).  RequestedOnly  ( default ):  the   skill   is   excluded   from   prompt   catalogs   entirely   and   can   only   be   activated   when   the   user   explicitly   requests   it   for   the   run  ( a  / skill   mention   flowing   through   ExecuteAgentParams . requestedSkillIDs ).  All   other   activation   gates  ( AcceptsSkills ,  skill   Status ,  per - agent   assignment ,  user   Run   permission )  apply   unchanged   in   both   modes .

Fields.Name: SearchScopeAccess
Fields.Description: Which   Search   Scopes   this   skill   may   reach   when   activated .  None  =  grants   no   retrieval   scope ;  Assigned  =  only   scopes   listed   in   AISkillSearchScope ;  All  =  any   active   scope .  NULL   behaves   as   None   so   existing   skills   are   unaffected .  Mirrors   AIAgent . SearchScopeAccess   so   a   skill   and   an   agent   are   interchangeable   principals   to   SearchScopePermissionResolver .

Fields.Name: ActivationScope
Fields.Description: How   long   an   activation   lasts .  Run  ( default ):  the   skill   is   active   for   the   run   that   activated   it   and   no   longer  —  a   one - shot   capability .  Conversation :  once   activated   in   a   run   that   belongs   to   a   conversation ,  the   skill   stays   active   for   that   conversation  ( an   MJ :  Conversation   Skills   row ,  Status   Active )  and   is   re - requested   at   the   start   of   every   later   root   run   there   until   ended  —  a   persona ,  or   a   mode   whose   menu   is   pressed   on   the   next   turn .  Subject   to   every   availability   gate   on   each   run ;  ActivationMode   still   decides   who   may   trigger   the   FIRST   activation .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Usage   Types
entities.Description: The   base   measure   a   quantity   of   AI   usage   is   expressed   in  —  Tokens ,  Seconds ,  Characters   or   Images .  Referenced   by   AIModelPriceUnitType  ( what   a   billing   unit   is   a   quantity   of ,  and   therefore   what   every   cost   row   priced   by   it   measures )  and   by   AIPromptRun  ( what   a   recorded   quantity   counts ).  Distinct   from   AIModelPriceUnitType   itself ,  which   names   the   BILLING   unit   and   its   scale :  audio   recorded   in   Seconds   may   be   billed   by   the   Per   Hour   unit   type .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   of   the   base   measure ,  e . g .  Tokens ,  Seconds ,  Characters ,  Images .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   explanation   of   what   the   measure   counts   and   how   it   is   recorded .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Vendor   Type   Definitions
entities.Description: Defines   the   possible   types   of   AI   vendors ,  such   as   Model   Developer   or   Inference   Provider .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   vendor   type .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   vendor   type .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Vendor   Types
entities.Description: Associates   vendors   with   their   types  ( Model   Developer ,  Inference   Provider )  and   tracks   the   status   of   each   role .

Fields.Name: Rank
Fields.Description: Determines   the   priority   rank   of   this   type   for   the   vendor .  Higher   values   indicate   higher   priority .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: The   current   status   of   this   vendor   type .  Values   include   Active ,  Inactive ,  Deprecated ,  and   Preview .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Vendors
entities.Description: Stores   information   about   AI   vendors   providing   models   and / or   inference   services .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   unique   name   of   the   vendor .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   vendor   and   their   AI   offerings .

Fields.Name: CredentialTypeID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   type   of   credential   this   vendor   expects  ( e . g .,  API   Key ,  GCP   Service   Account ,  Azure   Service   Principal ).  Used   for   type - based   default   credential   resolution   when   no   explicit   binding   exists ,  and   for   UI   guidance   when   creating   credentials .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Vendor   configuration   bag  ( JSON ,  IAIVendorConfiguration   shape ).  Its   ModelDefaults   key   is   an   IAIModelConfiguration   bag  ( LLM  /  Realtime  /  Vision  /  Audio   sections )  that   forms   the   default   model   configuration   for   every   model   this   vendor   serves :  the   vendor   layer   of   the   ModelConfiguration   cascade ,  above   AIModelType   and   AIModel   and   below   AIModelVendor ,  which   may   override   it   per   key .  NULL  =  contributes   nothing .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Application   Scopes
entities.Description: Defines   the   scope   ceiling   for   each   application   with   pattern - based   rules .  Controls   which   scopes   and   resource   patterns   an   application   can   use ,  regardless   of   what   API   keys   grant .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   application   this   ceiling   rule   applies   to .

Fields.Name: ScopeID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   scope   this   rule   applies   to .

Fields.Name: ResourcePattern
Fields.Description: Glob   pattern   for   matching   resources  ( e . g .,  Users , Accounts   or   Skip *  or  *).  NULL   means   match   all   resources .

Fields.Name: PatternType
Fields.Description: How   to   interpret   the   pattern :  Include  ( grant   if   matches )  or   Exclude  ( grant   if   does   NOT   match ).

Fields.Name: IsDeny
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   rule   explicitly   DENIES   access .  Deny   rules   trump   allow   rules   at   the   same   priority   level .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Rule   evaluation   order .  Higher   priority   rules   are   evaluated   first .  Within   same   priority ,  deny   rules   are   evaluated   before   allow   rules .

Fields.Name: RowFilterID
Fields.Description: Optional   row - level   filter   acting   as   a   CEILING   for   every   API   key   operating   under   this   application  —  a   restriction   keys   inherit   and   cannot   widen .  Composes   with   the   per - key   filter  ( APIKeyScope . RowFilterID )  and   with   role - based   RLS   using   AND ,  never   OR ,  so   no   layer   can   broaden   another .  References   the   same   RowLevelSecurityFilter   catalog   used   by   role - based   RLS .  NULL  ( the   default )  means   the   application   imposes   no   row   ceiling .  The   same   authoring   constraints   as   APIKeyScope . RowFilterID   apply :  exact   single - entity   resource   pattern ,  all   referenced   columns   must   exist   on   that   entity ,  and   all   referrers   of   the   filter   record   must   resolve   to   the   same   entity .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Applications
entities.Description: Registry   of   applications   that   can   consume   MemberJunction   APIs .  Each   application   defines   a   scope   ceiling   that   limits   what   API   keys   can   access   when   used   with   that   application .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   identifying   the   application  ( e . g .,  MJAPI ,  MCPServer ,  Portal ,  CLI ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   of   the   application   and   its   purpose .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   application   is   currently   active .  Inactive   applications   reject   all   API   key   authentication .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Key   Applications
entities.Description: Optional   binding   of   API   keys   to   specific   applications .  If   no   records   exist   for   a   key ,  it   works   with   all   applications .  If   records   exist ,  the   key   only   works   with   those   specific   applications .

Fields.Name: APIKeyID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   API   key   being   bound   to   an   application .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   application   this   key   is   authorized   to   use .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Key   Scopes
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   API   keys   to   their   assigned   permission   scopes .  Each   key   can   have   multiple   scopes ,  and   scopes   can   be   shared   across   multiple   keys .

Fields.Name: ResourcePattern
Fields.Description: Glob   pattern   for   matching   resources  ( e . g .,  Users , Accounts   or   Skip *  or  *).  NULL   means   match   all   resources   under   this   scope .

Fields.Name: PatternType
Fields.Description: How   to   interpret   the   pattern :  Include  ( grant   if   matches )  or   Exclude  ( grant   if   does   NOT   match ).

Fields.Name: IsDeny
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   rule   explicitly   DENIES   access .  Deny   rules   trump   allow   rules   at   the   same   priority   level .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Rule   evaluation   order .  Higher   priority   rules   are   evaluated   first .  Within   same   priority ,  deny   rules   are   evaluated   before   allow   rules .

Fields.Name: RowFilterID
Fields.Description: Optional   row - level   filter   narrowing   WHICH   RECORDS   this   scope   grant   applies   to ,  in   addition   to   the   resource   pattern   that   governs   which   entities .  References   the   same   RowLevelSecurityFilter   catalog   used   by   role - based   RLS ,  so   the   filter   text   flows   through   the   standard  {{ Token }}  substitution   engine   and   every   existing   RLS   enforcement   point  ( RunView ,  Load   by   primary   key ,  save ,  delete ,  search ).  NULL  ( the   default )  means   no   row   restriction  —  behavior   identical   to   before   this   column   existed .  When   set ,  the   rule ' s   ResourcePattern   must   name   a   single   exact   entity  ( no   wildcards ,  no   comma - separated   lists ),  every   column   the   filter   references   must   resolve   to   a   real   non - virtual   field   on   that   entity ,  and   every   other   referrer   of   the   same   filter   record   must   resolve   to   that   same   entity .  Critically ,  this   filter   is   evaluated   INDEPENDENTLY   of   the   role - RLS   exemption :  a   user   exempt   from   role   RLS   is   still   bound   by   their   key ' s   filter ,  because   narrowing   a   principal   below   what   their   roles   allow   is   the   entire   purpose   of   a   key   ceiling .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Key   Usage   Logs
entities.Description: Audit   log   tracking   all   API   key   usage   for   analytics ,  debugging ,  and   security   monitoring .  Records   each   request   including   endpoint ,  response   status ,  timing ,  and   client   information .

Fields.Name: Endpoint
Fields.Description: The   API   endpoint   path   that   was   accessed  ( e . g ., / mcp , / graphql , / api / v1 / entities ).

Fields.Name: Operation
Fields.Description: The   specific   operation   performed ,  such   as   the   GraphQL   operation   name   or   MCP   tool   invoked  ( e . g .,  Get_Users_Record ,  Run_Agent ).

Fields.Name: Method
Fields.Description: HTTP   method   used   for   the   request  ( GET ,  POST ,  PUT ,  DELETE ,  etc .).

Fields.Name: StatusCode
Fields.Description: HTTP   response   status   code   returned   to   the   client  ( e . g .,  200   for   success ,  401   for   unauthorized ,  500   for   server   error ).

Fields.Name: ResponseTimeMs
Fields.Description: Total   time   in   milliseconds   to   process   the   request   and   return   a   response .  Useful   for   performance   monitoring .

Fields.Name: IPAddress
Fields.Description: Client   IP   address   that   made   the   request .  Supports   both   IPv4   and   IPv6   addresses  ( up   to   45   characters ).

Fields.Name: UserAgent
Fields.Description: User - Agent   header   from   the   HTTP   request ,  identifying   the   client   application   or   library   making   the   API   call .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: The   application   through   which   this   request   was   made  ( MJAPI ,  MCPServer ,  etc .).

Fields.Name: RequestedResource
Fields.Description: The   specific   resource   that   was   requested  ( e . g .,  entity   name ,  agent   name ,  query   name ).

Fields.Name: ScopesEvaluated
Fields.Description: JSON   array   containing   detailed   evaluation   of   each   scope   rule   checked   during   authorization .

Fields.Name: AuthorizationResult
Fields.Description: Final   authorization   result :  Allowed ,  Denied ,  or   NoScopesRequired  ( for   operations   that   do   not   require   scope   checks ).

Fields.Name: DeniedReason
Fields.Description: When   authorization   is   denied ,  explains   why  ( e . g .,  app   ceiling   blocked ,  no   matching   key   scope ,  explicit   deny   rule ).

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Keys
entities.Description: Stores   API   keys   for   programmatic   access   to   MemberJunction   services .  Keys   are   stored   as   SHA - 256   hashes   for   security .  Each   key   is   associated   with   a   user   context   and   can   have   multiple   permission   scopes   assigned .

Fields.Name: Hash
Fields.Description: SHA - 256   hash   of   the   raw   API   key  ( 64   hexadecimal   characters ).  The   raw   key   is   only   shown   once   at   creation   time   and   cannot   be   recovered .

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: User - friendly   name   for   identifying   the   key   purpose  ( e . g .,  Cowork   Integration ,  CI / CD   Pipeline ,  Mobile   App ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   detailed   description   of   the   key ' s   intended   use ,  integration   details ,  or   other   notes .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   lifecycle   status   of   the   key .  Active   keys   can   be   used   for   authentication ;  Revoked   keys   are   permanently   disabled .

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Optional   expiration   timestamp .  Keys   with   NULL   expiration   never   expire .  Expired   keys   are   rejected   during   authentication .

Fields.Name: LastUsedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   most   recent   successful   authentication   using   this   key .  Updated   on   each   valid   API   request .

Fields.Name: KeyPrefix
Fields.Description: A   short   preview   of   the   key   shown   at   creation   time  ( e . g .  mj_sk_a1b2 ).  Stores   the   configured   prefix   plus   the   first   4   characters   of   the   random   body   for   visual   identification .  NULL   for   keys   created   before   this   column   was   added .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Scopes
entities.Description: Defines   reusable   permission   scopes   that   can   be   assigned   to   API   keys .  Scopes   follow   a   hierarchical   naming   convention  ( e . g .,  entities : read ,  agents : execute ,  admin :*)  and   are   grouped   by   category   for   organizational   purposes .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   scope   identifier   following   the   pattern   category : permission  ( e . g .,  entities : read ,  agents : execute ,  admin :*).  Supports   wildcard  (*)  for   broad   permissions .

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: Grouping   category   for   the   scope  ( e . g .,  Entities ,  Agents ,  Admin ).  Used   for   organizing   and   filtering   scopes   in   the   UI .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   explaining   what   permissions   this   scope   grants .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   parent   scope   for   hierarchical   organization .  NULL   indicates   a   root - level   scope .

Fields.Name: FullPath
Fields.Description: Full   hierarchical   path   of   the   scope  ( e . g .,  entity : runview ,  agent : execute ).  Used   for   matching   during   authorization .

Fields.Name: ResourceType
Fields.Description: Type   of   resource   this   scope   applies   to  ( Entity ,  Agent ,  Query ,  Mutation ,  or   NULL   for   abstract   grouping   scopes ).

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   scope   is   currently   active .  Inactive   scopes   are   ignored   during   authorization .

Fields.Name: UIConfig
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   UI   presentation .  Schema : { " icon ": " fa - solid   fa - xxx ", " color ": "# hexcolor " }.  Icon   should   be   a   Font   Awesome   class .  Color   should   be   a   hex   color   code .

entities.Name: MJ :  Access   Control   Rules
entities.Description: Generic   ACL - style   permission   system   that   can   control   access   to   any   entity   record   in   the   system   with   granular   CRUD   permissions .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   value ( s )  of   the   record   being   protected  -  scalar   for   simple   PKs   or   JSON   for   composite   PKs

Fields.Name: GranteeType
Fields.Description: Type   of   grantee   receiving   permission  ( User ,  Role ,  Everyone ,  Public ). " Everyone "  means   all   authenticated   users   whereas  " Public "  means   any   authenticated   OR   anonymous   user .

Fields.Name: CanRead
Fields.Description: Permission   to   read / view   the   record

Fields.Name: CanCreate
Fields.Description: Permission   to   create   new   related   records

Fields.Name: CanUpdate
Fields.Description: Permission   to   update / modify   the   record

Fields.Name: CanDelete
Fields.Description: Permission   to   delete   the   record

Fields.Name: CanShare
Fields.Description: Permission   to   share / grant   permissions   to   other   users

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Optional   expiration   date / time   for   this   access   rule

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Authorizations
entities.Description: Links   actions   to   authorizations ,  one   or   more   of   these   must   be   possessed   by   a   user   in   order   to   execute   the   action .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Categories
entities.Description: Organizes   actions   into   categories ,  including   name ,  description ,  and   optional   parent   category   for   hierarchy .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   action   category .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   the   action   category .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   action   category  ( Pending ,  Active ,  Disabled ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Context   Types
entities.Description: Lists   possible   contexts   for   action   execution   with   optional   descriptions .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   context   type .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   the   context   type .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Contexts
entities.Description: Links   actions   to   their   supported   context   types   enabling   a   given   action   to   be   executable   in   more   than   one   context .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   action   context  ( Pending ,  Active ,  Disabled ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Execution   Logs
entities.Description: Tracks   every   execution   of   an   action ,  including   start   and   end   times ,  inputs ,  outputs ,  and   result   codes .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   action   execution   started  ( timezone - aware )

Fields.Name: EndedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   action   execution   ended  ( timezone - aware )

Fields.Name: Params
Fields.Description: JSON - formatted   input   parameters   AS   THE   ACTION   WAS   CALLED ,  captured   once   when   execution   starts   and   never   overwritten .  Custom   and   Generated   actions   mutate   their   parameter   array   in   place ,  so   this   is   the   only   durable   record   of   the   values   actually   passed   in ;  the   final   state   lives   in   ResultParams .  Parameter   values   may   be   redacted   per   ActionParam . LogValue  /  EntityActionParam . LogValue ,  and   whole - record   value   types   are   never   written  -  see   the   parameter ' s   own   documentation .

Fields.Name: ResultCode
Fields.Description: The   outcome   code   returned   by   the   action   execution ,  indicating   success ,  failure ,  or   specific   error   conditions   as   defined   in   Action   Result   Codes .

Fields.Name: RetentionPeriod
Fields.Description: Number   of   days   to   retain   the   log ;  NULL   for   indefinite   retention .

Fields.Name: Message
Fields.Description: Human - readable   summary   message   returned   by   the   action  -  the   reason   for   a   refusal ,  or   a   short   description   of   what   was   done .  Not   the   action ' s   output   data :  parameter   values   live   in   Params   and   ResultParams ,  and   the   outcome   code   in   ResultCode .

Fields.Name: EntityActionID
Fields.Description: Optional .  The   Entity   Action   binding   that   caused   this   run .  NULL   when   the   action   was   invoked   directly  -  from   a   resolver ,  a   script ,  an   agent   step   or   a   scheduled   action .

Fields.Name: EntityActionInvocationTypeID
Fields.Description: Optional .  Which   lifecycle   event   fired   the   binding  -  AfterUpdate ,  Validate ,  List   and   so   on .  Recorded   separately   from   EntityActionID   because   one   binding   may   be   attached   to   several   invocation   types ,  and   telling   a   Validate   refusal   apart   from   an   AfterUpdate   side   effect   is   the   first   question   anyone   asks   of   this   log .

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: Optional .  The   entity   of   the   record   this   run   operated   on .  Deliberately   denormalized   rather   than   joined   through   EntityActionID :  it   survives   the   binding   being   deleted   or   retargeted ,  and   it   lets   the   log   be   queried   by   record   with   no   join .  Kept   generic   because   every   invoker   has   a   subject  -  not   only   Entity   Actions .

Fields.Name: TargetRecordID
Fields.Description: Optional .  The   primary   key   of   the   record   this   run   operated   on ,  as   text ,  paired   with   TargetEntityID .  For   multi - record   invocation   types  ( List ,  View )  one   log   row   is   written   per   record ,  so   this   is   always   a   single   record .

Fields.Name: ResultParams
Fields.Description: JSON - formatted   FINAL   parameter   set   captured   when   the   action   finished  -  the   inputs   as   the   action   left   them ,  plus   any   output   parameters   it   produced .  Written   on   FAILURE   exactly   as   on   success ,  under   the   same   redaction   rules :  a   failed   run ' s   partially - mutated   inputs   are   usually   the   most   diagnostic   thing   available ,  and   an   audit   trail   that   records   only   successes   is   not   an   audit   trail .  Distinct   from   Params ,  which   holds   the   values   the   action   was   called   with   and   is   never   overwritten .  NULL   means   one   thing   only  -  the   run   never   finished  ( process   died ,  host   killed ) -  so   it   is   a   signal   rather   than   an   absence ,  and   must   not   be   backfilled .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Filters
entities.Description: Defines   filters   that   can   be   evaluated   ahead   of   executing   an   action .  Action   Filters   are   usable   in   any   code   pipeline   you   can   execute   them   with   the   same   context   as   the   action   itself   and   use   the   outcome   to   determine   if   the   action   should   execute   or   not .

Fields.Name: UserDescription
Fields.Description: Human - readable   explanation   of   what   this   filter   checks   and   when   it   should   prevent   action   execution ,  written   for   non - technical   users .

Fields.Name: UserComments
Fields.Description: Additional   notes   or   implementation   details   about   the   filter   logic ,  including   examples   or   edge   cases   to   consider .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: JavaScript   code   that   evaluates   to   true  ( allow   action )  or   false  ( prevent   action ),  executed   in   the   same   context   as   the   action .

Fields.Name: CodeExplanation
Fields.Description: Technical   documentation   of   the   filter   code   logic ,  including   expected   inputs ,  outputs ,  and   any   dependencies   or   assumptions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Libraries
entities.Description: Tracks   the   list   of   libraries   that   a   given   Action   uses ,  including   a   list   of   classes / functions   for   each   library .

Fields.Name: ItemsUsed
Fields.Description: List   of   classes   and   functions   used   by   the   action   from   the   library .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Params
entities.Description: Tracks   the   input   and   output   parameters   for   Actions .

Fields.Name: DefaultValue
Fields.Description: The   default   value   for   this   parameter   if   not   provided   during   action   execution ,  can   be   a   literal   value   or   JSON   for   complex   types .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Specifies   whether   this   parameter   is   used   for   Input ,  Output ,  or   Both   directions   in   the   action   execution   flow .

Fields.Name: ValueType
Fields.Description: Tracks   the   basic   value   type   of   the   parameter ,  additional   information   can   be   provided   in   the   Description   field

Fields.Name: IsArray
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   parameter   accepts   or   returns   an   array   of   values   rather   than   a   single   value .

Fields.Name: IsRequired
Fields.Description: Determines   if   this   parameter   must   be   provided   for   input   parameters   or   will   always   be   populated   for   output   parameters .

Fields.Name: MediaModality
Fields.Description: Specifies   the   type   of   media   this   parameter   outputs   when   ValueType   is   MediaOutput .  Used   for   action   discovery   and   validation .

Fields.Name: LogValue
Fields.Description: Whether   this   parameter ' s   VALUE   may   be   written   to   ActionExecutionLog . Params .  Default   1 .  Set   to   0   for   parameters   that   carry   records ,  credentials   or   personal   data  -  for   example   the   Data   payload   of   Execute   Agent .  Independent   of   the   hard   rule   that   Entity   Action   params   of   ValueType  ' Entity   Object '  or  ' Entity   Object   Data '  are   never   logged   regardless   of   this   flag .  When   logging   is   suppressed   the   log   records   the   parameter   name ,  its   type   and   a   redaction   marker ,  never   the   value .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Result   Codes
entities.Description: Defines   the   possible   result   codes   for   each   action .

Fields.Name: ResultCode
Fields.Description: The   unique   code   string   returned   by   the   action   to   indicate   specific   outcomes ,  used   for   programmatic   handling   of   results .

Fields.Name: IsSuccess
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   the   result   code   is   a   success   or   not .  It   is   possible   an   action   might   have   more   than   one   failure   condition / result   code   and   same   for   success   conditions .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   the   result   code .

entities.Name: MJ :  Actions
entities.Description: Stores   action   definitions ,  including   prompts ,  generated   code ,  user   comments ,  and   status .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   action .  Must   be   unique   within   the   combination   of   CategoryID   and   ParentID .  Actions   with   the   same   name   can   exist   in   different   categories   or   under   different   parents .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Generated   or   Custom .  Generated   means   the   UserPrompt   is   used   to   prompt   an   AI   model   to   automatically   create   the   code   for   the   Action .  Custom   means   that   a   custom   class   has   been   implemented   that   subclasses   the   BaseAction   class .  The   custom   class   needs   to   use   the  @ RegisterClass   decorator   and   be   included   in   the   MJAPI  ( or   other   runtime   environment )  to   be   available   for   execution .

Fields.Name: UserPrompt
Fields.Description: The   natural   language   prompt   provided   by   the   user   describing   what   the   action   should   accomplish ,  used   for   AI   code   generation .

Fields.Name: UserComments
Fields.Description: User ' s   comments   not   shared   with   the   LLM .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: The   generated   or   manually   written   code   that   implements   the   action   logic ,  typically   TypeScript / JavaScript   that   will   be   executed .

Fields.Name: CodeComments
Fields.Description: AI ' s   explanation   of   the   code .

Fields.Name: CodeApprovalStatus
Fields.Description: An   action   won ' t   be   usable   until   the   code   is   approved .

Fields.Name: CodeApprovalComments
Fields.Description: Optional   comments   when   an   individual  ( or   an   AI )  reviews   and   approves   the   code .

Fields.Name: CodeApprovedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   code   was   approved .

Fields.Name: CodeLocked
Fields.Description: If   set   to   1 ,  Code   will   never   be   generated   by   the   AI   system .  This   overrides   all   other   settings   including   the   ForceCodeGeneration   bit

Fields.Name: ForceCodeGeneration
Fields.Description: If   set   to   1 ,  the   Action   will   generate   code   for   the   provided   UserPrompt   on   the   next   Save   even   if   the   UserPrompt   hasn ' t   changed .  This   is   useful   to   force   regeneration   when   other   candidates  ( such   as   a   change   in   Action   Inputs / Outputs )  occurs   or   on   demand   by   a   user .

Fields.Name: RetentionPeriod
Fields.Description: Number   of   days   to   retain   execution   logs ;  NULL   for   indefinite .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   action  ( Pending ,  Active ,  Disabled ).

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: For   actions   where   Type =' Custom ',  this   specifies   the   fully   qualified   class   name   of   the   BaseAction   sub - class   that   should   be   instantiated   to   handle   the   action   execution .  This   provides   a   more   reliable   mechanism   than   relying   on   the   Name   field   for   class   instantiation .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Optional   ID   of   the   parent   action   this   action   inherits   from .  Used   for   hierarchical   action   composition   where   child   actions   can   specialize   parent   actions .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class  ( e . g .,  fa - cog ,  fa - play ,  fa - search )  for   visual   representation   of   the   action .

Fields.Name: DefaultCompactPromptID
Fields.Description: Default   prompt   for   compacting / summarizing   this   action ' s   results   when   used   by   agents   with   CompactMode = AISummary .  Action   designers   define   how   their   specific   results   should   be   summarized .  Can   be   overridden   per   agent   in   AIAgentAction . CompactPromptID .

Fields.Name: Config
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   configuration   for   the   action .  For   integration   actions ,  contains   routing   info :  integrationName ,  objectName ,  verb ,  and   optional   connectorConfig .  Non - integration   actions   leave   this   NULL .

Fields.Name: RuntimeActionConfiguration
Fields.Description: JSON   blob   holding   configuration   specific   to   Type =' Runtime '  actions :  declarative   permission   scopes  ( allowedEntities ,  allowedActions ,  allowedAgents   with   id + name   pairs ),  resource   limits  ( maxMemoryMB ,  maxBridgeCalls ),  and   sandbox   options  ( additionalLibraries ,  debugMode ).  Evolvable  —  new   keys   can   be   introduced   without   schema   changes .  NULL   for   non - Runtime   actions .

Fields.Name: MaxExecutionTimeMS
Fields.Description: Universal   maximum   execution   time   in   milliseconds   for   a   single   action   invocation .  Enforced   by   ActionEngine   across   ALL   action   types  ( Custom ,  Generated ,  Runtime )  via   AbortSignal   passed   through   RunActionParams .  NULL   means   use   the   engine   default .

Fields.Name: CreatedByAgentID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   AI   Agent   that   authored   this   action  —  populated   when   an   agent  ( e . g .  ActionSmith )  dynamically   generates   a   Runtime   action .  NULL   for   human - authored   Custom / Generated   actions .  Provides   an   audit   trail   linking   agent - generated   capabilities   back   to   their   creator .

entities.Name: MJ :  Application   Entities
entities.Description: List   of   entities   within   each   application .  An   application   can   have   any   number   of   entities   and   an   entity   can   be   part   of   any   number   of   applications .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   of   this   entity   within   the   application ,  lower   numbers   appear   first   in   navigation   and   menus .

Fields.Name: DefaultForNewUser
Fields.Description: When   set   to   1 ,  the   entity   will   be   included   by   default   for   a   new   user   when   they   first   access   the   application   in   question

entities.Name: MJ :  Application   Roles
entities.Description: Controls   which   roles   can   access   and   administer   specific   applications .  When   no   ApplicationRole   records   exist   for   an   application ,  all   roles   can   access   it  ( open   access ).  When   at   least   one   record   exists ,  only   roles   with   CanAccess = 1   are   permitted .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Application   this   role   grant   applies   to

Fields.Name: RoleID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Role   being   granted   or   denied   access

Fields.Name: CanAccess
Fields.Description: When   true ,  users   in   this   role   can   access   the   application .  When   false ,  this   record   acts   as   an   explicit   deny   for   the   role .

Fields.Name: CanAdmin
Fields.Description: When   true ,  users   in   this   role   can   modify   application   settings ,  manage   nav   items ,  and   configure   the   application .

entities.Name: MJ :  Application   Settings
entities.Description: Stores   configuration   settings   and   preferences   for   applications ,  including   key - value   pairs   for   runtime   parameters   and   user - specific   customizations .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Application .  When   NULL   the   row   is   a   GLOBAL   setting   that   applies   across   all   applications ;  when   set ,  the   setting   is   scoped   to   that   single   application .  Resolution   should   prefer   an   app - scoped   row   over   the   global   fallback   for   the   same   Name .

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: The   setting   value ,  can   be   simple   text ,  numbers ,  booleans ,  or   JSON   for   complex   configuration   objects .

entities.Name: MJ :  Applications
entities.Description: Applications   are   used   to   group   entities   in   the   user   interface   for   ease   of   user   access

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: Specify   the   CSS   class   information   for   the   display   icon   for   each   application .

Fields.Name: DefaultForNewUser
Fields.Description: If   turned   on ,  when   a   new   user   first   uses   the   MJ   Explorer   app ,  the   application   records   with   this   turned   on   will   have   this   application   included   in   their   selected   application   list .

Fields.Name: SchemaAutoAddNewEntities
Fields.Description: Comma - delimited   list   of   schema   names   where   entities   will   be   automatically   added   to   the   application   when   created   in   those   schemas

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Hex   color   code   for   visual   theming  ( e . g ., # 4caf50 )

Fields.Name: DefaultNavItems
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   default   navigation   items   for   this   application .  Parsed   by   BaseApplication . GetNavItems ()

Fields.Name: ClassName
Fields.Description: TypeScript   class   name   for   ClassFactory   registration  ( e . g .,  CRMApplication )

Fields.Name: DefaultSequence
Fields.Description: Default   sequence   position   when   adding   this   application   to   a   new   user ' s   User   Applications .  Lower   values   appear   first .  Used   when   DefaultForNewUser   is   true .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Application   lifecycle   status .  Pending  =  not   yet   ready ,  Active  =  available   for   use ,  Disabled  =  temporarily   unavailable ,  Deprecated  =  being   phased   out .  Only   Active   applications   are   shown   to   users .

Fields.Name: NavigationStyle
Fields.Description: How   the   application   appears   in   navigation .  App   Switcher  =  only   in   dropdown   menu ,  Nav   Bar  =  permanent   icon   in   top   nav ,  Both  =  shown   in   both   locations .

Fields.Name: TopNavLocation
Fields.Description: Position   of   the   permanent   nav   icon   when   NavigationStyle   is   Nav   Bar   or   Both .  Left   of   App   Switcher  =  appears   before   the   app   switcher ,  Left   of   User   Menu  =  appears   near   the   user   avatar .  Ignored   when   NavigationStyle   is   App   Switcher .

Fields.Name: HideNavBarIconWhenActive
Fields.Description: When   true ,  the   Nav   Bar   icon   for   this   application   is   hidden   when   the   application   is   active .  Useful   for   launcher - style   apps   like   Home   that   should   only   be   visible   when   the   user   is   NOT   in   that   app .  Only   applies   when   NavigationStyle   is   Nav   Bar   or   Both .

Fields.Name: Path
Fields.Description: URL - friendly   slug   for   the   application  ( e . g ., " data - explorer "  for  " Data   Explorer ").  Used   in   URLs   instead   of   the   full   Name .  Auto - generated   from   Name   when   AutoUpdatePath   is   true .  Must   be   unique   across   all   applications .

Fields.Name: AutoUpdatePath
Fields.Description: When   true ,  Path   is   automatically   generated   from   Name   on   save .  Set   to   false   to   manually   control   the   Path   value .  Defaults   to   true   for   new   applications .

Fields.Name: AgentSettings
Fields.Description: App - scoped   agent   configuration   JSON  ( shape  =  IAgentSettings ).  Declares   the   default / lead   agent ,  relevant   agents   available   to   conversational   and   realtime   co - agents ,  app - scoped   client   tool   references ,  and   realtime   persona / disclosure   overrides   that   layer   into   the   agent   config   cascade .  Null  =  no   app - level   agent   config .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Configuration   Entities
entities.Description: Per - entity   configuration   within   an   archive   pipeline .  Allows   overriding   the   parent   configuration ' s   defaults   for   mode ,  retention ,  batch   size ,  and   filtering   on   a   per - entity   basis .

Fields.Name: ArchiveConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   parent   ArchiveConfiguration .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Entity   being   archived .

Fields.Name: Mode
Fields.Description: Archive   mode   override   for   this   entity .  NULL   inherits   from   the   parent   configuration ' s   DefaultMode .

Fields.Name: RetentionDays
Fields.Description: Retention   period   override   in   days .  NULL   inherits   from   the   parent   configuration ' s   DefaultRetentionDays .

Fields.Name: DateField
Fields.Description: The   date   field   on   the   entity   used   to   determine   record   age   for   retention   policy   evaluation .  Defaults   to   __mj_CreatedAt .

Fields.Name: FilterExpression
Fields.Description: Optional   SQL   WHERE   clause   fragment   to   further   filter   which   records   are   eligible   for   archiving  ( e . g ., " Status  = ' Closed '").

Fields.Name: BatchSize
Fields.Description: Batch   size   override   for   this   entity .  NULL   inherits   from   the   parent   configuration ' s   DefaultBatchSize .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Processing   priority  —  lower   numbers   are   archived   first .  Default   is   100 .

Fields.Name: FieldConfiguration
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   specifying   which   fields   to   include / exclude   in   the   archive   output .  Required   for   all   modes .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Optional   fully - qualified   class   name   of   a   custom   archive   driver   to   use   for   this   entity ,  overriding   the   default   archiver .

Fields.Name: ArchiveRelatedRecordChanges
Fields.Description: Override   for   archiving   related   Record   Changes .  NULL   inherits   from   the   parent   configuration .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   entity   is   active   within   the   archive   configuration .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Configurations
entities.Description: Top - level   configuration   for   an   archive   pipeline .  Defines   the   storage   target ,  default   retention   policy ,  archive   format ,  and   operational   mode   for   archiving   entity   records .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   for   this   archive   configuration .

Fields.Name: StorageAccountID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   FileStorageAccount  —  the   blob / file   storage   target   for   archived   data .

Fields.Name: RootPath
Fields.Description: Root   path   within   the   storage   account   where   archive   files   are   written  ( e . g ., " archives / production /").

Fields.Name: ArchiveFormat
Fields.Description: Output   format   for   archived   records :  JSON ,  Parquet ,  or   CSV .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   configuration   is   active   and   eligible   for   scheduled   archive   runs .

Fields.Name: DefaultRetentionDays
Fields.Description: Default   number   of   days   after   which   records   become   eligible   for   archiving .  Can   be   overridden   per   entity .

Fields.Name: DefaultMode
Fields.Description: Default   archive   mode :  StripFields  ( null   out   specified   fields ),  HardDelete  ( delete   from   source   after   archiving ),  ArchiveOnly  ( copy   to   storage   without   modifying   source ).

Fields.Name: DefaultBatchSize
Fields.Description: Default   number   of   records   to   process   per   batch   during   archive   runs .

Fields.Name: ArchiveRelatedRecordChanges
Fields.Description: When   enabled ,  related   Record   Changes   entries   are   also   archived   alongside   the   source   records .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   operational   status   of   this   configuration :  Idle ,  Running ,  Error ,  or   Disabled .

Fields.Name: CreatedByUserID
Fields.Description: The   user   who   created   this   archive   configuration .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Run   Details
entities.Description: Per - record   detail   for   each   archive   run .  Tracks   the   outcome ,  storage   location ,  and   error   information   for   each   individual   record   processed .

Fields.Name: ArchiveRunID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   parent   ArchiveRun .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Entity   this   record   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   primary   key   value   of   the   archived   record  ( string   representation   to   support   all   key   types ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Outcome   for   this   record :  Success ,  Failed ,  or   Skipped .

Fields.Name: StoragePath
Fields.Description: Full   path   to   the   archived   file   in   storage  ( e . g ., " archives / production / Users / 2026 / 04 / record - id . json ").

Fields.Name: BytesArchived
Fields.Description: Number   of   bytes   written   to   storage   for   this   record .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   details   when   Status   is   Failed .

Fields.Name: ArchivedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   record   was   successfully   archived .

Fields.Name: VersionStamp
Fields.Description: The   __mj_UpdatedAt   timestamp   of   the   record   at   the   time   of   archiving ,  used   for   conflict   detection   during   restore .

Fields.Name: IsRecordChangeArchive
Fields.Description: When   true ,  this   detail   row   represents   an   archived   Record   Change   entry   rather   than   a   primary   entity   record .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   each   execution   of   an   archive   configuration ,  including   timing ,  aggregate   statistics ,  and   overall   status .

Fields.Name: ArchiveConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   ArchiveConfiguration   that   was   executed .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   archive   run   started .

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   archive   run   completed  ( NULL   while   still   running ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status :  Running ,  Complete ,  Failed ,  Cancelled ,  or   PartialSuccess .

Fields.Name: TotalRecords
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   records   identified   for   archiving   in   this   run .

Fields.Name: ArchivedRecords
Fields.Description: Number   of   records   successfully   archived .

Fields.Name: FailedRecords
Fields.Description: Number   of   records   that   failed   to   archive .

Fields.Name: SkippedRecords
Fields.Description: Number   of   records   skipped  ( e . g .,  already   archived   or   filtered   out ).

Fields.Name: TotalBytesArchived
Fields.Description: Total   bytes   written   to   archive   storage   during   this   run .

Fields.Name: ErrorLog
Fields.Description: Aggregated   error   log   for   the   run .  Contains   error   details   when   Status   is   Failed   or   PartialSuccess .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   user   who   initiated   this   archive   run .

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Permissions
entities.Description: Manages   user   permissions   for   artifacts   with   granular   access   control  ( Read ,  Edit ,  Delete ,  Share )

Fields.Name: CanRead
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   view / read   the   artifact

Fields.Name: CanEdit
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   modify   the   artifact   or   create   new   versions

Fields.Name: CanDelete
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   delete   the   artifact

Fields.Name: CanShare
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   share   the   artifact   with   other   users

Fields.Name: SharedByUserID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   User   who   shared   this   artifact  ( if   shared )

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   types   of   artifacts   that   can   be   created   within   conversations

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   artifact   type

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   artifact   type

Fields.Name: ContentType
Fields.Description: MIME   type   or   content   identifier   for   this   artifact   type

Fields.Name: IsEnabled
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   this   artifact   type   is   currently   available   for   use

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Parent   artifact   type   ID   for   hierarchical   artifact   type   organization .  Child   types   inherit   ExtractRules   from   parent   but   can   override .

Fields.Name: ExtractRules
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   extraction   rules   defining   how   to   extract   attributes   from   artifact   content .  Each   rule   has :  name  ( string ),  description  ( string ),  type  ( TypeScript   type ),  standardProperty  (' name '|' description '|' displayMarkdown '|' displayHtml '| null ),  extractor  ( JavaScript   code   string ).  Child   types   inherit   parent   rules   and   can   override   by   name .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Driver   class   name   for   the   artifact   viewer   plugin .  References   Angular   component   registered   with  @ RegisterClass   decorator .

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   name   for   displaying   this   artifact   type   in   the   UI  ( e . g .,  fa - file - code ,  fa - chart - line )

Fields.Name: ContentCategory
Fields.Description: Classifies   whether   this   artifact   type   stores   text   content  (' Text ',  the   default   for   all   existing   types )  or   a   binary   file   in   MJStorage  (' File ').  Used   by   AgentRunner   and   viewer   components   to   route   file - based   artifacts   correctly .

Fields.Name: ToolLibraryClass
Fields.Description: Class   name   for   the   BaseArtifactToolLibrary   subclass   that   provides   type - specific   artifact   exploration   tools   for   agents .  Resolved   via   ClassFactory .  When   NULL ,  ArtifactToolManager   uses   name - based   fallback   resolution .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Deterministic   tiebreaker   when   multiple   Artifact   Types   match   the   same   MIME   pattern .  Higher   values   win .  Within   a   specificity   tier  ( exact  >  subtype - wildcard ),  the   resolver   sorts   by   Priority   desc ,  then   SystemSupplied  =  false   beats   SystemSupplied  =  true ,  then   lowest   ID   wins .

Fields.Name: DefaultDeliveryMode
