Fields.Description: How   artifacts   of   this   type   are   delivered   to   the   LLM   by   default .  Inline :  emitted   as   an   inline   content   block  ( image_url ,  audio_url ,  small   text ,  etc .)  when   the   model   supports   the   modality   and   the   size   is   under   the   inline   cap .  ToolsOnly :  never   inlined ;  the   agent   reaches   the   bytes   only   through   tool   calls  ( get_full ,  library - specific   tools ).  Per - instance   override   is   one - way   via   ConversationArtifactVersion . ForceToolsOnly  —  an   instance   can   opt   out   of   inline   but   never   opt   in   when   the   type   default   is   ToolsOnly .

Fields.Name: SystemSupplied
Fields.Description: True   for   Artifact   Types   shipped   as   part   of   the   MemberJunction   default   registry  ( JSON ,  PDF ,  Office   variants ,  Image / Audio / Video ,  Generic   Text ,  Generic   Binary ).  False   for   user / org - supplied   customizations .  Used   as   a   tiebreaker   in   MIME   pattern   resolution :  user   customizations   win   over   shipped   defaults   at   equal   Priority .

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Uses
entities.Description: Audit   trail   of   artifact   usage   for   security   and   analytics .  Tracks   each   time   an   artifact   is   viewed ,  opened ,  shared ,  saved ,  or   exported   by   users .

Fields.Name: ArtifactVersionID
Fields.Description: The   specific   version   of   the   artifact   being   used .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   user   performing   the   action .

Fields.Name: UsageType
Fields.Description: Type   of   usage :  Viewed  ( artifact   displayed ),  Opened  ( artifact   accessed ),  Shared  ( artifact   shared   with   others ),  Saved  ( artifact   bookmarked ),  or   Exported  ( artifact   downloaded ).

Fields.Name: UsageContext
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   context   with   additional   metadata   about   the   usage   event  ( e . g .,  source   page ,  referrer ,  device   info ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Version   Attributes
entities.Description: Stores   extracted   attribute   values   from   artifact   content   based   on   ArtifactType   ExtractRules .  Prevents   re - running   extraction   logic   on   every   access .

Fields.Name: ArtifactVersionID
Fields.Description: The   artifact   version   this   attribute   belongs   to

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   extracted   attribute  ( matches   ExtractRule . name )

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: TypeScript   type   definition   of   the   value  ( e . g ., ' string ', ' number ', ' Date ', ' Array <{ x :  number ,  y :  string }>')

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: JSON - serialized   extracted   value

Fields.Name: StandardProperty
Fields.Description: Maps   this   attribute   to   a   standard   property   for   UI   rendering : ' name ', ' description ', ' displayMarkdown ', ' displayHtml ',  or   NULL   for   custom   attributes

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Versions
entities.Description: Version   history   for   artifacts ,  tracking   all   changes   over   time

Fields.Name: VersionNumber
Fields.Description: Sequential   version   number   for   this   artifact

Fields.Name: Content
Fields.Description: The   content   of   the   artifact   at   this   version

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   this   version

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: User   comments   specific   to   this   version

Fields.Name: ContentHash
Fields.Description: SHA - 256   hash   of   the   Content   field   for   duplicate   detection   and   version   comparison

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name   of   this   artifact   version .  Can   differ   from   Artifact . Name   as   it   may   evolve   with   versions .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   this   artifact   version .  Can   differ   from   Artifact . Description   as   it   may   evolve   with   versions .

Fields.Name: FileID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MJ :  Files   entity .  When   ContentMode   is  ' File ',  this   references   the   binary   file   stored   in   MJStorage .  NULL   when   ContentMode   is  ' Text '.

Fields.Name: ContentMode
Fields.Description: Determines   how   artifact   content   is   stored . ' Text ' ( default )  means   the   Content   column   holds   the   data . ' File '  means   FileID   references   a   binary   file   in   MJStorage   and   Content   is   unused .

Fields.Name: MimeType
Fields.Description: MIME   type   of   the   stored   file  ( e . g .  application / pdf ).  Denormalized   from   the   File   entity   for   display   without   joins .  Only   populated   when   ContentMode   is  ' File '.

Fields.Name: FileName
Fields.Description: Original   filename   of   the   stored   file  ( e . g .  report . pdf ).  Denormalized   from   the   File   entity   for   display   without   joins .  Only   populated   when   ContentMode   is  ' File '.

Fields.Name: ContentSizeBytes
Fields.Description: Size   of   the   stored   file   in   bytes .  Denormalized   for   display   without   loading   the   file .  Only   populated   when   ContentMode   is  ' File '.

Fields.Name: ForceToolsOnly
Fields.Description: One - way   override   that   forces   this   artifact   version   to   be   delivered   via   tools   regardless   of   the   Artifact   Type ' s   DefaultDeliveryMode .  When   true ,  the   resolver   never   emits   an   inline   content   block   for   this   version .  There   is   no   inverse   override  —  an   instance   cannot   be   widened   from   ToolsOnly   to   Inline .  Default   false .

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifacts
entities.Description: Independent   content   items  ( code ,  documents ,  charts )  that   can   be   linked   to   multiple   conversations   and   collections .  Supports   versioning   and   sharing .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   artifact

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   artifact   contents   and   purpose

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: User   comments   about   the   artifact

Fields.Name: Visibility
Fields.Description: Controls   artifact   visibility   in   user - facing   lists . " Always "  shows   in   all   lists , " System   Only "  hides   from   normal   views  ( for   system - generated   artifacts   like   agent   routing   payloads ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Audit   Log   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   types   of   events   that   can   be   recorded   in   the   audit   log ,  enabling   categorization   and   filtering   of   system   activities .

entities.Name: MJ :  Audit   Logs
entities.Description: Tracks   system   events   and   user   actions   for   security ,  compliance ,  and   debugging   purposes ,  providing   a   complete   audit   trail .  Any   application   can   write   entries   to   this   entity .

Fields.Name: Details
Fields.Description: JSON - formatted   additional   context   about   the   audited   event ,  including   before / after   values ,  parameters ,  or   other   relevant   data .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   primary   key   value   of   the   record   that   was   affected   by   this   audited   action ,  enabling   direct   lookup   of   the   modified   data .

entities.Name: MJ :  Authentication   Providers
entities.Description: Metadata   catalog   of   authentication   providers .  Each   row   defines   one   provider  ( Auth0 ,  Okta ,  MSAL ,  Cognito ,  Google ,  WorkOS ,  or   any   third - party   driver )  whose   implementation   is   resolved   at   runtime   from   DriverClass   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance ( BaseAuthProvider ,  DriverClass ).  Supersedes   the   hard - wired   mj . config . cjs   authProviders   array ,  which   remains   a   back - compat   fallback   when   this   table   is   empty .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique ,  human - readable   name   for   this   provider   instance  ( e . g . " WorkOS   Production ", " Corporate   Azure   AD ").  Also   the   key   used   to   register   the   provider   with   AuthProviderFactory .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   administrator   notes   describing   this   provider   configuration .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Driver   key   resolved   at   runtime   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance ( BaseAuthProvider ,  DriverClass ).  MUST   match   the  @ RegisterClass   key   on   the   concrete   server   provider  ( e . g . " workos ", " auth0 ", " okta ", " msal ", " cognito ", " google ").  The   browser   resolves   its   matching   MJAuthBase   subclass   from   the   same   key ,  so   a   driver   ships   as   a   server / browser   pair   under   one   name .

Fields.Name: Issuer
Fields.Description: Expected   JWT   issuer  ( the  " iss "  claim ).  Used   to   route   an   incoming   token   to   this   provider   and   to   validate   the   token .  E . g .  https :// api . workos . com / user_management /< clientId >.

Fields.Name: Audience
Fields.Description: Expected   JWT   audience  ( the  " aud "  claim )  enforced   during   validation .

Fields.Name: JWKSUri
Fields.Description: JWKS   endpoint   URL   used   to   fetch   the   signing   keys   that   verify   token   signatures .  E . g .  https :// api . workos . com / sso / jwks /< clientId >.

Fields.Name: ClientID
Fields.Description: Public   OAuth   client   ID .  Safe   to   expose   to   the   browser   and   published   in   the   pre - auth   provider   catalog .

Fields.Name: Domain
Fields.Description: Provider   domain   where   applicable  ( e . g .  Auth0 / Okta   tenant   domain ).  Optional ;  published   in   the   pre - auth   provider   catalog .

Fields.Name: Scopes
Fields.Description: OAuth   scopes   to   request ,  space - delimited  ( e . g . " openid   profile   email ").  Published   in   the   pre - auth   provider   catalog .

Fields.Name: AdditionalConfiguration
Fields.Description: SERVER - SIDE   ONLY   driver   configuration   as   a   JSON   object ,  for   fields   not   modeled   as   columns .  NEVER   published   to   the   pre - auth   catalog .  Merged   into   the   provider   config   when   the   server   driver   is   instantiated .  Put   anything   the   browser   must   not   read   here .

Fields.Name: ClientConfiguration
Fields.Description: Browser   driver   configuration   as   a   JSON   object  ( e . g .  WorkOS   apiHostname ,  Cognito   region / userPoolId ,  redirectUri ).  PUBLISHED   VERBATIM   in   the   unauthenticated   pre - auth   provider   catalog ,  so   every   value   here   must   be   considered   world - readable .  Server - only   settings   belong   in   AdditionalConfiguration .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status .  Only   Active   providers   are   registered   at   startup   and   offered   for   login .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: When   true ,  this   provider   is   the   default   selection  --  pre - highlighted   in   the   login   picker ,  and   used   directly   when   it   is   the   only   Active ,  client - visible   provider .

Fields.Name: ClientVisible
Fields.Description: When   true ,  this   provider   appears   in   the   browser   pre - auth   login   picker   and   is   included   in   the   public   catalog   endpoint .  Set   false   for   providers   that   only   validate   machine - to - machine   tokens   and   should   never   be   offered   as   an   interactive   login .

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: Label   shown   on   the   login   picker   button  ( e . g . " Microsoft ",  rendered   as  " Continue   with   Microsoft ").  Falls   back   to   Name   when   null .

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: Icon   for   the   login   picker   button  --  a   Font   Awesome   class  ( e . g . " fa - brands   fa - microsoft ")  or   a   known   brand - logo   key   the   picker   maps   to   a   brand   chip .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ordering   of   this   provider   within   the   login   picker  ( ascending ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Authorization   Roles
entities.Description: Links   authorizations   to   roles ,  defining   which   permissions   are   granted   to   users   assigned   to   specific   roles   in   the   system .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Specifies   whether   this   authorization   is   granted   to  (' grant ')  or   explicitly   denied  (' deny ')  for   the   role .

entities.Name: MJ :  Authorizations
entities.Description: Stores   the   fundamental   permissions   and   access   rights   that   can   be   granted   to   users   and   roles   throughout   the   system .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   authorization   is   currently   active   and   can   be   granted   to   users   or   roles .

Fields.Name: UseAuditLog
Fields.Description: When   set   to   1 ,  Audit   Log   records   are   created   whenever   this   authorization   is   invoked   for   a   user

entities.Name: MJ :  Cluster   Analysis
entities.Description: A   saved   cluster   analysis :  the   configuration ,  computed   metrics ,  and   projected   2D / 3D   layout   of   a   clustering   run   over   an   entity ' s   embedding   vectors .  First - class ,  queryable ,  and   shareable  —  replaces   the   prior   approach   of   stashing   analyses   in   a   User   Settings   JSON   blob  /  browser   localStorage .  Owner - private ;  explicit   shares   are   recorded   in   ResourcePermission   against   the  " Cluster   Analysis "  ResourceType .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   for   this   saved   analysis  ( e . g . " Members   by   skill   embedding  —  June ").

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   longer   description   of   what   this   analysis   explores   and   how   to   interpret   it .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   User   who   owns   this   analysis .  The   owner   has   full   control ;  other   users   gain   access   only   via   explicit   ResourcePermission   share   rows  ( owner - private   sharing   model ).

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   primary   Entity   whose   records   were   clustered .  Drives   drilldown  ( click   a   point  ->  open   that   record )  and   view - type   qualification .  Nullable   for   analyses   not   bound   to   a   single   entity ;  the   full   source   definition  ( including   multi - document   selections )  lives   in   Configuration .

Fields.Name: Algorithm
Fields.Description: Clustering   algorithm   used :  KMeans ,  DBSCAN ,  or   Hierarchical .  Stored   as   a   top - level   column   for   filtering / reporting ;  the   full   parameter   set   is   captured   in   Configuration .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   snapshot   of   the   configuration   this   analysis   was   run   with :  algorithm   parameters  ( k  /  epsilon  /  minPoints ),  distance   metric ,  the   Entity   Document   ID ( s )  supplying   the   vectors ,  max   record   count ,  any   record   filter ,  and   whether   LLM   cluster   naming   was   requested .  A   complete ,  self - describing   record   of   how   to   interpret  ( or   re - run )  the   analysis .

Fields.Name: Metrics
Fields.Description: JSON   of   computed   quality / shape   metrics   for   the   run  —  e . g .  silhouette   score ,  inertia ,  resolved   cluster   count ,  point   count .  Used   to   display   analysis   quality   and   to   compare   runs .

Fields.Name: ProjectedPoints
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   the   projected   points  ( 2D   or   3D   coordinates )  with   each   point ' s   record   key   and   assigned   cluster   index .  Persisted   because   dimensionality   reduction  ( UMAP )  is   stochastic  —  re - running   would   not   reproduce   the   same   layout  —  so   the   rendered   scatter   is   reconstructed   from   this   snapshot   rather   than   recomputed .

Fields.Name: ViewportState
Fields.Description: JSON   describing   the   saved   viewport   for   the   visualization  ( pan  /  zoom ,  and   rotation   for   3D )  so   the   analysis   reopens   framed   exactly   as   the   user   left   it .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status   of   the   analysis   run :  Pending  ( queued  /  running ),  Complete  ( results   available ),  or   Failed  ( run   errored ;  see   Metrics / Configuration   for   diagnostics ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Cluster   Analysis   Clusters
entities.Description: One   named   cluster   within   a   saved   ClusterAnalysis .  Holds   the   cluster ' s   label  ( LLM - generated   or   user - edited ),  member   count ,  and   display   color ,  so   labels   can   be   regenerated   or   hand - edited   per   cluster   without   re - running   the   whole   analysis .

Fields.Name: ClusterAnalysisID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   parent   ClusterAnalysis .  Cluster   rows   are   deleted   with   their   analysis  ( cascade ).

Fields.Name: ClusterIndex
Fields.Description: Zero - based   index   of   this   cluster   within   the   analysis ,  matching   the   cluster   assignments   stored   in   ClusterAnalysis . ProjectedPoints .  Unique   per   analysis .

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: Display   label   for   the   cluster  ( e . g .  an   LLM - generated   theme   name   like  " Renewal  &  retention ").  Nullable   until   named .

Fields.Name: MemberCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   records  ( points )  assigned   to   this   cluster .

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Color   used   to   render   this   cluster   in   the   scatter   visualization  ( e . g .  a   hex   string   or   token   reference ).

Fields.Name: IsUserEdited
Fields.Description: True   when   a   user   has   manually   edited   this   cluster ' s   label / color ,  so   regenerating   LLM   labels   for   the   analysis   can   skip   user - curated   clusters .

entities.Name: MJ :  Collection   Artifacts
entities.Description: Links   collections   to   specific   artifact   versions .  Each   collection   can   contain   multiple   versions   of   the   same   artifact .

Per - membership :  the   same   artifact   can   carry   different   guidance   in   different   Collections  ( media   kits ).

Default   0  ( lazy  —  surfaced   only   when   the   agent   chooses ).

Fields.Name: SyncDirection

Fields.Name: SourceFieldLabel

Fields.Name: DestinationFieldName

Fields.Name: DestinationFieldLabel

Fields.Name: Direction

Fields.Name: IsRequired

Fields.Name: DefaultValue
Fields.Description: Default   value   to   use   when   the   source   field   is   null   or   missing .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Processing   order   for   this   field   mapping   within   the   entity   map .

Fields.Name: Status

Fields.Description: The   unique   identifier   for   this   record   in   the   external   integrated   system .

Fields.Name: EntityRecordID
Fields.Description: The   internal   MemberJunction   record   ID   that   corresponds   to   the   external   system   record .

entities.Name: MJ :  Company   Integration   Run   API   Logs
entities.Description: Logs   detailed   API   calls   and   responses   during   integration   runs ,  including   request / response   payloads ,  status   codes ,  and   timing   information .

Fields.Name: URL
Fields.Description: The   complete   URL   that   was   called ,  including   query   parameters .

Fields.Name: Parameters

entities.Name: MJ :  Company   Integration   Run   Details
entities.Description: Tracks   individual   record - level   operations   within   an   integration   run ,  including   success / failure   status   and   error   details   for   each   processed   item .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   ID   of   the   specific   record   being   processed   in   this   integration   operation .

Fields.Name: Action
Fields.Description: The   type   of   operation   performed  ( INSERT ,  UPDATE ,  DELETE ,  SYNC ).

Fields.Name: ExecutedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   specific   record   operation   was   executed .

Fields.Name: IsSuccess
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   individual   record   operation   succeeded   or   failed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Company   Integration   Runs
entities.Description: Records   execution   history   of   company   integrations ,  including   start / end   times ,  overall   status ,  and   aggregate   statistics   for   monitoring   and   troubleshooting .

Fields.Name: TotalRecords
Fields.Description: The   total   number   of   records   processed   during   this   integration   run .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Status   of   the   integration   run .  Possible   values :  Pending ,  In   Progress ,  Success ,  Failed .

Fields.Name: ErrorLog
Fields.Description: Optional   error   log   information   for   the   integration   run .

Fields.Name: ConfigData
Fields.Description: Optional   configuration   data   in   JSON   format   for   the   request   that   started   the   integration   run   for   audit   purposes .

Fields.Name: ScheduledJobRunID
Fields.Description: Links   to   the   scheduled   job   run   that   triggered   this   integration   sync .  NULL   for   manually - triggered   syncs .

Fields.Name: OwnerToken
Fields.Description: Opaque   token   identifying   the   process   currently   executing   this   run .  NULL  =  unowned .  Set   atomically   by   spClaimCompanyIntegrationRun ;  a   claim   succeeds   only   when   the   run   is   unowned   or   its   lease   has   expired .  Cleared   by   spReleaseCompanyIntegrationRun .

Fields.Name: LeaseExpiresAt
Fields.Description: When   the   current   owner ' s   lease   expires .  A   run   whose   lease   has   passed   is   reclaimable   by   the   stale   sweep   or   another   worker   via   spClaimCompanyIntegrationRun .  Renewed   on   a   timer   by   the   owning   engine   via   spRenewCompanyIntegrationRunLease .

Fields.Name: HeartbeatAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   owner ' s   most   recent   lease   renewal  ( liveness   signal ).  Updated   by   spClaimCompanyIntegrationRun   and   spRenewCompanyIntegrationRunLease .

Fields.Name: FenceToken
Fields.Description: Monotonic   fencing   token ,  incremented   on   every   successful   claim / reclaim   by   spClaimCompanyIntegrationRun .  The   engine   re - checks   this   at   every   batch   boundary   BEFORE   writing :  if   it   has   moved ,  another   process   owns   the   run   and   the   original   owner   aborts   without   writing .  This   is   what   turns   the   stale   sweep   from   a   double - run   cause   into   a   double - run   fix .

Fields.Name: CancelRequestedAt
Fields.Description: When   cancellation   was   requested   for   this   run  ( from   any   process ).  NULL  =  no   cancel   requested .  The   owning   engine   checks   this   at   the   same   batch   boundary   as   the   fence   token   and   stops   at   the   next   boundary .  Replaces   the   former   per - process   in - memory   cancellation   map  —  the   database   row   is   the   single   source   of   truth .

Fields.Name: ProgressJSON
Fields.Description: JSON   progress   snapshot   written  ( throttled ,  at   most   once   per   batch )  by   the   owning   engine .  Readers   query   this   row   instead   of   an   in - process   map ,  so   progress   is   visible   from   any   process .  Only   the   owner   writes   it .

Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   library - specific   lint   rules   that   are   applied   during   component   validation .  This   field   contains   structured   rules   that   define   how   components   using   this   library   should   be   validated ,  including   DOM   element   requirements ,  initialization   patterns ,  lifecycle   methods ,  and   common   error   patterns .  Example   structure : {" initialization ": {" constructorName ": " Chart ", " elementType ": " canvas "}, " lifecycle ": {" requiredMethods ": [" render "], " cleanupMethods ": [" destroy "]}}.  The   linter   dynamically   applies   these   rules   based   on   the   libraries   referenced   in   a   component   spec ,  enabling   extensible   validation   without   hardcoding   library - specific   logic .

Fields.Name: Dependencies
Fields.Description: JSON   object   defining   dependencies   for   this   component   library .  Format : { " libraryName ": " versionSpec ", ... }.  Version   specifications   follow   NPM - style   syntax  ( e . g ., "~ 1 . 0 . 0 ", "^ 1 . 2 . 3 ", " 2 . 3 . 4 ").  Dependencies   are   loaded   before   this   library   to   ensure   proper   execution   context .

Fields.Name: UsageType
Fields.Description: Controls   how   the   library   can   be   used :  Direct  ( by   components ),  Dependency  ( only   as   dependency ),  or   Both

Fields.Name: UsageInstructions
Fields.Description: Markdown - formatted   usage   instructions   for   AI   code   generators   and   agents .  Injected   into   prompts   when   a   component   references   this   library .  Covers   container   requirements ,  initialization   patterns ,  required   config   options ,  and   common   pitfalls .  Distinct   from   Description   which   is   a   high - level   summary   of   what   the   library   does .

entities.Name: MJ :  Component   Library   Links
entities.Description: Links   components   to   their   third - party   library   dependencies

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   for   component - library   relationship

Fields.Name: ComponentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Component   that   depends   on   the   library

Fields.Name: LibraryID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   ComponentLibrary   that   the   component   depends   on

Fields.Name: MinVersion
Fields.Description: Minimum   version   requirement   using   semantic   versioning  ( e . g ., ^ 1 . 0 . 0 , ~ 2 . 5 . 0 )

entities.Name: MJ :  Component   Registries
entities.Description: Registry   catalog   for   component   sources ,  similar   to   NPM   registry   but   supporting   multiple   sources

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   for   the   component   registry

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   registry  ( e . g .,  MemberJunction   Registry ,  NPM ,  Internal   Registry )

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Description   of   the   registry   and   its   purpose

Fields.Name: URI
Fields.Description: Registry   endpoint   URI  ( e . g .,  https :// registry . memberjunction . org )

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Type   of   registry :  public ,  private ,  or   internal

Fields.Name: APIVersion
Fields.Description: API   version   supported   by   the   registry   for   compatibility

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   the   registry :  active ,  deprecated ,  or   offline

entities.Name: MJ :  Components
entities.Description: Main   catalog   of   reusable   components   with   versioning   and   registry   support

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Immutable   UUID   that   remains   the   same   across   all   systems

Fields.Name: Namespace
Fields.Description: Hierarchical   namespace   path  ( e . g .,  dashboards / sales   for   local , @ memberjunction / dashboards / financial   for   external )

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Component   name   within   the   namespace  ( e . g .,  revenue - tracker )

Fields.Name: Version
Fields.Description: Semantic   version   number  ( e . g .,  1 . 0 . 0 ,  1 . 2 . 3 - beta )

Fields.Name: VersionSequence
Fields.Description: Numeric   sequence   for   sorting   versions

Fields.Name: Title
Fields.Description: User - friendly   display   title   for   the   component

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: [ READ - ONLY ]  Detailed   description   of   the   component   functionality .  This   field   is   automatically   synchronized   from   the   Specification . description   field   and   should   not   be   edited   directly .  To   update   this   value ,  edit   the   component   spec   file .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Component   type :  report ,  dashboard ,  form ,  table ,  chart ,  navigation ,  search ,  widget ,  utility ,  or   other

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Publication   status :  draft ,  published ,  or   deprecated

Fields.Name: DeveloperName
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   component   developer   or   author

Fields.Name: DeveloperEmail
Fields.Description: Contact   email   for   the   component   developer

Fields.Name: DeveloperOrganization
Fields.Description: Organization   name   of   the   component   developer

Fields.Name: SourceRegistryID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   ComponentRegistry  -  NULL   for   local   components ,  populated   for   replicated   ones

Fields.Name: ReplicatedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   component   was   replicated   from   external   registry  ( NULL   for   local   components )

Fields.Name: LastSyncedAt
Fields.Description: Last   synchronization   timestamp   with   the   source   registry

Fields.Name: Specification
Fields.Description: Complete   JSON   specification   object   for   the   component

Fields.Name: FunctionalRequirements
Fields.Description: [ READ - ONLY ]  Functional   requirements   describing   what   the   component   should   accomplish .  This   field   is   automatically   synchronized   from   the   Specification . functionalRequirements   field   and   should   not   be   edited   directly .  To   update   this   value ,  edit   the   component   spec   file .

Fields.Name: TechnicalDesign
Fields.Description: [ READ - ONLY ]  Technical   design   describing   how   the   component   is   implemented .  This   field   is   automatically   synchronized   from   the   Specification . technicalDesign   field   and   should   not   be   edited   directly .  To   update   this   value ,  edit   the   component   spec   file .

Fields.Name: FunctionalRequirementsVector
Fields.Description: Vector   embedding   of   the   functional   requirements   for   similarity   search

Fields.Name: TechnicalDesignVector
Fields.Description: Vector   embedding   of   the   technical   design   for   similarity   search

Fields.Name: HasCustomProps
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   the   component   has   custom   properties   defined   in   its   specification .  Components   with   custom   props   cannot   be   used   directly   by   deterministic   containers .

Fields.Name: HasCustomEvents
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   the   component   has   custom   events   defined   in   its   specification .  Components   with   custom   events   may   have   limited   functionality   in   generic   containers .

Fields.Name: RequiresData
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   the   component   requires   data   access  ( utilities   object   with   md ,  rv ,  rq ).  Used   to   determine   if   component   needs   data   context .

Fields.Name: DependencyCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   component   dependencies   defined   in   the   specification .  Used   to   assess   component   complexity .

Fields.Name: TechnicalDesignVectorEmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: The   ID   of   the   AI   model   used   to   generate   the   vector   embedding   for   the   technical   design

Fields.Name: FunctionalRequirementsVectorEmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: The   ID   of   the   AI   model   used   to   generate   the   vector   embedding   for   the   functional   requirements

Fields.Name: HasRequiredCustomProps
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   the   component   has   any   custom   properties   that   are   marked   as   required .  This   is   auto - calculated   based   on   the   component ' s   properties   array   to   identify   components   with   mandatory   custom   configuration .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   File   Types
entities.Description: Defines   supported   file   types   for   content   management ,  including   extensions   and   processing   rules   for   different   content   formats .

Fields.Name: FileExtension
Fields.Description: The   file   extension  ( e . g ., . pdf , . docx , . jpg )  used   to   identify   this   content   type .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Item   Attributes
entities.Description: Stores   metadata   attributes   extracted   with   prompting   for   content   items ,  enabling   flexible   key - value   properties   and   custom   fields   for   content   classification .

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: The   extracted   or   assigned   value   for   this   attribute   on   the   content   item .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Item   Chunks
entities.Description: Represents   an   individual   chunk   of   a   Content   Item ' s   text   that   was   embedded   as   a   distinct   vector .  When   a   Content   Item   is   too   large   to   embed   as   a   single   vector   it   is   split   into   ordered   chunks ;  each   chunk   becomes   one   row   here ,  linking   the   stored   vector   back   to   the   specific   portion   of   the   parent   Content   Item   it   represents .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Zero - based   ordinal   position   of   this   chunk   within   the   parent   Content   Item ,  preserving   the   original   order   in   which   the   text   was   split .

Fields.Name: Text
Fields.Description: The   chunk   of   extracted   text  ( from   the   parent   Content   Item )  that   was   embedded   to   produce   this   chunk ' s   vector .  NULL   for   media - only   segments  ( for   example   an   image ,  or   a   video   window   with   no   transcript ),  where   the   embedded   payload   is   the   media   itself   and   any   readable   representation   lives   in   Description / Transcript .

Fields.Name: VectorRecordID
Fields.Description: The   identifier   of   this   chunk ' s   vector   record   in   the   vector   database  ( e . g .  Pinecone ) —  the   deterministic   key   MemberJunction   assigns   and   upserts   the   chunk ' s   embedding   under .  Provides   traceability   from   the   chunk   back   to   its   stored   vector .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingStatus
Fields.Description: Embedding   lifecycle   state   of   this   chunk :  Pending  ( default ),  Processing ,  Active ,  Complete ,  Processed ,  Failed ,  or   Skipped .

Fields.Name: TaggingStatus
Fields.Description: Tagging   lifecycle   state   of   this   chunk :  Pending  ( default ),  Processing ,  Active ,  Complete ,  Processed ,  Failed ,  or   Skipped .

Fields.Name: DeleteStatus
Fields.Description: Deletion   lifecycle   state   of   this   chunk ' s   vector :  NULL   when   not   slated   for   deletion ,  Pending   when   vector   removal   is   queued ,  or   Deleted   once   the   vector   has   been   removed   from   the   vector   database .

Fields.Name: LastEmbeddedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   successful   embedding   of   this   chunk .

Fields.Name: LastTaggedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   successful   tagging   of   this   chunk .

Fields.Name: LastDeletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   successful   deletion   of   this   chunk ' s   vector   from   the   vector   database .

Fields.Name: Modality
Fields.Description: The   modality   of   this   chunk ' s   embedded   payload :  text  ( default ),  image ,  audio ,  video ,  or   multimodal  ( text   and   media   fused   into   a   single   vector ).  Determines   which   vector   index   the   chunk ' s   embedding   belongs   to ,  since   a   multimodal   embedding   model   produces   vectors   of   a   different   dimension   than   a   text   model ,  and   is   used   at   retrieval   time   to   merge   results   per   modality   rather   than   taking   a   single   global   top - k .

Fields.Name: StartOffset
Fields.Description: Inclusive   character   offset   where   this   chunk   begins   within   the   parent   Content   Item ' s   extracted   text .  Together   with   EndOffset   this   is   the   provenance   link   that   resolves   a   search   hit   back   to   the   exact   passage   in   the   source   document .  NULL   for   media   segments ,  which   are   positioned   by   StartMs / EndMs   instead .

Fields.Name: EndOffset
Fields.Description: Exclusive   character   offset   where   this   chunk   ends   within   the   parent   Content   Item ' s   extracted   text .  See   StartOffset .  NULL   for   media   segments .

Fields.Name: StartMs
Fields.Description: Start   of   this   chunk ' s   time   window ,  in   milliseconds   from   the   beginning   of   the   parent   audio   or   video   asset .  Set   by   transcript -  or   window - based   segmentation ;  enables   time - windowed   playback   deep - links   from   a   search   result  ( for   example   14 : 22 - 15 : 05   of   a   session   recording ).  NULL   for   text   segments .

Fields.Name: EndMs
Fields.Description: End   of   this   chunk ' s   time   window ,  in   milliseconds   from   the   beginning   of   the   parent   audio   or   video   asset .  See   StartMs .  NULL   for   text   segments .

Fields.Name: PageNumber
Fields.Description: One - based   page   number   this   chunk   came   from ,  for   paginated   sources   such   as   PDFs   or   slide   decks .  Provides   citation - grade   provenance   alongside   the   character   offsets .  NULL   when   the   source   is   not   paginated .

Fields.Name: SegmentTitle
Fields.Description: Human - readable   label   for   this   segment  —  a   document   heading   for   structure - based   segmentation ,  or   a   generated   chapter   title   for   topic -  and   transcript - based   segmentation .  Displayed   with   search   results   and   prepended   to   the   embedded   text   so   a   chunk ' s   vector   carries   its   own   topic .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: An   AI - generated   description   of   this   chunk ' s   content ,  primarily   for   non - text   segments .  Retrieval   of   a   media   chunk   otherwise   yields   only   a   pointer  ( an   asset   and   a   time   window )  that   an   agent   cannot   reason   over ;  this   column   is   the   readable   representation   that   an   agent   reads ,  a   cross - encoder   reranks ,  and   lexical   search   matches .  A   short   summary   of   it   may   be   mirrored   into   the   vector   record ' s   metadata   for   display   and   filtering ,  but   the   full   text   belongs   here .

Fields.Name: Transcript
Fields.Description: The   verbatim   transcript   covering   this   chunk ' s   time   window ,  for   audio   and   video   segments ,  including   speaker   labels   where   the   source   provides   them .  Distinct   from   Description ,  which   is   a   generated   summary :  this   is   what   was   actually   said ,  and   it   is   what   makes   a   recording   findable   by   lexical   search .

Fields.Name: SegmenterKey
Fields.Description: Registration   key   of   the   segmentation   strategy   that   produced   this   chunk  ( for   example   StructuralText ,  SemanticText ,  Transcript ,  or   FixedWindow ).  Provenance :  when   a   Content   Source ' s   configured   strategy   changes ,  this   identifies   which   chunks   were   produced   by   the   previous   strategy   and   therefore   need   re - chunking .

Fields.Name: ParentChunkID
Fields.Description: Optional   self - reference   to   another   chunk   of   the   same   Content   Item   that   is   the   parent   of   this   one ,  expressing   a   chapter   to   sub - chapter   hierarchy  —  for   example   a   five - minute   chapter   of   a   recording   and   the   individual   speaker   turns   within   it ,  or   a   document   section   and   its   subsections .  NULL   for   top - level   segments .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Item   Duplicates
entities.Description: Detected   duplicate   or   near - duplicate   content   items   across   sources .  Each   row   represents   a   pair   of   items   with   similarity   scoring   and   resolution   tracking .

Fields.Name: SimilarityScore
Fields.Description: Cosine   similarity  ( for   Vector )  or   exact   match   score  ( 1 . 0   for   Checksum / URL ).  Range   0 . 0 - 1 . 0 .

Fields.Name: DetectionMethod
Fields.Description: How   the   duplicate   was   detected :  Checksum  ( identical   text   hash ),  Vector  ( embedding   similarity ),  Title  ( same   title   text ),  URL  ( same   source   URL ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status :  Pending  ( awaiting   review ),  Confirmed  ( verified   duplicate ),  Dismissed  ( not   a   duplicate ),  Merged  ( one   item   was   removed ).

Fields.Name: Resolution
Fields.Description: How   the   duplicate   was   resolved :  KeepA  ( keep   first ,  remove   second ),  KeepB  ( keep   second ,  remove   first ),  MergeBoth  ( combine   into   one ),  NotDuplicate  ( false   positive ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Item   Tags
entities.Description: Links   tags   to   content   items   for   categorization ,  searchability ,  and   content   discovery   across   the   system .

Fields.Name: Tag
Fields.Description: The   tag   text   applied   to   the   content   item   for   categorization   and   search .

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Relevance   weight   for   this   tag  ( 0 . 0 - 1 . 0 ).  1 . 0  =  highly   relevant   central   topic ,  0 . 5  =  moderately   relevant ,  0 . 1  =  tangentially   related .  Assigned   by   the   LLM   during   autotagging .

Fields.Name: TagID
Fields.Description: Optional   link   to   the   formal   MJ   Tag   taxonomy .  When   set ,  this   free - text   tag   has   been   matched  ( via   semantic   similarity   or   exact   match )  to   a   curated   Tag   record .  NULL   means   the   tag   is   unmatched   free   text   only .

Fields.Name: AIPromptRunID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   AI   Prompt   Run   that   produced   this   tag ,  populated   by   the   autotagging   pipeline   at   tag - creation   time .  Provides   a   direct ,  reliable   edge   from   a   tag   back   to   the   exact   extraction   run ,  replacing   the   previous   fragile   time - correlation   heuristic .  Nullable   for   tags   created   outside   the   LLM   pipeline  ( e . g .  manual   tagging )  or   backfilled   rows .

Fields.Name: Reasoning
Fields.Description: The   LLM ' s   reasoning  /  justification   for   assigning   this   tag   to   the   content   item ,  captured   at   extraction   time .  Surfaced   in   the   item   drilldown   so   users   can   audit   why   a   tag   was   applied   without   re - parsing   the   AI   Prompt   Run   result   JSON .  Nullable   when   no   reasoning   was   produced .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Items
entities.Description: Stores   extracted   text   from   content   assets ,  as   well   as   the   source   location ,  versioning ,  and   links   to   extracted   tags   and   attributes .

Fields.Name: Checksum
Fields.Description: Hash   value   of   the   content   used   to   detect   changes   and   prevent   duplicate   processing .

Fields.Name: URL
Fields.Description: The   source   location   URL   where   this   content   was   retrieved   from .

Fields.Name: Text
Fields.Description: The   extracted   text   content   from   the   source   document   or   file .

Fields.Name: EntityRecordDocumentID
Fields.Description: For   entity - sourced   content   items ,  links   to   the   Entity   Record   Document   snapshot   that   was   rendered   for   this   item .  Provides   traceability   back   to   the   source   entity   record   via   ERD . EntityID  +  ERD . RecordID .  NULL   for   non - entity   sources .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingStatus
Fields.Description: Vectorization   status :  Pending  ( not   yet   embedded ),  Processing  ( currently   being   embedded ),  Complete  ( vector   stored ),  Failed  ( embedding   error ),  Skipped  ( excluded   from   vectorization ).

Fields.Name: LastEmbeddedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   most   recent   successful   embedding   for   this   content   item .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: The   AI   model   used   to   generate   the   most   recent   embedding   for   this   content   item .

Fields.Name: TaggingStatus
Fields.Description: Autotagging   status :  Pending  ( not   yet   tagged ),  Processing  ( LLM   is   generating   tags ),  Complete  ( tags   assigned ),  Failed  ( LLM   error ),  Skipped  ( excluded   from   tagging ).

Fields.Name: LastTaggedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   most   recent   successful   autotagging   run   for   this   content   item .

Fields.Name: VectorRecordID
Fields.Description: The   identifier   of   this   Content   Item ' s   vector   record   in   the   vector   database  ( e . g .  Pinecone ) —  the   deterministic   key   MemberJunction   assigns   and   upserts   the   embedding   under   when   the   item   is   embedded   as   a   single   vector .  Provides   traceability   from   the   Content   Item   back   to   its   stored   vector .  For   chunked   items ,  per - chunk   identifiers   are   tracked   on   the   ContentItemChunk   entity   instead .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Optional   self - reference   to   another   Content   Item   that   is   the   parent   of   this   one ,  enabling   a   content - item   hierarchy  ( e . g .  a   document   and   its   sub - pages ,  or   a   site   and   its   crawled   pages ).  NULL   for   top - level   items .

Fields.Name: DisplayLink
Fields.Description: Optional   display / clickable   URL   for   this   Content   Item  ( e . g .  a   canonical   or   human - facing   link ),  distinct   from   the   source   URL   used   for   ingestion .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Process   Run   Details
entities.Description: Per - content - source   tracking   within   a   pipeline   run .  Each   source   processed   during   a   ContentProcessRun   gets   one   detail   record   with   item   counts ,  timing ,  token   usage ,  and   cost   rollups .

Fields.Name: ContentProcessRunID
Fields.Description: The   parent   pipeline   run   this   detail   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: ContentSourceID
Fields.Description: The   content   source   being   processed   in   this   detail   record .

Fields.Name: ContentSourceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   type   of   content   source  ( RSS   Feed ,  Entity ,  Website ,  Cloud   Storage ,  etc .).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Processing   status :  Pending ,  Running ,  Completed ,  Failed ,  or   Skipped .

Fields.Name: ItemsProcessed
Fields.Description: Total   content   items   processed   for   this   source   during   the   run .

Fields.Name: ItemsTagged
Fields.Description: Number   of   content   items   successfully   tagged   by   the   LLM .

Fields.Name: ItemsVectorized
Fields.Description: Number   of   content   items   successfully   embedded   and   upserted   to   the   vector   database .

Fields.Name: TagsCreated
Fields.Description: Number   of   new   ContentItemTag   records   created   during   LLM   tagging .

Fields.Name: ErrorCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   errors   encountered   while   processing   this   source .

Fields.Name: StartTime
Fields.Description: When   processing   started   for   this   source   within   the   pipeline   run .

Fields.Name: EndTime
Fields.Description: When   processing   completed   for   this   source   within   the   pipeline   run .

Fields.Name: TotalTokensUsed
Fields.Description: Rollup   of   all   tokens   used   across   LLM   tagging   and   embedding   calls   for   this   source .  Computed   from   linked   AIPromptRun   records   via   the   ContentProcessRunPromptRun   junction   table .

Fields.Name: TotalCost
Fields.Description: Rollup   of   all   costs   across   LLM   tagging   and   embedding   calls   for   this   source .  Computed   from   linked   AIPromptRun   records   via   the   ContentProcessRunPromptRun   junction   table .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Process   Run   Prompt   Runs
entities.Description: Links   ContentProcessRunDetail   records   to   their   associated   AIPromptRun   records .  Each   LLM   tagging   call   and   embedding   call   creates   an   AIPromptRun ,  and   this   junction   table   provides   the   FK   relationship   for   cost / token   analytics .

Fields.Name: ContentProcessRunDetailID
Fields.Description: The   content   process   run   detail   record   this   prompt   run   is   associated   with .

Fields.Name: AIPromptRunID
Fields.Description: The   AI   prompt   run   record   containing   token   usage ,  cost ,  model ,  vendor ,  and   execution   details   for   this   call .

Fields.Name: RunType
Fields.Description: Whether   this   AIPromptRun   was   for   LLM   tagging  ( Tag )  or   text   embedding  ( Embed ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Process   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   execution   of   content   tagging   workflows ,  logging   the   status   and   details   of   each   execution   and   ensuring   efficient   processing   of   content .

Fields.Name: StartTime
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   content   processing   workflow   began   execution .

Fields.Name: EndTime
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   content   processing   workflow   completed   or   failed .

Fields.Name: ProcessedItems
Fields.Description: Count   of   content   items   successfully   processed   during   this   run .

Fields.Name: StartedByUserID
Fields.Description: The   user   who   triggered   this   pipeline   run .  NULL   for   system - initiated   runs .

Fields.Name: TotalItemCount
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   content   items   to   process   in   this   run .  Used   for   progress   percentage   calculation .

Fields.Name: LastProcessedOffset
Fields.Description: StartRow   offset   of   the   last   successfully   completed   batch .  Used   for   resume - from - crash :  next   batch   starts   at   this   offset .  Reset   to   0   on   new   runs .

Fields.Name: BatchSize
Fields.Description: Number   of   content   items   processed   per   batch .  Configurable   per   run ,  default   100 .

Fields.Name: ErrorCount
Fields.Description: Running   count   of   errors   encountered   during   processing .  Used   by   the   circuit   breaker   to   halt   the   pipeline   if   error   rate   exceeds   the   configured   threshold .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   details   if   the   run   failed .  Includes   error   messages ,  stack   traces ,  or   circuit   breaker   trigger   reason .

Fields.Name: CancellationRequested
Fields.Description: When   set   to   1 ,  the   pipeline   stops   after   completing   the   current   batch .  Used   for   pause   and   cancel   operations .  The   Status   column   reflects   the   final   state  ( Paused   or   Cancelled ).

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   snapshot   of   the   pipeline   configuration   used   for   this   run .  Conforms   to   the   IContentProcessRunConfiguration   interface .  Includes   batch   size ,  rate   limits ,  error   thresholds ,  and   duplicate   detection   settings .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Source   Params
entities.Description: Stores   configuration   parameters   for   specific   content   source   instances ,  customizing   how   content   is   retrieved   and   processed   from   each   source .

Fields.Name: ContentSourceTypeParamID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   parameter   definition   in   Content   Source   Type   Params .

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: The   configured   value   for   this   parameter   on   this   specific   content   source .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Source   Type   Params
entities.Description: Defines   required   and   optional   parameters   for   content   source   types ,  establishing   the   configuration   for   each   source   type .

Fields.Name: Type

Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   blob   for   type - level   settings .  Conforms   to   the   IContentSourceTypeConfiguration   interface .  Reserved   for   future   type - wide   settings   shared   by   all   sources   of   this   type .

entities.Name: MJ :  Content   Sources

Fields.Name: URL
Fields.Description: Base   URL   or   connection   string   for   accessing   this   content   source .

Fields.Name: Configuration

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: For   Entity - type   content   sources ,  the   MJ   Entity   to   pull   records   from .  NULL   for   non - entity   sources  ( files ,  RSS ,  websites ,  etc .).

Fields.Description: For   Entity - type   content   sources ,  the   Entity   Document   template   used   to   render   entity   records   into   text   for   autotagging . Fields.Name: SegmenterKey
Fields.Description: Registration   key   of   the   segmentation   strategy   used   to   split   this   source ' s   content   into   embeddable   chunks  —  for   example   StructuralText  ( document   headings ),  AdaptiveBoundary  ( target   size   closing   on   the   nearest   natural   break ),  SemanticText  ( LLM - detected   topic   boundaries ),  Transcript  ( audio / video   chapters ),  PagedContent  ( one   segment   per   page ),  or   FixedWindow  ( uniform   windows ).  NULL   falls   back   to   the   Content   Type ' s   value ,  then   to   a   built - in   default .

Fields.Name: CleanerKey

Cleaning   is   separate   from   segmentation   because   the   two   change   for   different   reasons :  a   new   site   template   needs   new   selectors ,  not   a   new   chunking   strategy .  NULL   falls   back   to   the   Content   Type ' s   value ,  then   to   a   default   inferred   from   the   content ' s   mime   type .

Fields.Name: ScheduledJobID
Fields.Description: Optional   link   to   the   Scheduled   Job   that   runs   this   content   source   on   a   recurring   basis . Fields.Name: UtteranceEndMs

entities.Name: MJ :  Conversation   Widget   Instances

NULL   means   fall   back   to   the   server - wide   default .  Voice   is   the   biggest   cost / abuse   surface ;  the   SessionJanitor   enforces   this   server - side  ( W4 ).

Fields.Name: EnabledChannels
Fields.Description: Which   MJ   interactive   channels   this   widget   may   attach   when   a   voice   session   is   active ,  as   a   JSON   array   of   channel   names  ( e . g . [" Whiteboard "]).  Resolved   client - side   through   MJGlobal . ClassFactory   the   same   way   the   realtime   client   driver   is   resolved ;  each   named   channel   is   scoped   by   the   existing   Widget   Guest   RLS   on   AI   Agent   Session   Channels .  NULL   or   empty   array  =  no   channels  ( the   backwards - compatible   default ).  Remote   Browser ,  given   its   control   surface ,  should   only   be   listed   when   a   deployment   explicitly   opts   in .

Fields.Name: HostPublicKey
Fields.Description: PEM - encoded   RS256   public   key   for   the   host - identity   auth   strategy  ( D1 ).  When   AuthStrategy   is   HostIdentity ,  the   host   signs   a   short - lived   identity   assertion   with   its   private   key ;  the   HostIdentityProvider   verifies   it   against   this   per - instance   key .  Supersedes   the   interim   config   map  ( mj . config . cjs   hostPublicKeys   keyed   by   PublicKey ).  NULL   when   the   widget   does   not   use   host   identity ;  a   HostIdentity   widget   with   no   key   fails   closed   at   mint .

Fields.Name: RememberReturningVisitors
Fields.Description: Returning - visitor   memory   opt - in  ( R6 ).  When   0  ( default )  this   widget   sets   no   durable   visitor   cookie   and   writes   no   cross - session   recap  —  fully   off .  When   1 ,  the   widget   mints   a   durable   VisitorKey   cookie ,  links   each   new   Conversation   to   the   visitor ' s   prior   one ,  and   writes   a   recap   memory   note   on   close   so   a   returning   visitor ' s   agent   opens   with   prior   context .

Fields.Name: VisitorMemoryRetentionDays
Fields.Description: Retention   window  ( days )  for   returning - visitor   recap   memory   notes   generated   by   this   widget .  NULL   means   use   the   system   default .  Past   this   window   the   visitor ' s   auto - generated   recap   notes   decay / archive   via   the   Memory   Manager .  Ignored   when   RememberReturningVisitors  =  0 .

entities.Name: MJ :  Conversations
entities.Description: Tracks   conversation   sessions   between   users   and   AI   agents   or   between   users ,  including   context ,  participants ,  and   metadata .

Fields.Name: ExternalID
Fields.Description: External   system   identifier   for   cross - system   conversation   tracking .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: The   type   or   category   of   conversation  ( Skip ,  Support ,  Chat ,  etc .).

Fields.Name: IsArchived
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   this   conversation   has   been   archived   and   should   not   appear   in   active   lists .

Fields.Name: LinkedEntityID
Fields.Description: Generic  ' what   is   this   conversation   about ?'  pointer .  Names   the   Entity   whose   record   this   conversation   references  ( e . g .  MJ :  Components   when   the   conversation   was   started   in   the   Form   Builder   cockpit   about   a   specific   form ).  Paired   with   LinkedRecordID   via   the   CK_Conversation_LinkBinding   cross - column   CHECK  —  both   NULL   or   both   populated .  Surfaces   use   this   to   filter   their   conversation   list   to   entries   about   the   currently - loaded   record  ( e . g . ' show   prior   conversations   about   THIS   form ').  Reusable   beyond   Form   Builder   by   any   future   dashboard  /  record - context   surface   that   wants   the   same   UX   without   further   schema   work .

Fields.Name: LinkedRecordID
Fields.Description: The   primary   key   of   the   record   this   conversation   is   about ,  serialized   as   a   string   so   any   entity   type   can   be   referenced   regardless   of   its   PK   shape  ( UUID ,  int ,  composite ).  Used   together   with   LinkedEntityID  —  see   CK_Conversation_LinkBinding .  Wide   enough  ( NVARCHAR ( 500 )  in   the   baseline   schema )  to   handle   chunky   composite   keys .  Surfaces   query   by  ( LinkedEntityID ,  LinkedRecordID ) —  or   by   LinkedRecordID   IN  (...)  when   a   lineage   of   records   shares   conversation   context  ( e . g .  multiple   Component   versions   of   the   same   form   lineage ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Tracks   the   processing   status   of   the   conversation :  Available ,  Processing

Fields.Name: IsPinned
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   this   conversation   is   pinned   to   the   top   of   lists

Fields.Name: TestRunID
Fields.Description: Optional   Foreign   Key  -  Links   this   conversation   to   a   test   run   if   this   conversation   was   generated   as   part   of   a   test .  Enables   tracking   test   conversations   separately   from   production   conversations .

Fields.Name: ApplicationScope
Fields.Description: Controls   where   this   conversation   surfaces   in   the   UI .  Global  =  appears   in   the   main   Chat   app  ( no   application   binding ).  Application  =  scoped   to   a   specific   Application ' s   embedded   chat   surface  ( e . g .  the   Form   Builder   cockpit );  hidden   from   the   main   chat   list   by   default .  Both  =  explicitly   promoted   to   appear   in   BOTH   the   main   chat   list   and   the   bound   Application ' s   embedded   surface .  Defaults   to   Global   so   pre - existing   conversations   stay   visible   in   main   chat .  Paired   with   ApplicationID   via   a   cross - column   CHECK   constraint :  Global  =>  ApplicationID   IS   NULL ;  Application   or   Both  =>  ApplicationID   IS   NOT   NULL .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Optional   Application   this   conversation   is   bound   to .  Required   when   ApplicationScope   is  ' Application '  or  ' Both ';  must   be   NULL   when   ApplicationScope   is  ' Global '.  Enforced   by   the   CK_Conversation_ScopeAppBinding   cross - column   CHECK .  Used   by   embedded   chat   surfaces  ( e . g .  the   Form   Builder   cockpit )  to   filter   their   conversation   list   to   just   their   own   application ' s   conversations .

Fields.Name: DefaultAgentID
Fields.Description: Optional   per - conversation   default   AI   agent .  When   set ,  the   message   router   targets   this   agent   for   non - mention ,  non - continuity   messages   instead   of   falling   through   to   the   embedder - supplied   default  ( e . g .  Form   Builder )  or   to   Sage .  Lets   a   user   pin   a   conversation   to   a   specific   specialist   agent  ( e . g .  Research   Agent )  so   Sage   is   never   invoked   for   that   thread .  Routing   precedence : @ mention  >  continuity  ( last   responder ) >  Conversation . DefaultAgentID  >  embedder ' s   defaultAgentId   input  >  Sage   fallback .

Fields.Name: AdditionalData
Fields.Description: Free - form   JSON   extensibility   column .  Apps   that   want   to   attach   conversation - scoped   metadata  ( UI   state ,  draft   notes ,  custom   analytics   tags ,  etc .)  can   stuff   it   here   without   a   schema   change . ** Namespace   your   keys **  to   avoid   collisions   across   apps  —  store   e . g . {" form - builder . lastPreviewRecordId ":"..."," my - app . fooFlag ": true }  rather   than   top - level   lastPreviewRecordId .  Core   MJ   code   paths   do   NOT   read   this   column ;  it ' s   purely   for   downstream   apps .  NVARCHAR ( MAX )  so   callers   can   store   arbitrarily   large   blobs ,  but   treat   that   as   a   smell  —  heavy   data   belongs   in   a   real   entity ,  not   a   JSON   dump .

Fields.Name: RecordingFileID
Fields.Description: For   a   Meeting - Room   conversation ,  the   MJ :  Files   row   holding   the   room - level   composite   recording  ( the   LiveKit   egress   MP4 ,  copied   into   MJStorage ).  NULL   when   the   meeting   was   not   recorded .

Fields.Name: EgressID
Fields.Description: The   LiveKit   egress   session   id   for   this   meeting ' s   room   recording .  Set   when   recording   starts ;  used   to   stop   the   egress   and   to   correlate   the   egress - completion   result   with   this   conversation .  NULL   when   the   meeting   was   not   recorded .

Fields.Name: VisitorKey
Fields.Description: Durable ,  opaque   returning - visitor   anchor  ( R3 ).  Holds   the   value   of   a   long - lived   first - party   cookie   minted   by   the   widget   on   first   visit ,  used   to   find   this   visitor ' s   prior   conversations   while   they   are   still   anonymous .  Distinct   from   ExternalID  ( which   stays   per - session   for   RLS   isolation ).  NULL   for   conversations   that   are   not   widget   returning - visitor   sessions .

Fields.Name: LastConversationID
Fields.Description: Conversation - altitude   returning - visitor   chain  ( R2 ).  Self - foreign - key   to   the   visitor ' s   immediately   prior   Conversation  ( found   by   VisitorKey   or   the   resolved   LinkedEntityID / LinkedRecordID   pair   at   mint   time ).  History   and   memory   are   conversation - scoped ,  so   the   chain   lives   here  —  NOT   on   AIAgentSession . LastSessionID ,  which   owns   reconnect / resume   semantics   and   is   walked   by   the   replay   viewer .  Named   to   mirror   AIAgentSession . LastSessionID .  NULL   for   a   brand - new   visitor ' s   first   conversation .

entities.Name: MJ :  Countries
entities.Description: Reference   table   for   countries   with   ISO   3166 - 1   codes ,  geographic   centroids ,  and   optional   medium - resolution   boundary   GeoJSON   for   choropleth   rendering .  Seeded   with  ~ 250   countries .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Full   country   name  ( e . g ., " United   States ", " Canada ").

Fields.Name: ISO2
Fields.Description: ISO   3166 - 1   alpha - 2   code  ( e . g ., " US ", " CA ").  Unique   business   key   for   lookups .

Fields.Name: ISO3
Fields.Description: ISO   3166 - 1   alpha - 3   code  ( e . g ., " USA ", " CAN ").  Unique   business   key   for   lookups .

Fields.Name: NumericCode
Fields.Description: ISO   3166 - 1   numeric   code  ( e . g .,  840   for   US ,  124   for   Canada ).

Fields.Name: Latitude
Fields.Description: Geographic   centroid   latitude .  Used   as   fallback   point   for   country - level   geocoding .

Fields.Name: Longitude
Fields.Description: Geographic   centroid   longitude .  Used   as   fallback   point   for   country - level   geocoding .

Fields.Name: BoundaryGeoJSON
Fields.Description: Medium - resolution  (~ 50m )  GeoJSON   boundary   polygon   for   choropleth   map   rendering .  Nullable  —  point   map   falls   back   to   centroid   if   absent .  Total  ~ 3MB   for   all   countries .

Fields.Name: CommonAliases
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   common   aliases   and   alternate   names  ( e . g ., [" United   States "," USA "," U . S ."," America "]).  Used   by   GeoResolver   for   fuzzy   text - to - country   matching .

entities.Name: MJ :  Credential   Categories
entities.Description: Hierarchical   organization   for   credentials .  Allows   grouping   credentials   by   service   type ,  department ,  or   any   organizational   structure .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   category .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   the   category .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Parent   category   for   hierarchical   organization .  NULL   for   root   categories .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   for   UI   display  ( e . g .,  fa - solid   fa - folder ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Credential   Types
entities.Description: Defines   credential   templates   for   different   services  ( e . g .,  OpenAI ,  SendGrid ).  Uses   JSON   Schema   to   define   required   fields   and   validation   rules .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   for   the   credential   type  ( e . g .,  OpenAI ,  SendGrid ,  AWS   S3 ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   the   credential   type .

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: High - level   category :  AI ,  Communication ,  Storage ,  Authentication ,  Database ,  or   Integration .

Fields.Name: FieldSchema
Fields.Description: JSON   Schema   defining   the   required   fields   for   this   credential   type .  Includes   field   names ,  types ,  validation   rules ,  and   UI   hints .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   for   UI   display  ( e . g .,  fa - brands   fa - openai ).

Fields.Name: ValidationEndpoint
Fields.Description: Optional   URL   endpoint   to   validate   credentials   against   the   service   provider .

entities.Name: MJ :  Credentials
entities.Description: Stores   credential   instances   with   encrypted   values .  All   access   should   go   through   CredentialEngine   for   proper   audit   logging .

Fields.Name: CredentialTypeID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   credential   type   that   defines   the   schema   for   this   credential .

Fields.Name: CategoryID
Fields.Description: Optional   category   for   organizational   grouping .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   for   this   credential  ( e . g .,  Production   SendGrid ,  Development   OpenAI ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   this   credential   instance .

Fields.Name: Values
Fields.Description: Encrypted   JSON   blob   containing   all   credential   values .  This   field   uses   MemberJunction   field - level   encryption .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   is   the   default   credential   for   its   type   when   no   specific   credential   is   requested .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: If   false ,  the   credential   is   disabled   and   will   not   be   used .

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Optional   expiration   date .  Expired   credentials   are   treated   as   inactive .

Fields.Name: LastValidatedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   successful   validation   against   the   provider .

Fields.Name: LastUsedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   time   this   credential   was   used .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Optional   Font   Awesome   icon   class   to   override   the   type   icon   for   this   specific   credential .

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   Categories
entities.Description: Organizes   dashboards   into   logical   groupings   for   navigation   and   access   control ,  supporting   hierarchical   categorization .

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   Category   Links
entities.Description: Allows   users   to   organize   shared   dashboards   into   their   own   category   structure .  Creates   a   link / reference   to   a   dashboard   without   duplicating   it .  Users   can   optionally   provide   a   custom   display   name   and   control   ordering   within   their   folders .

Fields.Name: DashboardCategoryID
Fields.Description: The   category   in   the   user ' s   personal   folder   structure .  NULL   means   the   dashboard   appears   at   root   level .

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: Optional   user - friendly   alias   for   the   dashboard   within   this   user ' s   view .  If   NULL ,  uses   the   original   dashboard   name .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   of   this   dashboard   within   the   user ' s   category .  Lower   values   appear   first .

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   Category   Permissions
entities.Description: Manages   user   permissions   for   dashboard   categories  ( folders ).  Permissions   cascade   to   all   dashboards   within   the   category .  Enables   sharing   entire   folders   of   dashboards   with   granular   access   control .

Fields.Name: CanRead
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   view   dashboards   within   this   category

Fields.Name: CanEdit
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   modify   dashboards   within   this   category

Fields.Name: CanAddRemove
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   add   new   dashboards   to   or   remove   dashboards   from   this   category

Fields.Name: CanShare
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   share   this   category   with   other   users

Fields.Name: SharedByUserID
Fields.Description: The   user   who   granted   this   permission .  NULL   if   shared   by   the   category   owner .

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   Part   Types
entities.Description: Stores   available   panel   types   for   metadata - driven   dashboards .  Each   panel   type   defines   a   driver   class   for   rendering   content   and   an   optional   config   dialog   for   setup   UI .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   for   the   panel   type  ( e . g .,  View ,  Query ,  Artifact ,  WebURL ,  Custom )

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   what   this   panel   type   displays   and   its   capabilities

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   for   the   panel   type  ( e . g .,  fa - solid   fa - table )

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: The  @ RegisterClass   name   for   the   panel   renderer   component   that   extends   DashboardBasePanelRenderer

Fields.Name: ConfigDialogClass
Fields.Description: The  @ RegisterClass   name   for   the   configuration   dialog   component   that   extends   DashboardBasePanelConfigDialog

Fields.Name: DefaultConfig
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   default   configuration   values   for   new   panels   of   this   type

Fields.Name: SortOrder
Fields.Description: Display   order   in   panel   type   selection   UI  ( lower   numbers   appear   first )

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   panel   type   is   currently   available   for   use

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   Permissions
entities.Description: Manages   user   permissions   for   dashboards   with   granular   access   control  ( Read ,  Edit ,  Delete ,  Share ).  Each   record   grants   a   specific   user   access   to   a   dashboard   with   configurable   permission   levels .

Fields.Name: CanRead
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   view   the   dashboard   and   its   contents

Fields.Name: CanEdit
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   modify   the   dashboard   layout ,  add / remove   parts ,  or   change   settings

Fields.Name: CanDelete
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   delete   the   dashboard   entirely

Fields.Name: CanShare
Fields.Description: Whether   the   user   can   share   the   dashboard   with   other   users

Fields.Name: SharedByUserID
Fields.Description: The   user   who   granted   this   permission .  NULL   if   shared   by   the   dashboard   owner .

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   User   Preferences
entities.Description: Stores   dashboard   preferences   for   users   and   system   defaults .  The   absence   of   a   record   for   a   dashboard   means   it   is   not   shown .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: User   that   these   preferences   belong   to ,  NULL   for   system   defaults

Fields.Name: DashboardID
Fields.Description: Dashboard   that   this   preference   refers   to

Fields.Name: Scope
Fields.Description: Scope   of   the   preference  ( Global   or   App )

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Application   that   this   preference   applies   to  ( only   for   App   scope )

Fields.Name: DisplayOrder
Fields.Description: Order   in   which   to   display   the   dashboard

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboard   User   States
entities.Description: Stores   user - specific   dashboard   state   information

Fields.Name: DashboardID
Fields.Description: Dashboard   that   this   state   applies   to

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: User   that   this   state   belongs   to

Fields.Name: UserState
Fields.Description: JSON   object   containing   user - specific   dashboard   state

entities.Name: MJ :  Dashboards
entities.Description: Dashboards   are   used   to   group   resources   into   a   single   display   pane   for   an   end - user

Fields.Name: UIConfigDetails
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   defining   the   dashboard   layout ,  widgets ,  data   sources ,  and   display   options .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Dashboard   type   supporting   Config  ( metadata - driven ),  Code  ( compiled   TypeScript ),  and   Dynamic   Code  ( Skip - generated   runtime   JavaScript / React )  options

Fields.Name: Thumbnail
Fields.Description: Base64   encoded   image   or   URL   to   an   image   thumbnail   for   the   dashboard

Fields.Name: Scope
Fields.Description: Scope   of   the   dashboard :  Global   or   App - specific

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Associated   Application   ID   if   Scope   is   App ,  otherwise   NULL

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Specifies   the   runtime   class   that   will   be   used   for   the   Dashboard   when   Type   is   set   to  ' Code '.  This   class   contains   the   custom   logic   and   implementation   for   code - based   dashboards .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Used   to   identify   the   dashboard   for   code - base   dashboards .  Allows   reuse   of   the   same   DriverClass   for   multiple   dashboards   that   can   be   rendered   differently .

entities.Name: MJ :  Data   Context   Items
entities.Description: Data   Context   Items   store   information   about   each   item   within   a   Data   Context .  Each   item   stores   a   link   to   a   view ,  query ,  or   raw   sql   statement   and   can   optionally   cache   the   JSON   representing   the   last   run   of   that   data   object   as   well .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: The   type   of   the   item ,  either  " view ", " query ", " full_entity ", " single_record ",  or  " sql "

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   Primary   Key   value   for   the   record ,  only   used   when   Type =' single_record '

Fields.Name: SQL
Fields.Description: Only   used   when   Type = sql

Fields.Name: DataJSON
Fields.Description: Optionally   used   to   cache   results   of   an   item .  This   can   be   used   for   performance   optimization ,  and   also   for   having   snapshots   of   data   for   historical   comparisons .

Fields.Name: LastRefreshedAt
Fields.Description: If   DataJSON   is   populated ,  this   field   will   show   the   date   the   the   data   was   captured

Fields.Name: CodeName
Fields.Description: Optional   programmatic   identifier   for   this   data   context   item .  Must   be   unique   within   the   DataContext   and   follow   JavaScript   naming   conventions  ( letters ,  numbers ,  underscore ,  starting   with   letter   or   underscore ).  Used   for   improved   code   generation   and   programmatic   access   to   data   context   items .

entities.Name: MJ :  Data   Contexts
entities.Description: Data   Contexts   are   a   primitive   within   the   MemberJunction   architecture .  They   store   information   about   data   contexts   which   are   groups   of   data   including   views ,  queries ,  or   raw   SQL   statements .  Data   contexts   can   be   used   in   conversations ,  reports   and   more .

Fields.Name: LastRefreshedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   the   data   in   this   context   was   last   refreshed   or   recalculated .

entities.Name: MJ :  Dataset   Items
entities.Description: A   single   item   in   a   Dataset   and   can   be   sourced   from   multiple   methods .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Unique   code   identifier   for   this   dataset   item   within   its   parent   dataset .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Order   in   which   this   item   should   be   processed   or   displayed   within   the   dataset .

Fields.Name: WhereClause
Fields.Description: SQL   WHERE   clause   to   filter   data   when   this   dataset   item   is   sourced   from   a   query .

Fields.Name: DateFieldToCheck
Fields.Description: The   date   field   name   used   for   incremental   updates   and   change   detection .

Fields.Name: Columns
Fields.Description: Optional   column   to   store   a   comma - delimited   list   of   columns   for   the   DatasetItem

entities.Name: MJ :  Datasets
