Fields.Description: SQL   expression   template   when   NormalizationStrategy   is   Custom .  Uses  {{ FieldName }}  as   placeholder .  Example : " REPLACE ( REPLACE ({{ FieldName }}, '-', ''), ' ', '')"  for   phone   number   normalization .

Fields.Name: AutoCreateRelatedViewOnForm
Fields.Description: When   true ,  a   future   discovery   process   will   automatically   scan   entities   and   create   EntityOrganicKeyRelatedEntity   rows   for   entities   with   matching   field   patterns .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ordering   when   an   entity   has   multiple   organic   keys .  Lower   values  =  higher   priority .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Active   or   Disabled .  Disabled   keys   are   ignored   at   runtime .

entities.Name: MJ :  Entity   Permissions
entities.Description: Security   settings   for   each   entity

Fields.Name: CanCreate
Fields.Description: Whether   the   role / user   can   create   new   records   in   this   entity .

Fields.Name: CanRead
Fields.Description: Whether   the   role / user   can   read / view   records   in   this   entity .

Fields.Name: CanUpdate
Fields.Description: Whether   the   role / user   can   update   existing   records   in   this   entity .

Fields.Name: CanDelete
Fields.Description: Whether   the   role / user   can   delete   records   from   this   entity .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Allow   or   Deny .  Deny   rows   override   any   Allow   grants   on   the   same  ( EntityID ,  RoleID ,  action )  at   evaluation   time ,  letting   administrators   exclude   a   role   from   an   action   another   role   grants .

entities.Name: MJ :  Entity   Record   Documents
entities.Description: Stores   the   output   for   a   given   entity   record   for   a   specific   Entity   Document .  For   example   if   a  " Person "  entity   had   a   particular   template   that   outputted   First   and   Last   name   like  "#{{ FirstName }}\ n #{{ LastName }}"  the   Entity   Record   Document   would   have   a   row   for   each   entity   record   in   the   Person   entity   that   was   run   through   that   particular   document   and   have   row   values   such   as  "# Jane \ n # Doe "  and  "# Mark \ n # Smith ".

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   ID   of   the   entity   record   this   document   was   generated   for .

Fields.Name: DocumentText
Fields.Description: The   generated   document   text   after   template   processing .

Fields.Name: VectorID
Fields.Description: Reference   to   the   vector   embedding   of   this   document   if   AI   search   is   enabled .

Fields.Name: VectorJSON
Fields.Description: JSON   representation   of   the   vector   embedding   for   this   document .

Fields.Name: EntityRecordUpdatedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   the   source   entity   record   was   last   updated .

entities.Name: MJ :  Entity   Relationship   Display   Components
entities.Description: This   table   stores   a   list   of   components   that   are   available   for   displaying   relationships   in   the   MJ   Explorer   UI

Fields.Name: RelationshipType
Fields.Description: The   type   of   relationship   the   component   displays .  Valid   values   are  " One   to   Many ", " Many   to   Many ",  or  " Both ".

entities.Name: MJ :  Entity   Relationships
entities.Description: Metadata   about   relationships   between   entities   including   display   preferences   for   the   UI

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Used   for   display   order   in   generated   forms   and   in   other   places   in   the   UI   where   relationships   for   an   entity   are   shown

Fields.Name: BundleInAPI
Fields.Description: Whether   to   include   related   records   when   fetching   the   parent   entity   via   API .

Fields.Name: IncludeInParentAllQuery
Fields.Description: Whether   to   include   this   relationship   when   querying   all   fields   of   the   parent   entity .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: The   cardinality   of   the   relationship  ( One   To   Many ,  Many   To   Many ,  One   To   One ).

Fields.Name: EntityKeyField
Fields.Description: The   primary   key   field   of   the   parent   entity   in   this   relationship .

Fields.Name: RelatedEntityJoinField
Fields.Description: The   foreign   key   field   in   the   related   entity   that   references   the   parent .

Fields.Name: JoinView
Fields.Description: For   many - to - many   relationships ,  the   view   containing   the   junction   data .

Fields.Name: JoinEntityJoinField
Fields.Description: For   many - to - many ,  the   field   in   the   junction   table   linking   to   the   parent   entity .

Fields.Name: JoinEntityInverseJoinField
Fields.Description: For   many - to - many ,  the   field   in   the   junction   table   linking   to   the   related   entity .

Fields.Name: DisplayInForm
Fields.Description: When   unchecked   the   relationship   will   NOT   be   displayed   on   the   generated   form

Fields.Name: DisplayLocation
Fields.Description: Where   to   display   this   relationship   in   the   UI   relative   to   other   entity   elements .

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: Optional ,  when   specified   this   value   overrides   the   related   entity   name   for   the   label   on   the   tab

Fields.Name: DisplayIconType
Fields.Description: When   Related   Entity   Icon  -  uses   the   icon   from   the   related   entity ,  if   one   exists .  When   Custom ,  uses   the   value   in   the   DisplayIcon   field   in   this   record ,  and   when   None ,  no   icon   is   displayed

Fields.Name: DisplayIcon
Fields.Description: If   specified ,  the   icon

Fields.Name: DisplayComponentConfiguration
Fields.Description: If   DisplayComponentID   is   specified ,  this   field   can   optionally   be   used   to   track   component - specific   and   relationship - specific   configuration   details   that   will   be   used   by   CodeGen   to   provide   to   the   display   component   selected .

Fields.Name: AutoUpdateFromSchema
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   relationship   should   be   automatically   updated   by   CodeGen .  When   set   to   0 ,  the   record   will   not   be   modified   by   CodeGen .  Defaults   to   1 .

Fields.Name: AdditionalFieldsToInclude
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   additional   field   names   to   include   when   joining   through   this   relationship  ( for   junction   tables ,  e . g ., [" RoleName ", " UserEmail "])

Fields.Name: AutoUpdateAdditionalFieldsToInclude
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  allows   system / LLM   to   auto - update   AdditionalFieldsToInclude ;  when   0 ,  user   has   locked   this   field

Fields.Name: RelatedRecordCollection
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   policy   object   that   declares   this   relationship   as   a   first - class   related - record   collection ,  so   CodeGen   can   emit   a   typed   DeclareRelatedRecords (...)  declaration   on   the   entity   subclass .  Shape   is   IRelatedRecordCollectionConfig :  Name  ( the   generated   property   name ,  e . g . " Lines "),  Load  (' explicit ' | ' immediate ' | ' lazy ' | ' never '),  Source  (' database ' | ' cache '),  ReadOnly ,  OnRemove  (' delete ' | ' orphan ' | ' refuse '),  OrderBy ,  Sequence  ({  Field ,  From  }),  and   ClearAfterSave .  Source  ' cache '  reads   the   related   records   from   whichever   loaded   BaseEngine   already   holds   that   entity ,  costing   no   query ,  and   defaults   ReadOnly   to   true   because   those   are   the   engine ' s   own   instances ; ' lazy '  fills   on   first   access   and   requires   both .  RelatedEntity   and   RelatedEntityJoinField   are   NOT   repeated   here  —  they   are   read   from   this   row ' s   own   columns .  NULL   means   the   relationship   is   not   a   declared   collection ,  which   is   the   default   and   reproduces   pre - 6 . 2   behaviour   exactly .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   configuration   bag   for   this   relationship  ( shape  =  IEntityRelationshipConfiguration ).  Nested   UI . FormRole   is   Primary  ( first - class   chrome )  or   Detail  ( parked   in   a   More   group ).  Distinct   from   RelatedRecordCollection  ( composite - graph   policy ),  DisplayComponentConfiguration  ( selected   display - component   knobs ),  and   AdditionalFieldsToInclude  ( join - field   names ) —  those   columns   are   owned   by   CodeGen   for   other   jobs .  NULL  /  omitted   keys  =  today ' s   behavior  ( the   relationship   is   first - class   when   DisplayInForm   is   set ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Experiment   Session   Iterations
entities.Description: A   GENERIC   single   attempt   within   an   ExperimentSession  —  the   polymorphic   anchor   and   the   leaderboard   unit .  Owns   the   cross - cutting  " attempt "  accounting   every   experiment   type   shares :  sequence ,  status ,  the   normalized   Score ,  compute / token   cost ,  the   agent   reasoning   for   trying   it ,  and  ( optionally )  the   AI   Agent   Run   that   executed   it .  Consumer - specific   detail   hangs   off   this   row :  Predictive   Studio   attaches   an   MLTrainingRun ;  a   future   prompt - optimization   consumer   would   attach   its   own   leaf   run   table   the   same   way .

Fields.Name: ExperimentSessionID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   ExperimentSession   this   iteration   belongs   to

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Order   of   this   iteration   within   its   session

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: Optional   human - readable   label   for   the   attempt  ( e . g ., " XGBoost  +  engagement   features ")

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Iteration   status :  Pending ,  Running ,  Completed ,  Failed ,  or   Pruned

Fields.Name: Score
Fields.Description: The   normalized   metric   value   this   iteration   achieved  ( the   parent   Experiment ' s   TargetMetric ) —  used   to   rank   the   leaderboard

Fields.Name: ComputeCost
Fields.Description: Compute   cost   attributed   to   this   iteration ,  for   budget   enforcement

Fields.Name: TokensUsed
Fields.Description: LLM   tokens   used   by   this   iteration  ( e . g .,  agent   internal   choice   prompts ),  for   budget   enforcement

Fields.Name: AIAgentRunID

entities.Name: MJ :  Experiment   Sessions
entities.Description: A   GENERIC   single   execution   of   an   Experiment :  a   budgeted ,  plan - then - execute - then - refine   search   that   groups   N   iterations ,  maintains   a   leaderboard ,  and   is   driven   by   an   owning   agent   run   with   a   human   approval   gate .  ML - agnostic  —  the   ML - specific   work   hangs   off   ExperimentSessionIteration   via   MLTrainingRun .  The   execution   phase   runs   iterations   in   WAVES   through   Record   Set   Processing  ( bounded   concurrency ,  budget ,  pause / resume ,  audit ),  with   the   adaptive   prune / what - next   logic   above   it .

Fields.Name: ExperimentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Experiment   definition   this   session   executes

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   of   this   session / execution

Fields.Name: Goal
Fields.Description: Optional   per - session   objective   override  ( defaults   to   the   parent   Experiment ' s   Goal )

Fields.Name: Budget
Fields.Description: JSON   budget   bounding   autonomy   for   this   session :  max   compute - cost  /  max   iterations  /  max   wallclock

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Planning ,  AwaitingApproval ,  Running ,  Paused ,  Completed ,  or   Cancelled

Fields.Name: PlanSpec
Fields.Description: JSON   of   the   approved   plan   the   deterministic   orchestrator   executes   for   this   session  ( consumer - specific   shape ;  for   Predictive   Studio   this   is   the   ModelingPlanSpec ).  Opaque   to   the   generic   substrate .

Fields.Name: Leaderboard
Fields.Description: JSON   snapshot   of   the   best   iterations   so   far  ( also   derivable   from   ExperimentSessionIteration   scores )

Fields.Name: AgentRunID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MJ :  AI   Agent   Run   that   owns / drives   this   session

entities.Name: MJ :  Experiments
entities.Description: A   GENERIC ,  reusable   definition   of   an   experiment  —  the   durable  " what   we   are   trying   to   optimize ,"  independent   of   any   single   execution .  Each   kick - off   of   the   experiment   creates   an   ExperimentSession   under   it  ( so   retraining / re - optimizing   monthly  =  new   sessions   under   the   same   Experiment ,  enabling   comparison   over   time ).  Deliberately   NOT   ML - specific :  ExperimentType   discriminates   the   consumer  ( MLModelSearch ,  PromptOptimization ,  AgentConfigSearch , ...)  so   prompt - optimization ,  agent - config   search ,  and   eval   sweeps   reuse   the   same   Experiment / Session / Iteration   substrate .  Predictive   Studio   is   the   first   consumer .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   of   the   experiment

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   the   experiment

Fields.Name: ExperimentType
Fields.Description: Discriminator   naming   the   kind   of   experiment  /  consuming   subsystem  ( e . g ., " MLModelSearch ", " PromptOptimization ", " AgentConfigSearch ").  Intentionally   an   open   NVARCHAR  ( no   CHECK   constraint )  so   new   consumers   can   introduce   types   without   a   schema   migration .

Fields.Name: Goal
Fields.Description: Natural - language   objective   of   the   experiment  ( e . g ., " maximize   holdout   AUC   for   renewal   prediction ")

Fields.Name: TargetMetric
Fields.Description: The   metric   the   experiment   optimizes  ( e . g ., " AUC ", " F1 ", " RMSE ") —  the   normalized   number   iterations   are   scored   and   ranked   by

Fields.Name: PlanSpecTemplate
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   reusable   plan   template   that   seeds   new   sessions '  PlanSpec  ( consumer - specific   shape ;  opaque   to   the   generic   substrate )

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Active   or   Archived

Provable - only :  leave   NULL   if   docs   do   not   name   a   watermark   field .

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Algorithm   Use   Case   Rankings
entities.Description: Codifies   how   well   each   algorithm   fits   each   use - case   scenario ,  so   both   the   model - development   agent   and   a   non - expert   human   get   guided ,  rationale - bearing   defaults   instead   of   guessing .  One   row   per  ( algorithm ,  use   case )  pair .

Fields.Name: MLAlgorithmID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   algorithm   being   ranked

Fields.Name: MLAlgorithmUseCaseID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   use - case   scenario   the   algorithm   is   ranked   for

Fields.Name: SuitabilityScore
Fields.Description: Numeric   suitability   for   sorting / ranking ,  1  ( worst )  to   5  ( best )

Fields.Name: RecommendationLevel
Fields.Description: Categorical   recommendation :  Primary ,  Strong ,  Viable ,  Weak ,  or   NotRecommended

Fields.Name: Rationale
Fields.Description: Plain - language   explanation   of   the   ranking ,  readable   by   both   agents   and   humans  ( e . g ., " Gives   feature   importances   but   not   simple   coefficients  —  if   a   stakeholder   needs   to   see   exactly   why   each   prediction   was   made ,  prefer   Logistic / Ridge .")

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Algorithm   Use   Cases
entities.Description: A   curated ,  decision - relevant   scenario   used   to   guide   algorithm   choice  —  NOT   a   business   label  ( churn / renewal / attendee - return   are   all   the   same  " binary   classification "  shape ,  so   they   do   not   differentiate   algorithms ).  Joined   to   MLAlgorithm   via   MLAlgorithmUseCaseRanking .  EXAMPLES : " Binary   classification  ( yes / no )", " Regression  ( predict   a   number )", " Interpretability   required ", " Minimal   tuning  ( business - user )", " Large / wide   dataset  ( speed )", " Embedding / LLM - feature - heavy ", " Small   dataset ".

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   scenario  ( e . g ., " Interpretability   required ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   the   scenario

Fields.Name: ProblemTypeScope
Fields.Description: Which   problem   type   this   scenario   applies   to :  classification ,  regression ,  or   any

Fields.Name: Guidance
Fields.Description: Longer   agent - readable   guidance   on   when   this   scenario   applies   and   what   it   implies   for   algorithm   choice

Fields.Name: DisplayOrder
Fields.Description: Ordering   hint   for   displaying   scenarios   in   the   UI

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Algorithms
entities.Description: Curated ,  fixed   catalog   of   machine - learning   algorithms   a   Training   Pipeline   can   use .  Opinionated   by   design  ( a   small   set   of   well - understood   algorithms );  the   differentiation   is   in   the   data / features ,  not   algorithm   innovation .  Each   row   declares   the   algorithm ' s   supported   problem   types ,  its   hyperparameter   schema ,  and   the   Python - sidecar   driver   key   that   executes   it .  EXAMPLE : " Gradient   Boosting  ( XGBoost )"  with   DriverClass  " xgboost ".

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   algorithm  ( e . g ., " Gradient   Boosting  ( XGBoost )", " Logistic   Regression ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   the   algorithm   and   when   to   use   it

Fields.Name: ProblemTypes
Fields.Description: Comma - delimited   list   of   supported   problem   types  ( e . g ., " classification ", " regression ",  or  " classification , regression ")

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: Algorithm   key   passed   to   the   Python   training / inference   sidecar  ( e . g ., " xgboost ", " lightgbm ", " logistic_regression ", " random_forest ", " ridge ", " mlp ")

Fields.Name: HyperparameterSchema
Fields.Description: JSON   Schema   describing   the   algorithm ' s   tunable   hyperparameters  ( drives   the   UI   form   and   validation )

Fields.Name: DefaultHyperparameters
Fields.Description: JSON   object   of   default   hyperparameter   values   applied   when   a   pipeline   does   not   override   them

Fields.Name: SupportsFeatureImportance
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   algorithm   produces   per - feature   importance   scores   used   for   explainability   and   the   leakage   guard

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Active  ( selectable )  or   Deprecated

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Model   Scoring   Bindings
entities.Description: Binds   an   MLModel   to   where   it   scores ,  so   staleness   can   be   detected   and   retraining   driven  ( maintenance ).  The   scoring   itself   runs   as   a   Record   Process  ( the   new   ML   inference   work   type );  the   binding   records   the   target   entity / column   written   and   the   scoring   mode .  MaterializedResultID   is   a   forward - compatible   SOFT   reference   to   MJ :  Materialized   Results  ( PR  # 2770 ),  not   yet   a   FK   because   that   table   is   not   merged .

Fields.Name: MLModelID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MLModel   that   does   the   scoring

Fields.Name: RecordProcessID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Record   Process   that   runs   the   ML   inference   work   for   this   binding

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   entity   that   receives   the   prediction  ( when   scores   are   written   back )

Fields.Name: TargetColumn
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   column   that   receives   the   prediction  ( when   scores   are   written   back  /  materialized )

Fields.Name: Mode
Fields.Description: Scoring   mode :  OnDemand ,  Scheduled ,  or   Materialized

Fields.Name: MaterializedResultID
Fields.Description: Soft   reference   to   a   MJ :  Materialized   Results   row  ( PR  # 2770 )  when   Mode = Materialized ;  not   a   FK   until   that   table   exists

Fields.Name: LastScoredAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   most   recent   scoring   run   for   this   binding

Fields.Name: LastRowCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   records   scored   in   the   most   recent   scoring   run

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Models
entities.Description: An   immutable ,  versioned   trained   predictive   model   produced   by   a   training   run  —  distinct   from   MJ :  AI   Models  ( the   catalog   of   off - the - shelf   foundation   models   we   CALL ).  A   model   is   never   mutated   in   place ;  retraining   produces   a   new   MLModel .  The   serialized   artifact   lives   in   MJStorage  ( MJ :  Files )  and   the   FITTED   preprocessing   parameters   travel   WITH   the   model   so   inference   applies   the   exact   transforms   learned   at   training   time  ( prevents   train / serve   skew ).  Inference   runs   via   the   Python   sidecar .

Fields.Name: PipelineID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   ML   Training   Pipeline   that   produced   this   model  ( lineage )

Fields.Name: Version
Fields.Description: Monotonic   version   number   of   this   model   under   its   pipeline

Fields.Name: AlgorithmID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   algorithm   used   to   train   this   model

Fields.Name: ArtifactFileID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MJ :  Files   record   holding   the   serialized   model   artifact   in   MJStorage

Fields.Name: FittedPreprocessing
Fields.Description: JSON   of   the   fitted   preprocessing   parameters  ( means / std ,  one - hot   vocabularies ,  bin   edges ,  imputation   fills )  learned   at   training   time   and   re - applied   verbatim   at   inference  —  the   anti   train / serve   skew   payload

Fields.Name: FeatureSchema
Fields.Description: JSON   ordered   list   of   feature   names  +  kinds   the   model   expects   as   input  ( the   inference   input   contract )

Fields.Name: TargetVariable
Fields.Description: The   label   this   model   predicts

Fields.Name: ProblemType
Fields.Description: Problem   type :  classification   or   regression

Fields.Name: Metrics
Fields.Description: JSON   of   training  +  validation   metrics  ( AUC ,  F1 ,  accuracy ,  RMSE ,  etc .)

Fields.Name: HoldoutMetrics
Fields.Description: JSON   metrics   on   the   locked   holdout   set   the   search   never   saw  —  scored   exactly   once   for   an   honest   performance   number

Fields.Name: FeatureImportance
Fields.Description: JSON   per - feature   importance / contribution   for   explainability   and   the   leakage   guard

Fields.Name: Lineage
Fields.Description: JSON   lineage :  data   version ( s ),  pipeline   version ,  source   bindings ,  as - of   date ,  sidecar   version ,  and   any   embedding / LLM   model   versions   used   to   build   features

Fields.Name: TrainedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   training   completed

Fields.Name: TrainingDurationSec
Fields.Description: Wall - clock   training   duration   in   seconds

Fields.Name: TrainingRowCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   rows   used   to   train   the   model

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Draft ,  Validated ,  Published ,  or   Archived

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Training   Pipelines
entities.Description: A   declarative   definition   of   how   to   build   a   predictive   model :  what   to   predict  ( target ),  over   which   entity ' s   records ,  using   which   algorithm ,  assembled   from   which   sources   via   which   feature   steps ,  validated   how .  Saving   a   pipeline   saves   intent ,  not   results  —  each   successful   training   run   of   it   produces   an   immutable   MLModel .  EXAMPLE : " Member   Renewal   Predictor "  predicts   Member . Renewed   using   XGBoost   from   tenure / engagement   features   plus   a   member - summary   embedding ,  with   a   point - in - time   as - of   strategy   and   a   locked   holdout .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   of   the   pipeline

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   what   this   pipeline   predicts   and   how

Fields.Name: Version
Fields.Description: Monotonic   version   number   of   the   pipeline   definition

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Draft ,  Published ,  or   Archived

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   entity   whose   records   are   the   training   units  ( e . g .,  Members )

Fields.Name: TargetVariable
Fields.Description: The   label   being   predicted  —  a   column   or   expression   on   the   target   entity  ( e . g ., " Renewed ")

Fields.Name: ProblemType
Fields.Description: Problem   type :  classification   or   regression

Fields.Name: AlgorithmID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   chosen   algorithm   in   the   catalog

Fields.Name: Hyperparameters
Fields.Description: JSON   hyperparameter   overrides   for   the   chosen   algorithm

Fields.Name: SourceBindings
Fields.Description: JSON   ordered   references   to   source   entities  /  queries  /  external   entities  /  vector   sets   the   features   are   drawn   from

Fields.Name: FeatureSteps
Fields.Description: JSON   ordered   DAG   of   FeatureAssembly   steps  ( selection ,  null - handling ,  encoding ,  scaling ,  embedding / LLM   featurization )  executed   by   the   single   FeatureAssembly   executor

Fields.Name: AsOfStrategy
Fields.Description: JSON   point - in - time   configuration : {  Mode :  none | column | offset ,  Column ?,  OffsetDays ? } —  assembles   features   as   of   the   decision   point   to   prevent   future   leakage

Fields.Name: LeakageGuard
Fields.Description: JSON   leakage   guard :  deny - list   of   fields / sources   that   must   not   enter   features ,  plus   the   single - feature - dominance   threshold   that   flags   suspicious   runs

Fields.Name: ValidationStrategy
Fields.Description: JSON   validation   strategy : {  Strategy :  train_test_split | kfold | holdout ,  TestSize ?,  K ?,  LockedHoldoutFraction  }

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Training   Runs
entities.Description: The   ML - specific   detail   of   a   training   attempt  —  the   leaf   that   hangs   off   a   generic   ExperimentSessionIteration   when   part   of   an   agent - driven   search ,  OR   stands   alone  ( ExperimentSessionIterationID   NULL )  for   a   one - off   manual   train .  Captures   the   exact   feature   set ,  algorithm ,  hyperparameters ,  validation   results ,  and   the   model   produced  ( ResultingModelID   is   nullable :  a   run   may   be   pruned / failed   and   produce   no   model ).  The   generic   search - level   accounting  ( leaderboard   Score ,  rationale ,  the   driving   agent   run )  lives   on   the   parent   iteration ;  this   row   keeps   the   ML   execution   detail .

Fields.Name: PipelineID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   ML   Training   Pipeline   this   run   executed

Fields.Name: ResultingModelID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MLModel   this   run   produced ,  when   it   produced   one  ( NULL   for   pruned / failed   runs )

Fields.Name: ExperimentSessionIterationID
Fields.Description: Optional   foreign   key   to   the   generic   ExperimentSessionIteration   that   owns   this   run  ( NULL   for   standalone / manual   training   outside   a   session )

Fields.Name: FeaturesUsed
Fields.Description: JSON   of   the   exact   feature   set   used   for   this   run

Fields.Name: AlgorithmID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   algorithm   used   for   this   run

Fields.Name: Hyperparameters
Fields.Description: JSON   hyperparameters   used   for   this   run

Fields.Name: ValidationResults
Fields.Description: JSON   of   all   validation   metrics ,  per - fold   where   applicable  ( the   full   metric   blob ;  the   parent   iteration ' s   Score   is   the   single   normalized   leaderboard   number )

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Run   status :  Pending ,  Running ,  Completed ,  Failed ,  or   Pruned

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   the   run   started

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   the   run   completed

Fields.Name: ComputeCost
Fields.Description: Compute   cost   attributed   to   this   run ,  for   budget   enforcement

Fields.Name: TokensUsed
Fields.Description: LLM   tokens   used   by   this   run ,  for   budget   enforcement

Fields.Name: Notes
Fields.Description: Notes  /  observations   about   this   run

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Allowed   Domains
entities.Description: An   external   host  ( origin )  where   this   invite   may   be   embedded   in   an   IFRAME .  Enforced   server - side   via   Content - Security - Policy   frame - ancestors   plus   Origin / Referer   checks   on   embed   responses .  Multiple   rows  =  multiple   allowed   hosts .

Fields.Name: InviteID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MagicLinkInvite   this   allowed - domain   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Domain
Fields.Description: An   allowed   host / origin  ( e . g .  https :// partner . example . com )  where   the   link   may   be   framed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Allowed   Paths
entities.Description: An   Explorer   FE   path  ( after   the   base   URL )  this   link   is   confined   to   in   the   UI .  This   is   UX   confinement   only  —  the   real   authorization   boundary   is   server - side   entity / resource   permissions .  Multiple   rows  =  multiple   allowed   paths .

Fields.Name: InviteID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MagicLinkInvite   this   allowed - path   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Path
Fields.Description: An   allowed   FE   path  ( after   the   Explorer   base   URL )  the   session   may   navigate   to .  UX   confinement   only .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Applications
entities.Description: Join   row   granting   a   magic - link   invite   access   to   one   Application .  An   invite   may   eventually   carry   several ;  today   create / redeem   write   exactly   one  ( mirroring   MagicLinkInvite . ApplicationID )  while   multi - scope   enforcement   is   being   designed .

Fields.Name: InviteID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MagicLinkInvite   this   application   grant   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Application   this   invite   grants   access   to .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Roles
entities.Description: Join   row   granting   a   magic - link   invite   a   Role .  An   invite   may   eventually   carry   several ;  today   create / redeem   write   exactly   one  ( mirroring   MagicLinkInvite . RoleID )  while   multi - scope   enforcement   is   being   designed .

Fields.Name: InviteID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   MagicLinkInvite   this   role   grant   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: RoleID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Role   this   invite   grants   to   the   redeeming   user .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invites
entities.Description: A   shareable ,  single - use ,  app - scoped   magic - link   invite   for   an   external   user .  Bound   to   one   Application   and   one   restricted   Role ;  redeeming   it   provisions / links   a   user   with   that   scope   and   mints   a   short - lived   MJ - issued   JWT .  The   raw   token   is   never   stored  —  only   its   SHA - 256   hash .

Fields.Name: TokenHash
Fields.Description: SHA - 256   hash   of   the   raw   magic - link   token ,  base64url - encoded  ( 43   chars ).  The   raw   token   is   delivered   only   in   the   emailed   URL   and   is   never   persisted .  Lookups   hash   the   incoming   token   and   match   against   this   column .  Unique .

Fields.Name: Email
Fields.Description: Email   address   the   invite   was   issued   to   and   delivered   at .  Becomes   the   provisioned   user ' s   email   on   first   redemption .

Fields.Name: ApplicationID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Application  —  the   single   app   this   invite   grants   access   to .  The   provisioned   user   receives   exactly   one   User   Application   record   for   this   app .

Fields.Name: RoleID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Role  —  the   restricted   role   assigned   to   the   redeeming   user .  This   role ' s   entity   permissions   are   the   real   authorization   boundary   that   confines   the   external   user   to   the   shared   app ' s   data .

Fields.Name: ExpiresAt
Fields.Description: Hard   expiry   for   the   link .  After   this   instant   the   invite   cannot   be   redeemed   regardless   of   Status .

Fields.Name: ConsumedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   first   successful   redemption .  NULL   while   unconsumed .  Set   in   the   same   transaction   that   mints   the   session   JWT   to   enforce   single - use   semantics .

Fields.Name: MaxUses
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   times   this   invite   may   be   redeemed .  Defaults   to   1  ( true   single - use ).  Set   higher   only   for   intentionally   multi - use   links .

Fields.Name: UseCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   times   this   invite   has   been   redeemed   so   far .  Incremented   on   each   successful   redemption ;  redemption   is   rejected   once   UseCount   reaches   MaxUses .

Fields.Name: CreatedByUserID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   User  —  the   internal   user   who   created / shared   this   invite .  Audit   trail   for   who   granted   external   access .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Active  ( redeemable ),  Consumed  ( single - use   link   fully   redeemed ),  Revoked  ( manually   disabled ),  Expired  ( past   ExpiresAt ).  Revoking   an   unconsumed   link   is   the   primary   revocation   mechanism .

Fields.Name: IdentityMode
Fields.Description: Identity   resolution   mode . ' email ' ( default ,  legacy ):  redemption   provisions / links   a   per - email   user   and   enforcement   rides   that   user ' s   DB   roles . ' anonymous ':  all   redemptions   resolve   to   the   shared   Anonymous   principal  ( an   attribution   anchor ,  not   a   permission   holder );  scope   is   carried   per - session   in   the   minted   JWT   claims ,  never   as   roles   on   that   user .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Invite   kind ,  gating   which   scope   columns / claims   are   valid   and   which   issuance   capability   check   applies . ' app - session ' ( default ):  the   legacy   app + role   session . ' resource - share ':  scoped   to   a   single   resource  ( ResourceTypeID / ResourceID ). ' anonymous - embed ':  framed   in   an   external   site  ( requires   allowed   domains  +  tier   capability ).

Fields.Name: ResourceTypeID
Fields.Description: For   resource - share / embed   kinds :  the   ResourceType   of   the   single   resource   this   link   shares .  The   link ' s   reach   to   dependent   data   is   admitted   at   runtime   via   FK - reachable   resource - pinned   row - level   security ,  not   an   enumerated   list .  NULL   for   app - session   invites .

Fields.Name: ResourceID
Fields.Description: For   resource - share / embed   kinds :  the   primary - key   value   of   the   specific   shared   resource  ( stringified   to   support   any   resource ' s   key   type ).  NULL   for   app - session   invites .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Redemptions
entities.Description: One   row   per   magic - link   redemption   ATTEMPT  ( success   or   failure ).  Provides   per - use   redemption   history   and   forensic   visibility   into   token   scanning / brute - force .  Distinct   from   MagicLinkInvite ,  which   keeps   only   an   aggregate   UseCount  +  last   ConsumedAt .

Fields.Name: InviteID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   MagicLinkInvite .  NULLABLE :  a   redemption   attempt   against   a   token   that   matches   no   invite  ( not_found  —  the   signature   of   scanning / brute - force )  has   no   invite   to   reference   but   is   still   logged .

Fields.Name: AttemptedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   redemption   attempt  ( UTC ).  Defaults   to   the   time   of   insert .

Fields.Name: Outcome
Fields.Description: Outcome   of   the   attempt : ' success ',  or   one   of   the   redemption   error   codes  ( not_found ,  expired ,  consumed ,  revoked ,  invalid ,  provisioning_failed ,  server_error ).  Mirrors   the   RedeemErrorCode   union   in   the   server   code .

Fields.Name: IPAddress
Fields.Description: Client   IP   address   the   redemption   came   from ,  as   captured   by   the   request   middleware .  May   be   stored   full ,  truncated ,  hashed ,  or   omitted   per   the   deployment ' s   magicLink . audit . ipStorage   policy .  NULL   when   unavailable   or   policy   is  ' none '.

Fields.Name: UserAgent
Fields.Description: User - Agent   header   of   the   redeeming   client .  NULL   when   unavailable .

Fields.Name: Origin
Fields.Description: Origin   header   of   the   redemption   request .  Retained   for   embed / domain   forensics  ( which   host   framed   or   initiated   the   redemption ).  NULL   for   direct  ( non - embedded )  redemptions .

Fields.Name: ProvisionedUserID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   User   provisioned / linked   by   a   SUCCESSFUL   redemption .  NULL   on   failed   attempts   and   on  ( future )  anonymous   redemptions   that   resolve   to   a   shared   principal   rather   than   a   per - email   user .

Fields.Name: MaterializedResultID
Fields.Description: The   materialization  ( MJ :  Materialized   Results )  side   of   the   query <-> materialization   link .

Fields.Name: QueryID
Fields.Description: The   source   Query  ( MJ :  Queries )  whose   result   this   materialization   was   built   from .  The   link   lives   here  ( not   as   a   direct   FK   on   either   table )  to   avoid   the   MaterializedResult <-> Query   circular   dependency .

Fields.Name: SourceType
Fields.Description: Which   materialization   door   produced   this   row : ' Query ' ( a   materialized   stored   Query ,  surfaced   as   a   new   read - only   Virtual   Entity ;  the   source   query   is   linked   via   the   MaterializedResultQuery   join   table )  or  ' EntityBaseView ' ( a   1 : 1   materialized   copy   of   an   existing   entity ' s   base   view ,  which   reuses   the   source   entity ).

Fields.Name: SourceEntityID
Fields.Description: For   the   EntityBaseView   case ,  the   existing   entity   whose   base   view   is   materialized  ( RLS   applies   unchanged ).  NULL   for   the   Query   case  ( whose   source   query   is   linked   via   the   MaterializedResultQuery   join   table ).

Fields.Name: GeneratedEntityID
Fields.Description: For   the   Query   case ,  the   new   read - only   Virtual   Entity   CodeGen   mints   for   the   materialized   result   shape .  NULL   for   the   EntityBaseView   case  ( which   reuses   the   source   entity ).

Fields.Name: SchemaName
Fields.Description: Schema   of   the   physical   materialized   table   and   its   wrapper   view .

Fields.Name: TableName
Fields.Description: Physical   materialized   table  ( swappable   storage ,  repointed   on   atomic   refresh ).  Convention :  materialized_ < Name >.

Fields.Name: ViewName
Fields.Description: Wrapper   view  ( the   stable   read   contract ;  body   is   SELECT  *  FROM   the   physical   table ).  Convention :  materialized_vw < Name >.  The   atomic   swap   repoints   this   view ,  never   truncates   the   table   in   place .

Fields.Name: ParamMode
Fields.Description: Parameterization   classification : ' None ' ( unparameterized ), ' RowFilterBroad ' ( materialize   broad ,  filter   at   read ), ' PerValueCache ' ( bounded   structural   variant ),  or  ' BoundFixed ' ( params   bound   to   fixed   values ).  v1   supports  ' None '  and  ' RowFilterBroad '; ' PerValueCache '  and  ' BoundFixed '  are   reserved   for   later   phases .

Fields.Name: RefreshStrategy
Fields.Description: Refresh   strategy : ' FullRebuild ' ( rebuild   the   whole   result ), ' Incremental ' ( MERGE   on   the   surrogate   key ),  or  ' DirtyGroupRecompute ' ( recompute   groups   changed   since   Watermark ).  v1   ships   all   three : ' FullRebuild '  for   unkeyed   materializations ,  and  ' Incremental '/' DirtyGroupRecompute '  auto - selected   by   CodeGen   for   eligible   keyed   aggregations .

Fields.Name: RefreshSchedule
Fields.Description: Cron   expression   for   scheduled   rehydration   via   the   ScheduledJobEngine .  NULL   means   manual   refresh   only .  Stagger   across   materializations   to   avoid   refresh - window   contention .

Fields.Name: LastRefreshedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   last   successful   refresh  ( freshness   surfacing   for   the   selection   contract ).

Fields.Name: NextRefreshAt
Fields.Description: Next   scheduled   refresh   time ,  computed   from   RefreshSchedule ;  the   scheduler   reads   this   as   its   due - work   signal .

Fields.Name: Watermark
Fields.Description: Last - seen   MAX ( __mj_UpdatedAt )  of   the   source   data ;  the   staleness   probe   for   incremental  /  dirty - group   refresh .  Reuses   the   existing   query   smart - cache   fingerprint   pattern .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   state : ' Building ' ( materializing ), ' Active ' ( fresh ,  readable ), ' Stale ' ( past   expected   freshness ), ' Disabled ' ( turned   off ), ' DriftHold ' ( upstream   schema   drift   detected ;  held   for   review ).

Fields.Name: RowCount
Fields.Description: Approximate   row   count   of   the   last   build  —  part   of   the   cost / size   profile   an   agent  ( Skip )  uses   to   choose   live   vs .  materialized .

Fields.Name: ApproxBuildCostMs
Fields.Description: Approximate   build   cost   in   milliseconds   of   the   last   refresh  —  part   of   the   cost / size   profile   for   the   selection   contract .

Fields.Name: IntendedWorkload
Fields.Description: Human / structured   note   describing   what   this   materialization   is   good   for ;  surfaced   in   the   selection   contract   so   callers   pick   the   right   variant .

Fields.Name: RowFilterColumns
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   the   output   column   names   that   the   row - filter   parameters   map   to .  Populated   when   ParamMode   is   RowFilterBroad .  The   materialization   holds   all   rows   broad   and   these   columns   are   filtered   at   read   time  ( plan   section   6 . 4 ).  NULL   for   non - row - filter   materializations .

Fields.Name: BroadSQL
Fields.Description: For   a   RowFilterBroad   materialization ,  the   broad   source   SELECT   that   the   refresh   engine   materializes :  the   source   query   with   its   row - filter   WHERE   predicates   removed ,  so   the   materialized   table   holds   every   row   the   query   could   return   for   any   parameter   value .  NULL   for   non - parameterized   materializations ,  which   use   the   source   query   SQL   directly .

Fields.Name: KeyColumns
Fields.Description: Phase   3 :  JSON   array   of   the   key   columns  ({ name ,  type })  for   a   keyed / aggregation   materialization  —  the   combined   key   hashed   into   the   surrogate  ( the   stable   match   key   for   incremental   refresh  /  dirty - group   recompute ).  NULL   means   not   keyed ,  in   which   case   a   synthetic   IDENTITY / ROW_NUMBER   surrogate   is   used .

Fields.Name: SourceRowCount
Fields.Description: Phase   3  ( DirtyGroupRecompute ):  the   SOURCE   table   row   count   observed   at   the   last   successful   refresh .  Delete - detection   guard  —  if   the   current   source   COUNT (*)  is   lower   than   this ,  rows   were   deleted   and   the   refresh   falls   back   to   a   full   rebuild  ( dirty - group   recompute   cannot   localize   deletes   from   surviving   rows ).  NULL   means   no   baseline   yet  ( first   run   does   a   full   rebuild   and   sets   it ).  Distinct   from   RowCount ,  which   counts   materialized   rows  ( groups ).

Fields.Name: RefreshesSinceFullRebuild
Fields.Description: Count   of   consecutive   incremental  ( Incremental / DirtyGroupRecompute )  refreshes   since   the   last   full   rebuild .  The   refresher   forces   a   full   rebuild   once   this   reaches   its   threshold ,  reconciling   drift   that   a   balanced   delete + insert  ( net - zero   source   row - count   change )  leaves   uncaught   by   the   delete - detection   guard .  Reset   to   0   on   every   full   rebuild ;  incremented   on   every   incremental   refresh .

Fields.Name: ReadFilterSpec
Fields.Description: For   a   RowFilterBroad   materialization ,  a   JSON   array   of   read - time   filter   predicates  —  each  {  column ,  operator ,  paramName ,  kind  } —  that   the   runtime   provider   injects   against   the   broad   materialized   table   when   a   caller   runs   the   query   with   DataSource = Materialized .  operator   is   one   of   the   read - time - safe   set  (=, !=, <>, <, >, <=, >=,  IN ,  NOT   IN );  kind   is   scalar   or   list .  Values   are   always   bound   as   SQL   parameters ,  never   interpolated .  NULL   for   non - row - filter   materializations .

A   set   value   means   PERSONAL :  the   folder   belongs   to   that   user   and   consumers   filter   it   to   them ,  so   it   stays   out   of   other   people ' s   sidebars .  Personal   is   opt - in   at   create   time ;  nothing   is   migrated .

entities.Name: MJ :  Queries
entities.Description: Catalog   of   stored   queries .  This   is   useful   for   any   arbitrary   query   that   is   known   to   be   performant   and   correct   and   can   be   reused .  Queries   can   be   viewed / run   by   a   user ,  used   programatically   via   RunQuery ,  and   also   used   by   AI   systems   for   improved   reliability   instead   of   dynamically   generated   SQL .  Queries   can   also   improve   security   since   they   store   the   SQL   instead   of   using   dynamic   SQL .

Fields.Name: UserQuestion
Fields.Description: The   natural   language   question   this   query   answers ,  used   for   AI   query   selection .

Fields.Name: SQL
Fields.Description: The   actual   SQL   query   text   to   execute ,  may   include   parameters .

Fields.Name: TechnicalDescription
Fields.Description: Technical   documentation   of   the   query   logic ,  performance   considerations ,  and   parameter   usage .

Fields.Name: OriginalSQL
Fields.Description: The   original   SQL   before   any   optimization   or   modification ,  kept   for   reference .

Fields.Name: Feedback
Fields.Description: User   feedback   on   query   accuracy ,  performance ,  or   suggested   improvements .

Fields.Name: QualityRank
Fields.Description: Value   indicating   the   quality   of   the   query ,  higher   values   mean   a   better   quality

Fields.Name: ExecutionCostRank
Fields.Description: Higher   numbers   indicate   more   execution   overhead / time   required .  Useful   for   planning   which   queries   to   use   in   various   scenarios .

Fields.Name: UsesTemplate
Fields.Description: Automatically   set   to   true   when   the   SQL   column   contains   Nunjucks   template   markers  ( e . g ., {{  paramName  }}).  This   flag   is   maintained   by   the   QueryEntityServer   for   performance   optimization   and   discovery   purposes .  It   allows   quick   filtering   of   parameterized   queries   and   enables   the   UI   to   show   parameter   inputs   only   when   needed .  The   system   will   automatically   update   this   flag   when   the   SQL   content   changes .

Fields.Name: AuditQueryRuns
Fields.Description: When   true ,  all   executions   of   this   query   will   be   logged   to   the   Audit   Log   system   for   tracking   and   compliance

Fields.Name: CacheEnabled
Fields.Description: When   true ,  enables   query   result   caching .  Caching   behavior   depends   on   CacheValidationSQL : ( 1 )  If   CacheValidationSQL   is   NULL ,  uses   simple   server - side   TTL   caching   based   on   CacheTTLMinutes  -  results   are   cached   on   the   server   and   expire   after   the   TTL   period . ( 2 )  If   CacheValidationSQL   is   set ,  enables   smart   client - side   caching   with   freshness   validation  -  client   sends   cache   fingerprint  ( maxUpdatedAt  +  rowCount )  to   server ,  server   validates   using   CacheValidationSQL   and   returns  ' current ' ( use   cached )  or  ' stale ' ( with   fresh   data ).  Smart   caching   provides   real - time   accuracy   while   minimizing   data   transfer .

Fields.Name: CacheTTLMinutes
Fields.Description: Time - to - live   in   minutes   for   cached   query   results .  NULL   uses   default   TTL .

Fields.Name: CacheMaxSize
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   cached   result   sets   for   this   query .  NULL   uses   default   size   limit .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingVector
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON - serialized   embedding   vector   for   the   query ,  used   for   similarity   search   and   query   analysis

Fields.Name: EmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: The   AI   Model   used   to   generate   the   embedding   vector   for   this   query .  Required   for   vector   similarity   comparisons .

Fields.Name: CacheValidationSQL
Fields.Description: SQL   query   used   to   validate   cache   freshness   for   smart   caching .  When   set  ( and   CacheEnabled = true ),  enables   smart   cache   validation   instead   of   simple   TTL   expiration .  This   query   MUST   return   exactly   two   columns :  MaxUpdatedAt  ( datetime / datetimeoffset )  and   TotalRows  ( int ).  The   query   has   access   to   the   same   Nunjucks   parameters   as   the   main   query   SQL .  When   NULL ,  caching   uses   TTL - only   behavior   based   on   CacheTTLMinutes .  Example :  SELECT   MAX ( __mj_UpdatedAt )  AS   MaxUpdatedAt ,  COUNT (*)  AS   TotalRows   FROM   Orders   WHERE   Status  = '{{  status  }}'

Fields.Name: SQLDialectID
Fields.Description: The   SQL   dialect   that   the   SQL   column   is   written   in .  Defaults   to   T - SQL   for   backward   compatibility .

Fields.Name: Reusable
Fields.Description: When   true ,  this   query   can   be   referenced   by   other   queries   using   composition   syntax .  Only   queries   that   are   both   Reusable   and   Approved   can   be   composed   into   other   queries .

Fields.Name: IsMaterialized
Fields.Description: Author ' s   declared   intent   that   this   Query   should   be   materialized .  CodeGen   scans   for   IsMaterialized  =  1   and ,  if   the   query   qualifies  (§ 9 /§ 10 ),  materializes   it .  The   authoritative   state   lives   on   the   linked   MJ :  Materialized   Results   row  ( found   via   the   MaterializedResultQuery   join   table ).

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   configuration   bag   defining   query - level   policies   and   semantic   capabilities  ( shape  =  IQueryConfiguration ).  Includes   Priority  ( 1 - 100 )  for   ground - truth   ranking   in   the   semantic   layer ,  LogExecution   to   control   query   execution   logging ,  AlternativeQuestions   for   multi - phrasing   vector   recall ,  UsageGuidance   and   WhenNotToUse   bounds   for   AI   agents ,  and   DomainScope .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Entities
entities.Description: Tracks   which   entities   are   involved   in   a   given   query .  The   Queries   table   stores   SQL   and   descriptions   for   stored   queries   that   can   be   executed   and   serve   as   examples   for   AI .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Unique   identifier   for   the   QueryEntity   record .

Fields.Name: QueryID
Fields.Description: References   the   ID   of   the   query   in   the   Queries   table .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: References   the   ID   of   the   entity   in   the   Entities   table .

Fields.Name: DetectionMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates   how   this   entity - query   relationship   was   identified . " AI "  means   the   QueryEntityServer   used   LLM   analysis   to   parse   the   SQL / template   and   identify   which   MemberJunction   entities   are   referenced  ( by   analyzing   table   names ,  joins ,  and   query   structure ). " Manual "  means   a   user   explicitly   marked   this   entity   as   being   used   by   the   query .  AI   detection   helps   maintain   accurate   metadata   automatically   as   queries   evolve .

Fields.Name: AutoDetectConfidenceScore
Fields.Description: Confidence   score  ( 0 . 00 - 1 . 00 )  indicating   how   certain   the   AI   was   that   this   entity   is   actually   used   in   the   query .  Only   populated   when   DetectionMethod =" AI ".  Considers   factors   like :  direct   table   references   vs   indirect   joins ,  clear   entity   names   vs   ambiguous   aliases ,  and   context   from   the   query   purpose .  Lower   scores   might   indicate   the   entity   is   only   peripherally   involved   or   the   detection   was   uncertain .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Fields
entities.Description: Stores   field - level   metadata   for   queries   including   display   names ,  data   types ,  and   formatting   rules   for   result   presentation .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   of   this   field   in   query   results .

Fields.Name: SQLBaseType
Fields.Description: The   base   type ,  not   including   parameters ,  in   SQL .  For   example   this   field   would   be   nvarchar   or   decimal ,  and   wouldn ' t   include   type   parameters .  The   SQLFullType   field   provides   that   information .

Fields.Name: SQLFullType
Fields.Description: The   full   SQL   type   for   the   field ,  for   example   datetime   or   nvarchar ( 10 )  etc .

Fields.Name: SourceFieldName
Fields.Description: The   original   field   name   from   the   SQL   query   if   different   from   the   display   name .

Fields.Name: IsComputed
Fields.Description: Indicates   if   this   field   is   calculated   from   other   fields   rather   than   directly   from   the   database .

Fields.Name: ComputationDescription
Fields.Description: Explanation   of   how   this   computed   field   is   calculated .

Fields.Name: IsSummary
Fields.Description: Whether   this   field   represents   an   aggregate   or   summary   value .

Fields.Name: SummaryDescription
Fields.Description: Description   of   what   this   summary   field   represents   and   how   it ' s   aggregated .

Fields.Name: DetectionMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates   how   this   field   was   identified   in   the   query   output . " AI "  means   the   QueryEntityServer   used   LLM   analysis   to   parse   the   SELECT   clause   and   determine   field   names ,  types ,  and   their   source   entities / columns .  This   includes   handling   aliased   columns ,  computed   expressions ,  aggregations ,  and   CASE   statements . " Manual "  means   a   user   explicitly   defined   this   output   field .  AI   detection   ensures   the   field   list   stays   synchronized   with   query   changes .

Fields.Name: AutoDetectConfidenceScore
Fields.Description: Confidence   score  ( 0 . 00 - 1 . 00 )  indicating   how   certain   the   AI   was   about   this   field   detection .  Only   populated   when   DetectionMethod =" AI ".  Factors   include :  clarity   of   the   SELECT   clause ,  complexity   of   any   expressions   or   transformations ,  confidence   in   type   inference ,  and   ability   to   trace   back   to   source   entity / column .  Complex   computed   fields   or   ambiguous   aliases   result   in   lower   scores .  This   helps   identify   fields   that   may   need   manual   verification .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Parameters
entities.Description: Stores   parameter   definitions   for   parameterized   queries   that   use   Nunjucks   templates .  Each   parameter   represents   a   dynamic   value   that   can   be   passed   when   executing   the   query .  Parameters   are   automatically   extracted   from   the   query   template   by   the   QueryEntityServer   using   LLM   analysis ,  or   can   be   manually   defined .  The   combination   of   parameter   metadata   and   validation   filters   creates   a   self - documenting ,  type - safe   query   execution   system .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The   name   of   the   parameter   as   it   appears   in   the   Nunjucks   template .  This   must   match   exactly   with   the   parameter   reference   in   the   SQL   template .  For   example ,  if   the   template   contains  {{  userEmail  |  required  |  email  }},  the   Name   would   be  " userEmail ".  Parameter   names   should   follow   JavaScript   identifier   rules :  start   with   a   letter ,  and   contain   only   letters ,  numbers ,  and   underscores .

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: The   data   type   of   the   parameter   used   for   validation   and   type   conversion .  Valid   values   are : " string "  for   text   values , " number "  for   integers   or   decimals , " date "  for   date / datetime   values  ( ISO   8601   format   expected ), " boolean "  for   true / false   values ,  and  " array "  for   multiple   values  ( typically   used   with   IN   clauses ).  The   type   determines   which   validation   filters   can   be   applied   and   how   the   parameter   is   processed .

Fields.Name: IsRequired
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   parameter   must   be   provided   when   executing   the   query .  When   true ,  the   query   execution   will   fail   if   the   parameter   is   not   supplied   and   no   DefaultValue   is   set .  This   is   automatically   determined   by   the   presence   of   the  " required "  filter   in   the   template ,  but   can   be   manually   overridden .  Required   parameters   ensure   data   integrity   and   prevent   unintended   query   behavior .

Fields.Name: DefaultValue
Fields.Description: The   default   value   to   use   when   the   parameter   is   not   provided   during   query   execution .  This   value   must   be   compatible   with   the   parameter   Type .  For   arrays ,  use   JSON   format   like  [" value1 "," value2 "].  Default   values   allow   queries   to   have   sensible   fallbacks   while   still   accepting   custom   inputs .  If   a   parameter   is   required  ( IsRequired = true ),  the   default   value   is   ignored .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   explaining   the   purpose   and   usage   of   this   parameter .  This   is   typically   generated   by   LLM   analysis   of   the   query   context   but   can   be   manually   edited .  Good   descriptions   include :  what   the   parameter   filters   or   controls ,  valid   value   ranges   or   formats ,  business   meaning ,  and   any   special   considerations .  This   text   is   shown   in   UI   to   help   users   understand   what   value   to   provide .

Fields.Name: SampleValue
Fields.Description: A   concrete   example   value   demonstrating   the   proper   format   for   this   parameter .  Generated   by   LLM   based   on   the   query   context   and   validation   filters .  For   example : " john @ example . com "  for   an   email   parameter , " 2024 - 01 - 15 "  for   a   date ,  or  "[" active "," pending "]"  for   a   status   array .  Sample   values   help   users   understand   the   expected   format   and   can   be   used   in   API   documentation .

Fields.Name: ValidationFilters
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   Nunjucks   filter   definitions   that   validate   and   transform   the   parameter   value .  Each   filter   is   an   object   with  " name "  and   optional  " args "  properties .  Filters   are   applied   in   order   and   can   include :  validation  ( required ,  email ,  min ,  max ),  transformation  ( trim ,  upper ,  lower ),  SQL   safety  ( sqlsafe ,  sqljoin ),  and   type   conversion  ( number ,  date ).  Example : [{" name ":" required "},{" name ":" email "},{" name ":" sqlsafe "}].  The   filter   chain   ensures   type   safety   and   prevents   SQL   injection .

Fields.Name: DetectionMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates   how   this   parameter   was   identified   and   added   to   the   system . " AI "  means   it   was   automatically   detected   by   LLM   analysis   of   the   query   template ,  including   extraction   of   parameter   name ,  type   inference   from   filters ,  and   generation   of   description . " Manual "  means   it   was   explicitly   defined   by   a   user .  This   helps   track   which   parameters   might   need   human   review   and   provides   transparency   about   the   source   of   metadata .

Fields.Name: AutoDetectConfidenceScore
Fields.Description: Confidence   score  ( 0 . 00 - 1 . 00 )  indicating   how   certain   the   AI   was   about   this   parameter   detection .  Only   populated   when   DetectionMethod =" AI ".  Higher   scores   indicate   the   LLM   was   more   confident   about   the   parameter   name ,  type ,  and   usage .  Scores   above   0 . 80   are   generally   reliable ,  0 . 60 - 0 . 80   may   benefit   from   human   review ,  and   below   0 . 60   should   be   manually   verified .  This   helps   prioritize   which   auto - detected   parameters   need   human   attention .

entities.Name: MJ :  RSU   Pending   Works
entities.Description: Durable   queue   of   Runtime   Schema   Update  ( RSU )  pending   setup   work   that   must   survive   a   server   restart  —  replaces   the   former  . rsu_pending   directory   of   delete - on - read   JSON   files .  A   row   is   inserted   when   post - restart   work   is   registered ,  marked   Completed   only   AFTER   the   work   succeeds ,  and   marked   Failed   with   ErrorMessage   on   error  ( never   deleted   on   read ),  so   stranded   work   older   than   N   minutes   is   queryable   instead   of   silently   lost .

Fields.Name: PayloadJSON

Fields.Name: Status

Pending  =  registered ,  not   yet   processed  ( rows   Pending   for   longer   than   expected   indicate   stranded   work ).  Completed  =  the   post - restart   consumer   finished   successfully .  Failed  =  processing   errored ;  see   ErrorMessage .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   detail   recorded   when   processing   this   work   item   failed .  The   row   is   left   in   place  ( Status = Failed )  rather   than   deleted ,  so   failures   are   visible   and   re - runnable .

Fields.Name: ProcessedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   post - restart   consumer   finished   processing   this   row  ( success   or   failure ).  NULL   while   Pending .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Geo   Codes
entities.Description: Polymorphic   table   storing   persisted   geocoding   results   for   any   MJ   entity   record .  Each   row   maps   an   entity   record  +  location   type   to   a   lat / lng   coordinate ,  with   optional   country / state   references   for   choropleth   grouping .  Supports   multi - location   entities   via   LocationType   discriminator .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Entity .  Identifies   which   entity   this   geocode   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: MJ   composite   primary   key   format   string   identifying   the   source   record  ( e . g ., " ID |< uuid >").  Max   450   chars   for   SQL   Server   index   support .

Fields.Name: LocationType
Fields.Description: Discriminator   for   multi - location   entities .  Default  " Primary "  for   single - address   entities .  Multi - address   examples : " Home ", " Business ", " Mailing ", " PO   Box ".

Fields.Name: Latitude
Fields.Description: Geocoded   latitude   coordinate .  NULL   when   Status   is  " pending "  or  " failed ".

Fields.Name: Longitude
Fields.Description: Geocoded   longitude   coordinate .  NULL   when   Status   is  " pending "  or  " failed ".

Fields.Name: Precision
Fields.Description: Precision   level   of   the   geocoded   result :  exact  ( street   address ),  postal_code ,  city ,  county ,  state_province ,  or   country .

Fields.Name: CountryID
Fields.Description: Optional   FK   to   Country   reference   table .  Populated   alongside   lat / lng   to   enable   choropleth   grouping   without   reverse - geocoding   at   render   time .

Fields.Name: StateProvinceID
Fields.Description: Optional   FK   to   StateProvince   reference   table .  Populated   alongside   lat / lng   to   enable   state - level   choropleth   grouping .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   geocoding   status : " pending " ( awaiting   geocode ), " success " ( geocoded ),  or  " failed " ( geocoding   error ).  Used   by   scheduled   job   for   retry   logic .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error   details   when   Status   is  " failed ".  Captures   API   error   messages ,  rate   limit   info ,  etc .  for   debugging .

Fields.Name: RetryCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   geocoding   attempts .  Used   for   exponential   backoff   in   the   scheduled   retry   job .  Stops   retrying   at   configurable   maxRetries  ( default   3 ).

Fields.Name: SourceFieldHash
Fields.Description: SHA - 256   hash   of   the   source   field   values   that   produced   this   geocode .  When   source   fields   change   on   save ,  the   hash   won ' t   match   and   re - geocoding   is   triggered .  Format :  SHA - 256 ( concat ( field1 , "|",  field2 , ...)).

Fields.Name: GeocodedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   when   geocoding   was   last   attempted  ( success   or   failure ).

Fields.Name: GeocodingSource
Fields.Description: Source   that   produced   this   geocode .  One   of :  google ,  geocodio ,  here ,  reference_data ,  manual ,  ip_geolocation ,  native ,  reverse .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Process   Watermarks
entities.Description: Per - record   change - detection   watermark   backing   WatermarkStrategy = Checksum .  Stores   the   last   content   hash   a   Record   Process   processed   for   a   given   record   so   unchanged   records   are   skipped   on   the   next   run .  Only   used   by   Checksum   mode ;  UpdatedAt   mode   compares   __mj_UpdatedAt   and   stores   nothing   here .

Fields.Name: RecordProcessID

Fields.Name: EntityID

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Processes
entities.Description: A   declarative ,  reusable   job   definition   that   binds   three   axes   of   a   business   process :  WORK  ( an   Action   or   an   Agent )  x   SCOPE  ( a   single   record ,  a   User   View ,  a   List ,  or   an   ad - hoc   Filter )  x   TRIGGER  ( on - change   save   hooks ,  a   cron   schedule ,  and / or   on   demand ).  One   row   is   one   configured   process ;  each   execution   of   it   produces   a   Process   Run   with   per - record   Process   Run   Details .  EXAMPLE :  a  " Weekly   Customer   Health   Summary "  row   runs   the  " Customer   Summarizer "  agent   over   the  " Active   Customers "  view   every   Saturday   2am ,  also   whenever   a   customer ' s   NPS / support   fields   change ,  and   on   demand ;  for   each   customer   it   infers  { satisfaction ,  sentiment ,  personalityStyle ,  summary }  and   writes   satisfaction / sentiment   back   onto   the   Customer   plus   a   summary   into   a   Customer   Insights   child   row ,  skipping   customers   unchanged   since   the   last   run .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   of   the   process   definition  ( e . g ., " Weekly   Customer   Health   Summary ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   description   of   what   this   process   does

Fields.Name: CategoryID
Fields.Description: Optional   hierarchical   category   for   organizing   this   process   in   the   UI

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   target   entity   whose   records   this   process   operates   on

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Draft  ( not   yet   wired ),  Active  ( triggers   live ),  or   Disabled

Fields.Name: WorkType
Fields.Description: Whether   the   work   is   an   Action ,  an   Agent ,  or   an   Infer  ( per - record   AI   Prompt ).  Agents   are   dispatched   through   the   Execute   Agent   action   and   must   be   top - level  +  ExposeAsAction ;  Infer   runs   the   AI   Prompt   named   by   PromptID   for   each   record   and   writes   its   structured   output   back   via   OutputMapping .

Fields.Name: ActionID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   Action   to   run ,  when   WorkType = Action

Fields.Name: AgentID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   AI   Agent   to   run ,  when   WorkType = Agent

Fields.Name: PromptID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   AI   Prompt   to   run   for   each   record ,  when   WorkType = Infer .  The   prompt ' s   structured   output   is   written   back   to   the   data   model   via   OutputMapping .

Fields.Name: ScopeType
Fields.Description: How   the   record   set   is   scoped   for   the   Schedule   and   On - Demand   triggers :  SingleRecord ,  View ,  List ,  or   Filter .  The   On - Change   trigger   is   always   single - record   and   ignores   this .

Fields.Name: ScopeViewID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   User   View   defining   the   scope ,  when   ScopeType = View

Fields.Name: ScopeListID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   List   defining   the   scope ,  when   ScopeType = List

Fields.Name: ScopeFilter
Fields.Description: Ad - hoc   WHERE   clause   used   to   resolve   the   record   set ,  when   ScopeType = Filter

Fields.Name: OnChangeEnabled
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   process   runs   per - record   on   save   via   an   owned   Entity   Action

Fields.Name: OnChangeInvocationType
Fields.Description: Which   save   event   fires   the   on - change   trigger :  AfterCreate ,  AfterUpdate ,  AfterDelete ,  or   Validate

Fields.Name: OnChangeFilter
Fields.Description: Gating   expression   evaluated   against   the   changed   record  ( with   changed - fields   context )  that   compiles   into   the   owned   Entity   Action   Filter ;  only   when   it   passes   does   the   on - change   trigger   fire

Fields.Name: ScheduleEnabled
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   process   runs   on   a   cron   schedule   via   an   owned   Scheduled   Job

Fields.Name: CronExpression
Fields.Description: Cron   expression   for   the   schedule   trigger ,  when   ScheduleEnabled = 1

Fields.Name: Timezone
Fields.Description: IANA   timezone   for   evaluating   the   cron   expression  ( default   UTC )

Fields.Name: OnDemandEnabled
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   process   can   be   run   on   demand  ( button  /  resolver )

Fields.Name: InputMapping
Fields.Description: JSON   mapping   describing   how   a   record   maps   to   the   work   inputs  ( optionally   including   an   EntityDocumentID   for   render - to - text )

Fields.Name: OutputMapping
Fields.Description: JSON   mapping   describing   how   the   structured   output   payload   writes   back  ( to   fields ,  a   child   record ,  or   tags )

Fields.Name: SkipUnchanged
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  records   whose   watermark   indicates   no   change   since   the   last   run   are   skipped

Fields.Name: WatermarkStrategy
Fields.Description: How   unchanged   records   are   detected   for   SkipUnchanged :  Checksum  ( per - record   content   hash ,  stored   in   RecordProcessWatermark ),  UpdatedAt  ( compares   __mj_UpdatedAt ,  stores   nothing ),  or   None

Fields.Name: BatchSize
Fields.Description: Number   of   records   processed   per   batch  ( default   100 )

Fields.Name: MaxConcurrency
Fields.Description: Maximum   number   of   records   processed   concurrently   within   a   batch  ( default   1 )

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   the   process ' s   work ,  used   by   work   types   that   need   structured   config   beyond   Input / Output   mappings .  For   WorkType =' FieldRules '  this   holds   the   serialized   FieldRuleSet  ( the   rules   applied   to   each   record ).  NULL   for   work   types   that   do   not   use   it .

entities.Name: MJ :  Remote   Operations
entities.Description: Definition   of   a   typed ,  provider - routed   server   operation   invoked   identically   from   the   client  ( marshalled   over   GraphQL )  and   the   server  ( dispatched   in - process ) -  the   typed   peer   of   BaseEntity  ( CRUD )  and   RunView  ( set   reads )  for   arbitrary   capabilities .  Input / output   types   are   declared   here   and   emitted   by   CodeGen   into   a   typed   base   class ;  the   body   may   be   hand - written   or   AI - authored   from   Description .  EXAMPLE : " RecordProcess . RunNow " ( ExecutionMode = LongRunning )  takes  { recordProcessID }  and   returns  { processRunID },  authorized   by   the   recordprocess : execute   scope   plus   the   caller ' s   entity   permissions .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   of   the   operation

Fields.Name: OperationKey
Fields.Description: Stable ,  unique   registry   key   and   wire   token   used   to   dispatch   the   operation  ( e . g ., " RecordProcess . RunNow ").  Namespaced   by   convention .

Fields.Name: CategoryID
Fields.Description: Optional   hierarchical   category   for   organizing   this   operation   in   the   UI

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human   description   of   the   operation ;  also   the   seed   for   AI - generated   implementation   code   when   GenerationType = AI

Fields.Name: InputTypeName
Fields.Description: TypeScript   type   name   for   the   operation   input  ( emitted   by   CodeGen   as   the   TInput   interface )

Fields.Name: InputTypeDefinition
Fields.Description: Raw   TypeScript   interface / type   source   defining   the   input   shape  ( same   mechanism   as   EntityField   JSON - type   definitions )

Fields.Name: InputTypeIsArray
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   input   type   is   emitted   as   an   array  ( TInput [])

Fields.Name: OutputTypeName
Fields.Description: TypeScript   type   name   for   the   operation   output  ( emitted   by   CodeGen   as   the   TOutput   interface )

Fields.Name: OutputTypeDefinition
Fields.Description: Raw   TypeScript   interface / type   source   defining   the   output   shape

Fields.Name: OutputTypeIsArray
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   output   type   is   emitted   as   an   array  ( TOutput [])

Fields.Name: ExecutionMode
Fields.Description: Sync  ( request / response )  or   LongRunning  ( returns   a   handle ;  supports   detached   and   attached   consumption )

Fields.Name: RequiredScope
Fields.Description: Optional   API - key   scope   string  ( e . g .,  recordprocess : execute )  enforced   for   API - key / MCP   callers ;  NULL   means   no   scope   gate  ( interactive   users   are   still   bounded   by   their   entity   permissions )

Fields.Name: RequiresSystemUser
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  only   the   system   user   may   invoke   this   operation

Fields.Name: GenerationType
Fields.Description: How   the   server   implementation   is   provided :  Manual  ( hand - written   subclass ),  AI  ( generated   from   Description ),  or   Default  ( standard   generated   plumbing )

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: The   AI - generated   implementation   body  ( when   GenerationType = AI );  regenerated   only   when   Description   changes

Fields.Name: CodeApprovalStatus
Fields.Description: Human   approval   gate   for   AI - generated   code :  Pending ,  Approved ,  or   Rejected .  Only   Approved   AI   code   is   emitted   and   routable .

Fields.Name: CodeApprovedByUserID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   the   user   who   approved   the   generated   code

Fields.Name: CodeApprovedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   generated   code   was   approved

Fields.Name: ContractFingerprint
Fields.Description: Fingerprint   of   the   input / output   contract ;  carried   in   the   wire   envelope   so   the   server   can   reject   a   stale   client   loudly   instead   of   mis - deserializing

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status :  Active  ( routable ),  Disabled ,  or   Pending .  Only   Active   operations   can   be   invoked .

Fields.Name: CacheTTLSeconds
Fields.Description: Optional   result   cache   TTL   in   seconds  ( NULL  =  no   caching )

Fields.Name: TimeoutMS
Fields.Description: Optional   execution   timeout   in   milliseconds

Fields.Name: MaxConcurrency
Fields.Description: Optional   cap   on   concurrent   executions   of   this   operation

Fields.Name: CodeLocked
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   AI - generated   Code   is   frozen   and   Save ()  will   not   regenerate   it   even   if   Description   changes  ( the   Generated - Actions   CodeLocked   analog ).  Default   0 .

Fields.Name: CodeComments
Fields.Description: The   model ' s   explanation  /  comments   for   the   AI - generated   Code  ( populated   alongside   Code   when   GenerationType = AI ).  Human - facing   review   aid .

Fields.Name: Libraries
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   the   libraries   the   generated   body   imports : [{ " Library ": "@ memberjunction / ai - prompts ", " ItemsUsed ": [" AIPromptRunner "] }, ...].  Bound   to   the   RemoteOperationLibrary   JSONType   via   metadata   sync   so   CodeGen   emits   a   typed   LibrariesObject   accessor ;  CodeGen   uses   it   to   emit   the   imports   at   the   top   of   the   generated   remote_operations . ts .  NULL / empty  =  only   the   default   always - available   libraries   are   imported .
