entities.Name: MJ :  Scheduled   Job   Runs
entities.Description: Records   execution   history   for   scheduled   jobs .  Provides   uniform   tracking   across   all   job   types .  Each   record   represents   one   execution   attempt   of   a   scheduled   job .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   job   execution   began .  Set   immediately   before   calling   the   job   plugin ' s   Execute   method .

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   job   execution   completed  ( successfully   or   with   failure ).  NULL   while   the   job   is   still   running .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   the   job   execution .  Running = currently   executing ,  Completed = finished  ( check   Success   for   outcome ),  Failed = exception   during   execution ,  Cancelled = manually   cancelled ,  Timeout = exceeded   maximum   execution   time .

Fields.Name: Success

This   is   the   job - level   success   from   the   plugin ' s   Execute   method ,  separate   from   domain - specific   success   tracking .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage

Fields.Name: Details
Fields.Description: Job - type   specific   execution   details   stored   as   JSON .  May   include   references   to   domain - specific   run   records  ( e . g ., {" AgentRunID ": "...", " TokensUsed ":  5000 }),  performance   metrics ,  or   other   execution   metadata . Fields.Name: ExecutedByUserID
Fields.Description: User   context   under   which   the   job   was   executed .  Typically   the   OwnerUserID   from   the   schedule ,  but   can   be   overridden   in   job - specific   configuration .

Fields.Name: QueuedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   execution   was   queued  ( for   ConcurrencyMode = Queue ).  NULL   for   immediate   executions .  When   set ,  indicates   this   run   is   waiting   for   a   previous   execution   to   complete   before   starting .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scheduled   Job   Types
entities.Description: Defines   types   of   schedulable   jobs   and   their   plugin   implementations .  Each   job   type   represents   a   different   kind   of   work   that   can   be   scheduled  ( e . g .,  Agents ,  Actions ,  Reports ).

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Unique   name   identifying   this   job   type  ( e . g .,  Agent ,  Action ,  Report ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   of   what   this   job   type   does   and   when   it   should   be   used .

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: TypeScript   class   name   that   implements   BaseScheduledJob   for   this   job   type .  Used   by   ClassFactory   to   instantiate   the   correct   plugin   at   runtime .

Fields.Name: DomainRunEntity
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   entity   that   stores   execution   records   for   this   job   type  ( e . g ., " MJ :  AI   Agent   Runs ", " Action   Execution   Logs ").  Used   for   generic   UI   linking   to   domain - specific   run   records .  NULL   if   job   type   uses   ScheduledJobRun   as   its   only   execution   record .

Fields.Name: DomainRunEntityFKey
Fields.Description: Name   of   the   foreign   key   field   in   the   DomainRunEntity   that   links   back   to   ScheduledJobRun  ( e . g ., " ScheduleID ").  Used   for   querying   related   domain   runs .  NULL   if   DomainRunEntity   is   NULL .

Fields.Name: NotificationsAvailable
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   job   type   supports   sending   notifications   on   completion   or   failure .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scheduled   Jobs
entities.Description: Defines   schedules   for   automated   job   execution   across   all   schedulable   types .  Each   record   represents   a   scheduled   job   with   its   cron   expression ,  configuration ,  and   execution   tracking .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   name   for   this   scheduled   job .  Should   clearly   identify   what   the   job   does .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   job ' s   purpose ,  what   it   does ,  and   any   important   notes   about   its   execution .

Fields.Name: CronExpression
Fields.Description: Cron   expression   defining   when   the   job   should   execute  ( e . g ., " 0   30   9  * *  MON - FRI "  for   weekdays   at   9 : 30   AM ).  Uses   standard   cron   syntax   with   seconds   precision .

Fields.Name: Timezone
Fields.Description: IANA   timezone   identifier   for   interpreting   the   cron   expression  ( e . g ., " America / Chicago ", " UTC ").  Ensures   consistent   scheduling   across   different   server   locations .

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Optional   start   date / time   for   when   this   schedule   becomes   active .  Job   will   not   execute   before   this   time .  NULL   means   active   immediately   upon   creation .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: Optional   end   date / time   for   when   this   schedule   expires .  Job   will   not   execute   after   this   time .  NULL   means   no   expiration .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current   status   of   the   schedule .  Pending = created   but   not   yet   active ,  Active = currently   running   on   schedule ,  Paused = temporarily   stopped ,  Disabled = manually   disabled ,  Expired = past   EndAt   date .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Job - type   specific   configuration   stored   as   JSON .  Schema   is   defined   by   the   ScheduledJobType   plugin .  For   Agents :  includes   AgentID ,  StartingPayload ,  InitialMessage ,  etc .  For   Actions :  includes   ActionID   and   parameter   mappings .

Fields.Name: OwnerUserID
Fields.Description: User   who   owns   this   schedule .  Used   as   the   execution   context   if   no   specific   user   is   configured   in   the   job - specific   configuration .

Fields.Name: LastRunAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   most   recent   execution .  Updated   after   each   run .  Used   for   monitoring   and   dashboard   displays .

Fields.Name: NextRunAt
Fields.Description: Calculated   timestamp   of   when   this   job   should   next   execute   based   on   the   cron   expression .  Updated   after   each   run .  Used   by   scheduler   to   determine   which   jobs   are   due .

Fields.Name: RunCount
Fields.Description: Total   number   of   times   this   schedule   has   been   executed ,  including   both   successful   and   failed   runs .

Fields.Name: SuccessCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   times   this   schedule   has   executed   successfully  ( Success  =  true   in   ScheduledJobRun ).

Fields.Name: FailureCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   times   this   schedule   has   executed   but   failed  ( Success  =  false   in   ScheduledJobRun ).

Fields.Name: NotifyOnSuccess
Fields.Description: Whether   to   send   notifications   when   the   job   completes   successfully .

Fields.Name: NotifyOnFailure
Fields.Description: Whether   to   send   notifications   when   the   job   fails .  Defaults   to   true   for   alerting   on   failures .

Fields.Name: NotifyUserID
Fields.Description: User   to   notify   about   job   execution   results .  If   NULL   and   notifications   are   enabled ,  falls   back   to   OwnerUserID .

Fields.Name: NotifyViaEmail
Fields.Description: Whether   to   send   email   notifications .  Requires   NotifyOnSuccess   or   NotifyOnFailure   to   also   be   enabled .

Fields.Name: NotifyViaInApp
Fields.Description: Whether   to   send   in - app   notifications .  Requires   NotifyOnSuccess   or   NotifyOnFailure   to   also   be   enabled .  Defaults   to   true .

Fields.Name: LockToken
Fields.Description: Unique   token   used   for   distributed   locking   across   multiple   server   instances .  Set   when   a   server   claims   the   job   for   execution .  Prevents   duplicate   executions   in   multi - server   environments .

Fields.Name: LockedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   lock   was   acquired .  Used   with   ExpectedCompletionAt   to   detect   stale   locks   from   crashed   server   instances .

Fields.Name: LockedByInstance
Fields.Description: Identifier   of   the   server   instance   that   currently   holds   the   lock  ( e . g ., " hostname - 12345 ").  Used   for   troubleshooting   and   monitoring   which   server   is   executing   which   job .

Fields.Name: ExpectedCompletionAt
Fields.Description: Expected   completion   time   for   the   current   execution .  If   current   time   exceeds   this   and   lock   still   exists ,  the   lock   is   considered   stale   and   can   be   claimed   by   another   instance .  Handles   crashed   server   cleanup .

Fields.Name: ConcurrencyMode
Fields.Description: Controls   behavior   when   a   new   execution   is   scheduled   while   a   previous   execution   is   still   running .  Skip = do   not   start   new   execution  ( default ),  Queue = wait   for   current   to   finish   then   execute ,  Concurrent = allow   multiple   simultaneous   executions .

Fields.Name: RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun
Fields.Description: When   true   AND   LastRunAt   IS   NULL ,  the   scheduler   sets   NextRunAt   to   now ()  instead   of   the   next   cron   tick   on   initialization ,  so   the   job   runs   on   the   next   polling   cycle .  Useful   for   newly - seeded   jobs   that   should   not   wait   up   to   a   full   cron   interval   before   their   first   execution .

Fields.Name: MaxRuntimeMinutes
Fields.Description: Optional   per - job   override   for   the   acquire - time   lock   lease   length ,  in   minutes .  When   set   and   positive ,  the   engine   uses   max ( default   lease ,  MaxRuntimeMinutes )  as   the   initial   ExpectedCompletionAt  —  so   it   only   ever   EXTENDS   the   default   lease ,  never   shrinks   it .  Intended   for   jobs   whose   work   is   a   single   long - running   call   that   cannot   heartbeat   mid - flight  ( e . g .  one   slow   synchronous   action ).  Jobs   that   heartbeat   via   the   plugin   opt - in   pattern   do   not   need   this .  NULL  =  use   the   engine   default   lease  ( LeaseTimeoutMinutes ).  See   plans / scheduled - job - engine - heartbeat - lease . md  ( GH  # 2749 ).

Fields.Name: MissedRunPolicy
Fields.Description: What   this   job   does   about   fire   times   that   passed   while   the   scheduler   was   not   running  ( a   deploy ,  a   crash ,  a   sleeping   machine ).  RunOnce  ( the   default )  performs   a   single   catch - up   run   and   then   resumes   the   normal   schedule  —  correct   for   digests ,  syncs   and   anything   where   only   the   latest   state   matters ,  and   identical   to   the   behavior   every   job   had   before   this   column   existed .  RunAll   replays   each   missed   occurrence ,  one   per   poll   tick   so   a   long   outage   drains   gradually   rather   than   dispatching   at   once  —  correct   for   per - period   work   such   as   billing   or   metric   snapshots ,  where   skipping   a   period   loses   data   nothing   else   recreates .  Skip   performs   no   catch - up   at   all   and   simply   advances   to   the   next   future   occurrence  —  correct   for   work   whose   value   expires ,  such   as   a   cache   warm .  A   run   is   only   treated   as   missed   when   a   LATER   occurrence   has   also   come   due ,  so   a   job   that   merely   became   due   seconds   ago   is   never   misclassified ;  this   is   evaluated   cron - relatively   rather   than   against   a   fixed   grace   window ,  which   would   misjudge   both   a   per - minute   job   after   a   short   pause   and   a   monthly   job   that   is   a   week   late .

entities.Name: MJ :  Schema   Info
entities.Description: Tracks   the   schemas   in   the   system   and   the   ID   ranges   that   are   valid   for   entities   within   each   schema .

Fields.Name: SchemaName
Fields.Description: The   database   schema   this   information   applies   to .

Fields.Name: EntityIDMin
Fields.Description: Field   EntityIDMin   for   entity   Schema   Info .

Fields.Name: EntityIDMax
Fields.Description: Field   EntityIDMax   for   entity   Schema   Info .

Fields.Name: EntityNamePrefix
Fields.Description: Optional   prefix   to   prepend   to   entity   names   generated   for   this   schema .  For   example ,  setting   this   to  " Committees : "  would   result   in   entity   names   like  " Committees :  Individuals ".  Can   be   overridden   by   mj . config . cjs   NameRulesBySchema   settings .

Fields.Name: EntityNameSuffix
Fields.Description: Optional   suffix   to   append   to   entity   names   generated   for   this   schema .  Can   be   overridden   by   mj . config . cjs   NameRulesBySchema   settings .

Fields.Name: CanonicalSchemaName
Fields.Description: Case - stable   canonical   schema   name ,  sourced   from   the   app   manifest  ( mj - app . json   schema . name ).  Used   in   place   of   SchemaName   when   deriving   the   schema   prefix   for   entity   ClassName / CodeName   and   GraphQL   type   names ,  so   that   PostgreSQL   installs  —  whose   physical   SchemaName   is   folded   to   lowercase  —  still   produce   PascalCase   prefixes   matching   the   published ,  hand - cased   entity   packages .  NULL   means  " no   override ":  the   prefix   falls   back   to   SchemaName  ( every   existing   install ,  the   core   __mj   schema ,  and   SQL   Server ,  where   SchemaName   is   already   canonical ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Scoped   Prompt   Configs
entities.Description: A   scope - aware   override   of   an   AIPrompt ' s   RUN   SETTINGS  ( model / vendor ,  AI   configuration ,  sampling   knobs ,  response   format ,  effort   level ).  The   run - settings   sibling   of   ScopedPromptPart .  Narrowed   by   a   polymorphic   scope  ( PrimaryScopeEntity / Record  +  SecondaryScopes ).  Resolved   by   a   cached   engine   via   a   specificity   cascade   per   PromptID  —  the   most - specific   in - scope   row   wins   as   a   whole   row  ( tie - broken   by   Priority );  each   non - null   column   overrides   the   prompt   default ,  a   NULL   column   inherits   it .  Runtime - explicit   overrides   on   the   agent   run   still   win .  Lets   any   MJ   app   tune   model / generation   behavior   per   scope   by   editing   rows ,  not   code .

Fields.Name: PromptID
Fields.Description: The   AIPrompt   whose   run   settings   this   row   overrides .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   human - readable   note   about   this   override  ( authoring   aid ;  not   sent   to   the   model ).

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: The   record   ID   within   the   primary   scope   entity   that   this   override   is   scoped   to .  NULL  =  global  ( applies   regardless   of   scope ).  When   set   with   empty   SecondaryScopes ,  the   override   is   primary - scope - only  ( e . g .  org - level ).

Fields.Name: SecondaryScopes
Fields.Description: JSON   object   of   additional   scope   dimensions  ( e . g . {" ChannelID ":"..."}).  Empty / NULL   with   PrimaryScopeRecordID   set  =  primary - scope - only ;  populated  =  fully - scoped .  Matched  ( cascading   or   strict )  against   the   run ' s   SecondaryScopes .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle :  Active  ( live ),  Provisional  ( staged ;  eligible   but   flaggable   as   not - yet - final ),  Archived  ( excluded   from   resolution ).  Only   Active   and   Provisional   are   eligible   for   resolution .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Precedence  /  tie - break   for   resolution .  Higher   wins   when   two   rows   tie   on   scope   specificity .  Default   0 .

Fields.Name: ModelID
Fields.Description: Optional   model   override   for   this   scope .  NULL  =  use   the   prompt ' s   own   model   selection .  Applied   as   AIPromptParams . override . modelId .

Fields.Name: VendorID
Fields.Description: Optional   vendor   override   paired   with   ModelID  ( which   inference   provider   serves   the   model ).  NULL  =  let   MJ   pick .  Applied   as   AIPromptParams . override . vendorId .

Fields.Name: ConfigurationID
Fields.Description: Optional   AI   Configuration  ( environment )  override   for   this   scope .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   as   AIPromptParams . configurationId .

Fields.Name: Temperature
Fields.Description: Sampling   temperature   override .  NULL  =  inherit   the   prompt   default .  Applied   via   AIPromptParams . additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: TopP
Fields.Description: Nucleus - sampling  ( top - p )  override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: TopK
Fields.Description: Top - k   sampling   override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: MinP
Fields.Description: Min - p   sampling   override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: FrequencyPenalty
Fields.Description: Frequency - penalty   override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: PresencePenalty
Fields.Description: Presence - penalty   override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: Seed
Fields.Description: Deterministic   sampling   seed   override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: StopSequences
Fields.Description: Comma - delimited   stop   sequences   override .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: ResponseFormat
Fields.Description: Response - format   override :  Any ,  JSON ,  Markdown ,  ModelSpecific ,  or   Text .  NULL  =  inherit .  Applied   via   additionalParameters .

Fields.Name: EffortLevel
Fields.Description: Reasoning / effort   level   override  ( 1 - 100 ).  NULL  =  inherit   the   prompt   default .  Applied   as   AIPromptParams . effortLevel .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scoped   Prompt   Parts
entities.Description: A   scope - aware ,  role - tagged   fragment   of   prompt   text   attached   to   an   AIPrompt .  Optionally   narrowed   by   a   polymorphic   scope  ( PrimaryScopeEntity / Record  +  SecondaryScopes  —  the   same   scope   the   agent   runtime   carries   for   memory ).  Resolved   by   a   cached   engine   via   a   specificity   cascade   per  ( PromptID ,  Name ) —  more - specific   scope   wins  —  then   assembled   additively  ( by   Sort )  into   a   role - faithful   chat   message   list .  Lets   any   MJ   app   control   prompt   behavior   per   scope   by   editing   rows ,  not   code .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Logical   part   name  ( e . g .  Personality ,  Instructions ).  The   OVERRIDE   key :  per   Name   within   a   PromptID ,  the   most - specific   scope   wins .  Distinct   Names   compose   additively .

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: Chat   message   role   this   part   renders   as :  System ,  User ,  or   Assistant .  Drives   role - faithful   assembly  ( assembled   messages   drive   the   model   directly ,  not   flattened   into   one   system   blob ).

Fields.Name: Sort
Fields.Description: Final - assembly   ordering  ( ASC ).  Controls   this   part ' s   position   in   the   assembled   message   list .  Not   used   for   specificity   tie - breaking .

Fields.Name: Text
Fields.Description: The   prompt - part   text .  May   contain   Nunjucks   templating ,  rendered   against   the   prompt ' s   data   context   at   execution   time .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional   human - readable   note   about   this   part  ( authoring   aid ;  not   sent   to   the   model ).

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: The   record   ID   within   the   primary   scope   entity   that   this   part   is   scoped   to .  NULL  =  global  ( applies   regardless   of   scope ).  When   set   with   empty   SecondaryScopes ,  the   part   is   primary - scope - only  ( e . g .  org - level ).

Fields.Name: SecondaryScopes
Fields.Description: JSON   object   of   additional   scope   dimensions  ( e . g . {" ChannelID ":"..."}).  Empty / NULL   with   PrimaryScopeRecordID   set  =  primary - scope - only ;  populated  =  fully - scoped .  Matched  ( cascading   or   strict )  against   the   run ' s   SecondaryScopes .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle :  Active  ( live ),  Provisional  ( staged ;  eligible   but   flaggable   as   not - yet - final ),  Archived  ( excluded   from   resolution ).  Only   Active   and   Provisional   are   eligible   for   resolution .

Fields.Name: MergeBehavior
Fields.Description: Within   a   part   Name ,  how   this   part   combines   with   less - specific   same - named   parts : ' Override ' ( default ) =  the   most - specific   part   replaces   the   others ; ' Append ' =  all   in - scope   same - named   parts   are   included   additively  ( ordered   by   specificity   then   Priority   then   Sort ).  Read   by   the   PromptComponentResolver .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Precedence  /  tie - break   for   resolution .  Higher   wins   when   two   same - Name   parts   tie   on   scope   specificity ;  also   used   as   a   secondary   ordering   key   after   Sort .  Default   0 .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Execution   Logs
entities.Description: One   row   per   SearchEngine . search   invocation .  Populated   by   SearchEngine ' s   post - fusion   logging   hook  ( Phase   3 . 2 ).  Read   by   the   Knowledge   Hub   Search   Analytics   dashboard  ( Phase   3 . 3 )  and   the   per - scope   tuning   CSV   export  ( Phase   3 . 4 ).

Fields.Name: SearchScopeID
Fields.Description: The   SearchScope   this   invocation   targeted .  NULL   for   unscoped   global   search .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   User   who   initiated   the   search .  NULL   for   system  /  unauthenticated   callers .

Fields.Name: AIAgentID
Fields.Description: The   AIAgent   identity   if   the   search   was   invoked   from   an   agent  ( e . g .  ScopedSearchAction ).  NULL   for   direct   human - initiated   searches .

Fields.Name: Query
Fields.Description: Raw   query   string   the   user  /  agent   submitted .  NVARCHAR ( MAX )  because   some   queries   are   long  ( full   sentences ,  snippets ).  Stored   verbatim   for   analytics  —  do   NOT   rely   on   this   for   permission   decisions .

Fields.Name: TotalDurationMs
Fields.Description: End - to - end   search   duration   in   milliseconds ,  measured   at   the   SearchEngine . search   call   boundary  ( provider   runs  +  fusion  +  rerank  +  permission   filter  +  enrichment ).

Fields.Name: ResultCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   results   returned   to   the   caller   after   permission   filtering ,  deduplication ,  and   score - threshold   trimming .  Use   this   as   the   hit - rate   denominator  ( rows   where   ResultCount  >  0 ).

Fields.Name: RerankerName
Fields.Description: BaseReRanker . Name   of   the   reranker   that   ran  ( e . g . ' Cohere ', ' Voyage ', ' OpenAI ', ' BGE ', ' NoopReRanker ').  NULL   when   no   rerank   stage   executed   for   this   invocation .

Fields.Name: RerankerCostCents
Fields.Description: Total   reranker   spend   in   cents   for   this   invocation ,  populated   from   the   BaseReRanker . CostReporter   callback   via   RerankerBudgetGuard .  NULL   when   no   rerank   ran   or   no   real - provider   cost   was   incurred  ( Noop  /  BGE ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Outcome   of   the   search : ' Success ' ( results   returned ,  possibly   empty ), ' Failure ' ( an   exception   bubbled   out  —  see   FailureReason ), ' Forbidden ' ( the   caller   lacked   SearchScopePermission   for   the   requested   scope ).  Constrained   by   CK_SearchExecutionLog_Status .

Fields.Name: FailureReason
Fields.Description: Short   human - readable   failure   reason   when   Status  = ' Failure '  or  ' Forbidden '.  NULL   on   success .

Fields.Name: ProvidersJSON
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   per - provider   breakdown   entries : [{" Provider ":" Vector "," DurationMs ": 123 ," ResultCount ": 5 ," ErrorMessage ": null }, ...].  Used   by   the   analytics   dashboard   for   p50 / p95   latency - by - provider   charts   and   to   spot   consistently   slow   providers .

Fields.Name: AISkillID
Fields.Description: The   AI   Skill   on   whose   behalf   this   search   ran ,  or   NULL   for   a   search   with   no   active   skill .  Mirrors   AIAgentID :  since   a   skill   is   a   search   principal   in   its   own   right  ( AISkill . SearchScopeAccess   plus   MJ :  AI   Skill   Search   Scopes   rows   can   reach   a   scope   the   user ' s   own   roles   do   not   grant ),  the   log   must   record   which   skill   was   active   or   the   entitlement   decision   cannot   be   reconstructed .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: The   tenant   this   search   ran   for ,  taken   from   SearchContext . PrimaryScopeRecordID .  Lets   a   multi - tenant   deployment   partition ,  filter   and   retain   search   audit   history   per   customer .  NULL   for   untenanted   searches .  Named   for   the   existing   primary - scope   concept   rather   than   OrganizationID   because   a   scope ' s   primary   scope   may   be   a   Company ,  Client   or   Practice .

Fields.Name: ScopeDecisionJSON
Fields.Description: Serialized   ScopeExplanation   recording   WHY   this   search   could   reach   what   it   reached :  the   entitlement   decision   and   the   grant   that   produced   it ,  every   dimension   with   its   provenance  ( CallerSupplied  /  ServerDerived  /  Default  /  DiscardedCaller  /  Absent ),  and   each   lane ' s   rendered   filter   with   its   active - or - skipped   status   and   reason .  Identical   in   shape   to   the   value   returned   by   SearchEngine . ExplainScope (),  so   the   dry - run   an   administrator   previews   before   running   a   search   is   the   same   structure   the   audit   log   stores   afterwards .  NULL   when   the   engine   did   not   capture   a   decision  ( older   writers ,  or   a   failure   before   scope   resolution ).

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   this   search   provider  ( e . g ., " Vector   Search ", " Algolia ")

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human - readable   description   of   what   this   provider   searches   and   how   it   works

Fields.Name: DriverClass
Fields.Description: ClassFactory   key   used   with  @ RegisterClass ( ISearchProvider ,  DriverClass )  to   instantiate   the   provider   at   runtime

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Provider   lifecycle   status :  Pending  ( not   yet   activated ),  Active  ( in   use ),  Terminated  ( disabled )

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Execution   priority  ( lower  =  higher   priority ).  Controls   provider   ordering   and   can   influence   RRF   weighting .  Must   be  >=  0 .

Fields.Name: SupportsPreview
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   should   run   during   fast   preview / autocomplete   searches .  Expensive   providers  ( external   APIs )  may   set   this   to   0 .

Fields.Name: MaxResultsOverride
Fields.Description: Optional   per - provider   cap   on   the   number   of   results   to   return .  Useful   for   rate - limited   or   pay - per - query   external   APIs .  When   NULL ,  uses   the   SearchEngine   default .

Fields.Name: ProviderConfig
Fields.Description: Optional   JSON   configuration   blob   for   provider - specific   settings  ( e . g .,  API   endpoints ,  index   names ,  tuning   parameters ).  Schema   is   provider - defined .

Fields.Name: CredentialID
Fields.Description: Optional   FK   to   the   Credential   entity   for   providers   that   require   authentication  ( e . g .,  Algolia   API   key ,  external   service   credentials )

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: UI   display   name   for   this   provider   shown   in   filter   facets   and   result   grouping  ( e . g ., " Database ", " Semantic   Search ").  When   NULL ,  falls   back   to   the   Name   column .

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: CSS   icon   class   for   UI   display   in   filter   facets   and   result   badges  ( e . g ., " fa - solid   fa - database ", " fa - solid   fa - brain ").  Supports   any   CSS - based   icon   library .  When   NULL ,  a   default   icon   is   used .

Fields.Name: Comments
Fields.Description: Free - form   notes   about   this   provider   configuration

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Entities
entities.Description: Controls   which   entities   participate   in   entity   and   full - text   search   within   a   scope ,  with   optional   per - entity   filter   and   user - search - string   overrides .

Fields.Name: ExtraFilter
Fields.Description: Optional   SQL   filter   applied   to   this   entity ' s   search   within   this   scope .  Example :  Status =' Published '  AND   DepartmentID =' abc '.  Rendered   as   a   Nunjucks   template   with   SearchContext   variables   for   multi - tenant   filtering .

Fields.Name: UserSearchString
Fields.Description: Optional   override   for   the   UserSearchString   passed   to   RunView   for   this   entity   within   this   scope .  Nunjucks   template  ( e . g ., "{{  query  }}  AND   type : policy ").  NULL  =  pass   the   user ' s   actual   query   through   as - is .

Fields.Name: RequiredMetadataKeys
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   column   or   alias   names   the   rendered   ExtraFilter   MUST   reference   for   this   lane   to   be   considered   safe ,  e . g . [" OrganizationID "," ContentSourceID "].  Checked   against   the   RENDERED   filter   at   search   time :  if   one   is   missing   the   lane   is   SKIPPED   rather   than   queried ,  because   a   partially - rendered   filter  ( an  {%  if  %}  clause   dropped   when   its   dimension   was   absent   or   discarded )  is   still   valid   SQL   and   silently   widens   the   search .  Same   concept   and   same   engine   check   as   SearchScopeExternalIndex . RequiredMetadataKeys ,  applied   to   the   SQL   lane .  NULL  =  no   contract   declared ,  which   is   the   pre - migration   behaviour .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   External   Indexes
entities.Description: Scoped   external / provider - owned   indexes .  Generic  —  covers   vector   stores  ( Pinecone ,  Qdrant ,  PGVector )  and   text / hybrid   engines  ( Elasticsearch ,  Typesense ,  Azure   AI   Search ,  OpenSearch ).  A   single   scope   can   mix   types ;  each   row   is   consumed   only   by   the   provider   matching   its   IndexType .

Fields.Name: IndexType
Fields.Description: Discriminator .  Determines   which   provider   class   consumes   this   row :  Vector  |  Elasticsearch  |  Typesense  |  AzureAISearch  |  OpenSearch  |  Other .

Fields.Name: VectorIndexID
Fields.Description: FK   to   VectorIndex .  REQUIRED   when   IndexType =' Vector '.  NULL   for   all   other   IndexType   values .

Fields.Name: ExternalIndexName
Fields.Description: For   non - vector   IndexTypes :  the   remote   engine ' s   index / collection / alias   name  ( e . g .,  Elasticsearch   index  " kb_docs_v3 ",  Typesense   collection  " articles ").  NULL   for   IndexType =' Vector ' ( VectorIndexID   resolves   the   name   instead ).

Fields.Name: ExternalIndexConfig
Fields.Description: JSON   with   extra   connection / config   hints   the   provider   needs  ( cluster   alias ,  routing   key ,  custom   analyzer ,  etc .).  Provider - interpreted .

Fields.Name: MetadataFilter
Fields.Description: JSON   filter   expression   applied   as   a   native   metadata   filter   on   the   remote   engine .  Pinecone / Qdrant / PGVector   metadata   filter ,  or   Elasticsearch   filter   DSL ,  etc .  Rendered   as   a   Nunjucks   template   so   SearchContext . PrimaryScopeRecordID   and   SearchContext . SecondaryScopes .*  can   be   interpolated   for   multi - tenant   filtering .

Fields.Name: RequiredMetadataKeys
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   metadata   key   names   the   rendered   MetadataFilter   MUST   constrain   on   for   this   lane   to   be   considered   safe ,  e . g . [" OrganizationID "," ContentSourceID "].  Checked   against   the   RENDERED   filter   at   search   time :  if   a   key   is   missing   the   lane   is   SKIPPED   rather   than   queried ,  because   a   partially - rendered   filter   silently   widens   the   search .  This   also   documents   the   ingest   contract  —  these   are   the   labels   the   writer   must   stamp   on   every   document   in   the   index ,  since   a   filter   on   a   key   that   was   never   written   either   matches   nothing   or  ( on   providers   that   ignore   unknown   keys )  matches   everything .  NULL  =  no   contract   declared ,  which   is   the   pre - migration   behaviour .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Permissions
entities.Description: Per - user   or   per - role   permission   grant   on   a   SearchScope .  Exactly   one   of   UserID   or   RoleID   is   set   on   each   row ;  the   other   is   NULL .  PermissionLevel   is   one   of   None ,  Read ,  Search ,  Manage .  Combined   with   AIAgent . SearchScopeAccess   for   agent - side   fallbacks   via   the   SearchScopePermissionResolver .

Fields.Name: ID
Fields.Description: Primary   key .  Auto - generated .

Fields.Name: SearchScopeID
Fields.Description: The   SearchScope   this   permission   row   applies   to .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   user   this   permission   applies   to .  Mutually   exclusive   with   RoleID  —  exactly   one   must   be   set .

Fields.Name: RoleID
Fields.Description: The   role   this   permission   applies   to .  Mutually   exclusive   with   UserID  —  exactly   one   must   be   set .  Permissions   granted   via   roles   flow   to   all   users   in   that   role .

Fields.Name: PermissionLevel
Fields.Description: Capability   granted   on   this   SearchScope .  None  =  explicit   deny  ( overrides   role   grants ),  Read  =  view   scope   metadata ,  Search  =  invoke   ScopedSearchAction ,  Manage  =  full   edit   including   authoring   of   permission   rows .  The   resolver   picks   the   highest   level   when   multiple   grants   apply  ( direct  +  role ).

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Optional   start   of   the   window   in   which   this   grant   applies .  NULL  =  no   lower   bound .  SearchScopePermission   was   the   only   member   of   this   family   without   a   time   window ,  so   temporary   grants   previously   needed   a   bespoke   mechanism .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: Optional   end   of   the   window   in   which   this   grant   applies .  NULL  =  no   upper   bound .

Fields.Name: PrimaryScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: Optional   tenant   this   grant   is   limited   to ,  matched   against   SearchContext . PrimaryScopeRecordID   at   search   time   and   type - checkable   against   the   scope ' s   own   PrimaryScopeEntityID .  NULL  =  applies   to   every   tenant ,  which   is   the   pre - migration   behaviour   for   all   existing   rows .  Deliberately   NOT   called   OrganizationID :  MJ   is   domain - agnostic   and   a   scope ' s   primary   scope   may   be   a   Company ,  Client   or   Practice ,  so   this   reuses   the   existing   primary - scope   concept   rather   than   inventing   a   parallel   tenancy   column .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Providers
entities.Description: Controls   which   SearchProviders   participate   in   a   given   SearchScope .  Each   row   enables   one   provider   within   one   scope ,  with   optional   overrides .

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   is   active   for   this   scope .  Lets   an   admin   toggle   providers   off   per - scope   without   deleting   the   row .

Fields.Name: MaxResultsOverride
Fields.Description: Override   the   max - results   value   for   this   provider   within   this   scope .  NULL  =  use   the   provider ' s   default .

Fields.Name: ProviderConfigOverride
Fields.Description: JSON   override   for   provider - specific   configuration   within   this   scope .  Provider   interprets .

Fields.Name: QueryTransformTemplateID
Fields.Description: Optional   FK   to   Templates .  When   set ,  the   user / agent   query   is   rewritten   through   this   Template   before   being   sent   to   this   provider .  Lets   vector   providers   get   a   chunk - shaped   rewrite   while   FTS   providers   get   keyword   extraction   within   the   same   scope .  Resolution   order :  this  >  AIAgentSearchScope . QueryTemplateID  >  raw   lastUserMessage .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Storage   Accounts
entities.Description: Controls   which   file   storage   accounts / folders   participate   in   a   scope .

Fields.Name: FolderPath
Fields.Description: Optional   folder   path   restriction .  NULL  =  entire   storage   account .  Example : / policies / hr /.  Rendered   as   a   Nunjucks   template   with   SearchContext   variables   so   platforms   can   do   per - tenant   folder   routing   like  / tenants /{{  context . PrimaryScopeRecordID  }}/.

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Test   Queries
entities.Description: Canonical   test   queries   owned   by   a   SearchScope .  Used   by   scope   authors   to   validate   tuning   changes  —  re - run   a   saved   query   after   swapping   the   reranker   or   adjusting   fusion   weights   and   compare   results   to   the   prior   run .

Fields.Name: SearchScopeID
Fields.Description: The   SearchScope   this   test   query   belongs   to .  Cascade - restricted   via   FK   so   accidental   scope   deletion   preserves   test   history .

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: Short   human - readable   label   for   the   test   query ,  shown   in   the   form ' s   test - query   grid  ( e . g . " VIP   customer   escalation ", " expense   reimbursement   policy ").

Fields.Name: Query
Fields.Description: The   query   text   itself .  NVARCHAR ( MAX )  because   canonical   queries   can   be   full   sentences   or   chunks   of   natural - language   context .

Fields.Name: ExpectedTopResultEntity
Fields.Description: Optional   MJ   entity   name  ( e . g . " Contacts ", " Documents ")  of   the   expected   top   result .  When   set   together   with   ExpectedTopResultRecordID ,  lets   the   test   runner   assert   that   the   tuned   scope   returns   the   right   record   at   rank  # 1  —  a   regression   tripwire   for   fusion  /  reranker   changes .

Fields.Name: ExpectedTopResultRecordID
Fields.Description: Optional   record   ID   of   the   expected   top   result ,  paired   with   ExpectedTopResultEntity .  NULL  =  no   assertion  ( the   query   is   exploratory ).

Fields.Name: Notes
Fields.Description: Free - form   notes   explaining   why   this   query   is   canonical   or   what   edge   case   it   represents .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scopes
entities.Description: A   named ,  reusable   boundary   defining   WHICH   content   participates   in   a   search  ( providers ,  external   indexes ,  entities ,  storage   accounts ).  Combined   with   a   runtime   SearchContext ,  it   enables   multi - tenant ,  permission - aware ,  agent - friendly   retrieval .  See   plans / search - scopes - rag - plus . md .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   scope   name  ( e . g ., " HR   Policies ", " Engineering   Docs ").  Unique   across   the   system .

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   what   this   scope   covers .  Surfaced   to   agents   in   the   available - scopes   prompt   injection   so   the   LLM   can   choose   a   scope .

Fields.Name: Icon
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome  ( or   equivalent )  icon   class   used   by   the   scope   selector   UI .

Fields.Name: IsGlobal
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   scope   includes   everything  ( equivalent   to   no   scope   filtering ).  Exactly   one   Global   scope   should   exist ;  it   is   seeded   via   metadata   sync .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: If   true ,  this   is   the   default   scope   for   users / agents   that   do   not   specify   one .

Fields.Name: OwnerUserID
Fields.Description: NULL  =  organization - wide   scope .  Set  =  personal   scope   owned   by   this   user  ( visible / usable   only   by   that   user   unless   explicitly   shared ).

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status .  Only   Active   scopes   are   considered   at   query   time .

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Optional   time - window   activation .  Scope   is   inactive   before   StartAt .  NULL  =  immediately   active .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: Optional   time - window   deactivation .  Scope   is   inactive   after   EndAt .  NULL  =  no   expiry .

Fields.Name: ScopeConfig
Fields.Description: JSON   configuration   for   advanced   scope   behavior .  Recognized   keys :  rrfK  ( RRF   k   parameter ),  fusionWeights  ( per - provider   weights ),  reRanker  ( optional   re - ranker   stage   config :  driverClass ,  inputTopN ,  outputTopN ,  config ),  permissionOverfetchFactor .

Fields.Name: SearchContextConfig
Fields.Description: JSON   defining   available   multi - tenant   SearchContext   dimensions ,  inheritance   modes ,  and   validation   rules .  Uses   the   SecondaryScopeConfig   structure   shared   with   the   agent   memory   system  (@ memberjunction / ai - core - plus ).  NULL  =  scope   is   not   multi - tenant   aware .

Fields.Name: RerankerBudgetCents
Fields.Description: Optional   cap   on   reranker   spend  ( in   cents )  per   search   invocation   against   this   scope .  NULL   means   uncapped  —  existing   behavior .  When   set ,  the   SearchEngine ' s   budget   guard   short - circuits   any   reranker   call   whose   projected   cost   would   push   the   run   total   past   this   value ,  and   accumulates   actual   post - call   cost   via   each   reranker ' s   CostReporter   callback  ( BaseReRanker . CostReporter ).  Real - provider   rerankers  ( Cohere ,  Voyage ,  OpenAI )  report   cost ;  NoopReRanker   and   BGEReRanker   report   zero  ( local  /  pass - through ).

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human - readable   account   name  ( e . g . " Acme   Prod   DocuSign ").

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   account   is   available   for   use .  Inactive   accounts   are   not   pre - initialized   by   the   engine   driver   cache .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   the   default   account   for   its   provider  ( and   Company ,  when   scoped ).

Fields.Name: DefaultFromName
Fields.Description: Default   sender   display   name   for   envelopes   from   this   account .

Fields.Name: DefaultFromEmail
Fields.Description: Default   sender   email   for   envelopes   from   this   account .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   of   non - secret   per - account   overrides  ( e . g .  accountId ,  restBase ).  Merged   over   provider   Configuration   and   under   decrypted   credential   values   at   driver   initialize ().

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   eSignature   provider   type  ( e . g .  DocuSign ,  Adobe   Sign ).

Fields.Name: ServerDriverKey
Fields.Description: Driver   key   resolved   at   runtime   via   MJGlobal . ClassFactory . CreateInstance ( BaseSignatureProvider ,  ServerDriverKey ).  MUST   match   the  @ RegisterClass   key   on   the   concrete   driver  ( e . g . ' DocuSign ').

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   type   is   available   for   use .  Inactive   providers   are   skipped   by   the   engine .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Selection   priority   when   multiple   providers   could   apply .  Lower   number  =  higher   priority .

Fields.Name: RequiresOAuth
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   requires   OAuth - based   credentials  ( vs .  a   static   API   key ).

Fields.Name: SupportsTemplates
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   supports   creating   envelopes   from   provider - hosted   templates  ( ApplyTemplate   operation ).

Fields.Name: SupportsEmbeddedSigning
Fields.Description: Whether   this   provider   supports   embedded  ( in - app )  signing   URLs  ( CreateEmbeddedSigningUrl   operation ).

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: JSON   of   non - secret   provider - type   defaults  ( e . g .  oauthBase ,  restBase ).  Merged   under   per - account   Configuration   and   decrypted   credential   values   at   driver   initialize ().

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Document   filename   as   presented   to   the   provider  /  signer .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ordering   of   this   document   within   the   envelope  ( 1 - based ).

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: Document   role :  Source  =  the   document   sent   for   signature ;  Signed  =  the   executed   document   downloaded   after   completion  ( written   back   as   a   new   Artifact   Version ).

Fields.Name: Operation
Fields.Description: The   provider   operation   logged  ( e . g .  CreateEnvelope ,  GetEnvelopeStatus ,  DownloadSignedDocument ,  VoidEnvelope ,  Webhook ).

Fields.Name: Success
Fields.Description: Whether   the   operation   succeeded .

Fields.Name: StatusBefore
Fields.Description: Signature   request   status   immediately   before   the   operation ,  when   applicable .

Fields.Name: StatusAfter
Fields.Description: Signature   request   status   immediately   after   the   operation ,  when   applicable .

Fields.Name: Detail
Fields.Description: Free - form   detail :  error   text   on   failure ,  or   normalized   event   JSON   for   webhook   entries .

Fields.Name: Email
Fields.Description: Recipient   email   address .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Recipient   display   name .

Fields.Name: RoutingOrder
Fields.Description: Signing   order ;  lower   routes   first  ( 1 - based ).

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: Template   role   name   for   this   recipient ,  when   the   envelope   was   created   from   a   provider   template .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Per - recipient   status :  Created ,  Sent ,  Delivered ,  Signed ,  or   Declined .

Fields.Name: SignedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   this   recipient   signed .

Fields.Name: ExternalRecipientID
Fields.Description: Provider - side   recipient   identifier ,  for   correlation   with   provider   events .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Envelope   title  /  email   subject .

Fields.Name: Message
Fields.Description: Optional   email   body  /  message   sent   to   recipients   with   the   envelope .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Normalized   envelope   lifecycle   status :  Draft ,  Sent ,  Delivered ,  Signed ,  Completed ,  Declined ,  or   Voided .

Fields.Name: ExternalEnvelopeID
Fields.Description: Provider - side   envelope   identifier  ( e . g .  DocuSign   envelopeId ),  assigned   after   the   envelope   is   created .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: Polymorphic   reference  ( entity   half ):  the   Entity   of   the   originating   business   record   that   owns   this   signature   request .  NULL   for   standalone   requests .  Paired   with   RecordID .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Polymorphic   reference  ( record   half ):  the   primary   key   value   of   the   originating   business   record   in   the   entity   named   by   EntityID .  NULL   for   standalone   requests .

Fields.Name: SentAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   the   envelope   was   sent   to   recipients .

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   the   envelope   reached   a   terminal   completed   state  ( all   recipients   signed ).

Fields.Name: VoidReason
Fields.Description: Reason   supplied   when   the   envelope   was   voided / cancelled .

entities.Name: MJ :  Skills
entities.Description: A   hierarchical   list   of   possible   skills   that   are   linked   to   Employees   and   can   also   be   linked   to   any   other   entity

entities.Name: MJ :  State   Provinces
entities.Description: Reference   table   for   states ,  provinces ,  and   first - level   administrative   divisions .  Linked   to   Country   via   FK .  Seeded   with  ~ 5 , 000   records   with   ISO   3166 - 2   codes ,  centroids ,  and   optional   boundary   GeoJSON .

Fields.Name: CountryID
Fields.Description: Foreign   key   to   Country .  Establishes   the   parent   country   for   this   state / province .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Full   state / province   name  ( e . g ., " California ", " Ontario ").

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Short   code   within   the   country  ( e . g ., " CA ", " ON ").  Unique   per   country   via   compound   constraint .

Fields.Name: ISO3166_2
Fields.Description: ISO   3166 - 2   subdivision   code  ( e . g ., " US - CA ", " CA - ON ").  Globally   unique .

Fields.Name: Latitude
Fields.Description: Geographic   centroid   latitude .  Used   as   fallback   point   for   state - level   geocoding .

Fields.Name: Longitude
Fields.Description: Geographic   centroid   longitude .  Used   as   fallback   point   for   state - level   geocoding .

Fields.Name: BoundaryGeoJSON
Fields.Description: Medium - resolution  (~ 50m )  GeoJSON   boundary   polygon   for   choropleth   map   rendering .  Nullable .  Total  ~ 15 - 20MB   for   all   states / provinces   worldwide .

Fields.Name: CommonAliases
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   common   aliases  ( e . g ., [" Calif ."," California "," Cal "]).  Used   by   GeoResolver   for   fuzzy   text - to - state   matching .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Audit   Logs
entities.Description: Immutable   audit   trail   for   all   tag   taxonomy   changes .  Each   row   records   a   single   action   with   before / after   details   in   JSON .

Fields.Name: TagID
Fields.Description: The   tag   that   was   acted   upon .

Fields.Name: Action
Fields.Description: The   type   of   action   performed :  Created ,  Renamed ,  Moved  ( parent   changed ),  Merged  ( into   RelatedTagID ),  Split  ( from   RelatedTagID ),  Deprecated ,  Reactivated ,  Deleted ,  DescriptionChanged .

Fields.Name: Details
Fields.Description: JSON   object   with   action - specific   details .  For   Renamed : {" OldName ":"..."," NewName ":"..."}.  For   Moved : {" OldParentID ":"..."," NewParentID ":"..."}.  For   Merged : {" ItemsMoved ": 42 }.

Fields.Name: PerformedByUserID
Fields.Description: User   who   performed   the   action .

Fields.Name: RelatedTagID
Fields.Description: For   Merged   actions :  the   surviving   tag .  For   Split   actions :  the   source   tag .  NULL   for   other   actions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Co   Occurrences
entities.Description: Materialized   co - occurrence   counts   for   tag   pairs .  Records   how   many   content   items   share   both   tags .  Used   for   taxonomy   health   analysis ,  merge   suggestions ,  and   cross - entity   intelligence .  Recomputed   periodically   by   the   pipeline .

Fields.Name: TagAID
Fields.Description: First   tag   in   the   canonical   pair  ( TagAID  <  TagBID   ensures   each   pair   is   stored   exactly   once ).

Fields.Name: CoOccurrenceCount
Fields.Description: Number   of   content   items  ( or   entity   records   via   TaggedItem )  that   are   tagged   with   both   TagA   and   TagB .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Scopes
entities.Description: Polymorphic   junction   binding   a   Tag   to   one   or   more  ( Entity ,  Record )  scope   rows .  A   Tag   with   one   or   more   TagScope   rows   is   only   visible   inside   those   scopes ;  a   Tag   with   no   rows   AND   IsGlobal = 1   is   visible   everywhere .  Mirrors   the   shape   of   TaggedItem .

Fields.Name: TagID
Fields.Description: The   Tag   whose   visibility   this   row   constrains .

Fields.Name: ScopeEntityID
Fields.Description: Entity   that   the   scope   record   belongs   to  ( e . g .,  Companies ,  AI   Agents ).  Combined   with   ScopeRecordID   identifies   the   specific   tenant   or   context   that   may   see   the   tag .

Fields.Name: ScopeRecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   value   of   the   scope   record .  Stored   as   NVARCHAR ( 450 )  to   match   the   polymorphic   RecordID   convention   used   by   TaggedItem .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Suggestions
entities.Description: Human - in - the - loop   review   queue   for   tag   changes   the   autotagger   could   not   commit   autonomously :  ambiguous   matches ,  governance - blocked   auto - grows ,  low - usage   deprecation   candidates ,  and   merge   candidates   from   co - occurrence   analysis .

Fields.Name: ProposedName
Fields.Description: The   proposed   tag   name   as   seen   by   the   classifier   or   analyzer .

Fields.Name: ProposedParentID
Fields.Description: Tag   under   which   the   suggestion   would   be   created   if   approved   as   a   new   tag .  NULL  =  root .

Fields.Name: BestMatchTagID
Fields.Description: When   non - null ,  the   existing   Tag   the   system   believes   is   the   closest   match .  The   reviewer   may   accept   this   as   a   merge   target   instead   of   creating   a   new   tag .

Fields.Name: BestMatchScore
Fields.Description: Cosine   similarity   score  ( 0 . 000 - 1 . 000 )  between   the   proposed   name   embedding   and   BestMatchTagID ' s   embedding ,  when   applicable .

Fields.Name: Reason
Fields.Description: Why   this   suggestion   was   created .  Free - form   NVARCHAR   for   forward   compatibility ;  conventional   values   include   ConstrainedMode ,  BelowThreshold ,  ParentFrozen ,  AutoGrowDisabled ,  MaxChildrenExceeded ,  MaxDepthExceeded ,  BelowMinWeight ,  RequiresReview ,  MergeCandidate ,  LowUsage ,  WideNode .

Fields.Name: SourceContentItemID
Fields.Description: ContentItem   that   triggered   this   suggestion ,  when   item - level .  NULL   for   taxonomy - level   suggestions  ( merge   candidates ,  low - usage   alerts ).

Fields.Name: SourceContentSourceID
Fields.Description: ContentSource   that   triggered   this   suggestion ,  when   source - attributable .

Fields.Name: SourceText
Fields.Description: Optional   snippet   of   source   text   that   prompted   the   suggestion .  Useful   for   reviewer   context .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Pending  =  awaiting   review ;  Approved  =  accepted   as   a   new   tag ;  Merged  =  accepted   as   a   merge   into   BestMatchTagID ;  Rejected  =  dismissed .

Fields.Name: ResolvedTagID
Fields.Description: When   Approved   or   Merged ,  points   to   the   resulting   Tag  ( the   new   tag   for   Approved ,  the   merge   target   for   Merged ).

Fields.Name: ReviewedByUserID
Fields.Description: User   who   took   action   on   this   suggestion .

Fields.Name: ReviewedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   of   the   review   action .

Fields.Name: ReviewerNotes
Fields.Description: Free - form   notes   captured   at   review   time .  Useful   for   rejection   rationale   or   merge   decisions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Synonyms
entities.Description: Alternate   names   that   should   resolve   to   a   Tag   during   autotagging .  Consulted   before   exact / fuzzy / semantic   match   tiers   in   TagEngine . ResolveTag .

Fields.Name: TagID
Fields.Description: The   Tag   this   synonym   maps   to .

Fields.Name: Synonym
Fields.Description: The   alternate   name   that   should   resolve   to   the   Tag .  Case - insensitive ;  uniqueness   is   enforced   per - Tag   via   UQ_TagSynonym_Tag_Synonym .

Fields.Name: Source
Fields.Description: How   this   synonym   was   introduced .  Manual  =  admin - authored ;  LLM  =  suggested   by   an   LLM   run ;  Imported  =  bulk - loaded ;  Merged  =  inherited   from   a   tag   merged   into   this   one .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Approval   state   of   the   synonym .  Active  =  resolves   to   its   tag   during   classification .  Pending  =  proposed  ( e . g .  by   the   LLM   or   a   bulk   import )  and   awaiting   human   review ;  does   not   resolve   until   approved .  Rejected  =  reviewed   and   declined ;  retained   for   audit   and   to   suppress   re - proposal .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tagged   Items

Fields.Name: RecordID

Lower   values   indicate   decreasing   relevance   as   determined   by   LLM   autotagging .  Default   1 . 0   for   manually   applied   tags .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tags
entities.Description: Tags   are   used   to   arbitrarily   associate   any   record   in   any   entity   with   addtional   information .

Fields.Name: DisplayName
Fields.Description: Field   DisplayName   for   entity   Tags .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   status   of   the   tag :  Active  ( in   use ),  Merged  ( consolidated   into   another   tag ),  Deprecated  ( no   longer   assigned   but   preserved ),  Deleted  ( soft - deleted ).

Fields.Name: MergedIntoTagID
Fields.Description: When   Status   is   Merged ,  points   to   the   surviving   tag   this   tag   was   merged   into .  All   TaggedItem   and   ContentItemTag   references   are   re - pointed   during   merge .

Fields.Name: IsGlobal
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   tag   is   visible   to   every   tenant / scope .  When   0 ,  the   tag   is   only   visible   to   the  ( Entity ,  Record )  pairs   listed   in   TagScope .  Cannot   be   set   together   with   TagScope   rows  —  enforced   in   entity   Save ()  override .

Fields.Name: AllowAutoGrow
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  the   autotagger   may   auto - create   new   child   tags   under   this   node   when   running   in   AutoGrow   or   FreeFlow   mode .  When   0 ,  new   children   must   come   through   the   TagSuggestion   review   queue .

Fields.Name: IsFrozen
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  this   subtree   is   locked :  no   new   children   may   be   created   under   this   node   or   any   descendant ,  regardless   of   taxonomy   mode .  Existing   children   remain   editable .

Fields.Name: MaxChildren
Fields.Description: Optional   cap   on   the   number   of   direct   children   allowed   under   this   tag .  NULL  =  unlimited .  Auto - grow   is   blocked   once   this   cap   is   reached   and   routed   to   the   TagSuggestion   queue .

Fields.Name: MaxDescendantDepth
Fields.Description: Optional   cap   on   the   depth   of   the   subtree   rooted   at   this   tag .  NULL  =  unlimited .  0  =  leaf - only  ( no   children   at   all ).  Enforced   via   ancestor   walk   during   auto - grow .

Fields.Name: MinWeight
Fields.Description: Optional   minimum   classifier   confidence  ( 0 . 00 - 1 . 00 )  required   for   this   tag   to   be   applied .  Items   below   this   floor   are   routed   to   the   TagSuggestion   queue   instead   of   being   tagged .

Fields.Name: RequiresReview
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  every   classifier - applied   use   of   this   tag   is   routed   to   the   TagSuggestion   queue   for   human   approval   before   being   persisted   as   a   ContentItemTag  →  TaggedItem .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingVector
Fields.Description: JSON - encoded   numeric   vector   representing   the   tag ' s   embedding   under   the   model   identified   by   EmbeddingModelID .  Refreshed   automatically   on   Save ()  when   Name   or   Description   changes .  Used   to   seed   the   in - memory   tag   vector   cache   without   a   cold - start   LLM   round - trip .

Fields.Name: EmbeddingModelID
Fields.Description: AI   model   whose   embedding   produced   EmbeddingVector .  When   the   configured   tag - embedding   model   differs   from   this   value ,  the   cached   vector   is   treated   as   stale   and   recomputed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Task   Dependencies
entities.Description: Defines   dependencies   between   tasks   to   create   a   directed   acyclic   graph  ( DAG )  for   workflow   orchestration

Fields.Name: DependencyType
Fields.Description: Type   of   dependency   relationship  ( Prerequisite ,  Corequisite ,  Optional )

Fields.Name: Condition
Fields.Description: Optional   boolean   expression   gating   this   dependency   edge .  NULL  ( the   default ,  and   the   value   every   pre - existing   row   carries )  means   the   edge   is   unconditional ,  so   adding   this   column   changes   the   meaning   of   no   existing   graph .  When   present   it   is   evaluated   by   the   shared   GraphTraversalEngine   against   the   same   context   a   design - time   AIAgentStepPath . Condition   sees ,  which   is   what   lets   a   runtime   task   graph   and   a   flow - editor   graph   be   the   same   graph .  A   condition   that   evaluates   false   skips   the   edge ;  one   that   fails   to   evaluate   ALSO   skips   it ,  but   is   reported   distinctly   so   a   graph   stalled   by   a   malformed   expression   cannot   be   mistaken   for   one   that   finished   normally .

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Ordering   within   an   exclusive   group  —  higher   wins .  Mirrors   AIAgentStepPath . Priority   so   a   compiled   workflow   chooses   the   same   branch   the   flow   editor   shows .  Ignored   for   edges   that   are   not   part   of   an   ExclusiveGroup .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Deterministic   tiebreak   when   two   edges   in   an   ExclusiveGroup   share   a   Priority ,  applied   ascending .  Load - bearing   rather   than   cosmetic :  compiled   dependencies   get   fresh   UUIDs   and   Priority   defaults   to   0 ,  so   without   a   stored   ordinal   a   tie   would   resolve   by   row   order   and   the   same   workflow   could   take   a   different   branch   on   a   different   machine .

Fields.Name: ExclusiveGroup
Fields.Description: XOR   group   key :  sibling   edges   leaving   the   same   origin   that   share   a   non - null   ExclusiveGroup   are   an   exclusive   fan - out .  The   highest - Priority   satisfied   edge   wins ,  ties   broken   by   ascending   Sequence ;  the   rest   are   Skipped .  NULL  ( the   default )  means   an   ordinary   dependency ,  so   existing   graphs   are   unaffected .  An   unevaluable   condition   anywhere   in   the   group   holds   the   whole   group   rather   than   firing   every   branch .

entities.Name: MJ :  Task   Types
entities.Description: Categorization   system   for   different   types   of   tasks   that   can   be   created   and   managed   within   the   system

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   task   type

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   what   this   task   type   represents   and   when   it   should   be   used

entities.Name: MJ :  Tasks
entities.Description: Core   task   management   entity   supporting   multi - agent   and   multi - human   collaboration   with   dependency   tracking

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   for   the   task

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Detailed   description   of   the   task   requirements   and   objectives

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle   state .  Pending   awaits   prerequisites ;  In   Progress   is   claimed   and   running ;  Complete   succeeded ;  Failed   did   not ;  Blocked   can   never   run   because   a   prerequisite   is   unsatisfiable ;  Cancelled   was   stopped   deliberately ;  Deferred   is   waiting   on   a   schedule .  Skipped   is   a   branch   that   was   NOT   TAKEN   at   an   exclusive   fan - out  —  a   normal   outcome ,  not   a   failure :  it   satisfies   dependents  ( so   a   join   downstream   of   a   fork   still   runs )  and   is   invisible   to   failure   precedence   when   the   parent   rolls   up .

Fields.Name: PercentComplete
Fields.Description: Completion   percentage   for   tracking   progress  ( 0 - 100 )

Fields.Name: DueAt
Fields.Description: Due   date   and   time   for   task   completion

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   work   on   the   task   began

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   the   task   was   completed

Fields.Name: InputPayload
Fields.Description: Structured   input   for   this   task ,  stored   as   JSON .  Replaces   the   legacy   __TASK_METADATA__   marker   that   was   embedded   in   Description .

Fields.Name: OutputPayload
Fields.Description: Structured   output   produced   by   this   task ,  stored   as   JSON .  Downstream   tasks   read   their   dependencies '  outputs   from   here .  Replaces   the   legacy   __TASK_OUTPUT__   marker   that   was   embedded   in   Description .

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Failure   detail   when   Status   is   Failed .  Null   for   tasks   that   have   not   failed .

Fields.Name: AgentRunID
Fields.Description: The   specific   AI   Agent   Run   that   executed   this   task .  Distinct   from   the   conversation - level   link :  sibling   tasks   in   one   graph   each   get   their   own   run ,  so   this   is   what   run - history   and   Gantt   views   should   follow .

Fields.Name: ClaimedBy
Fields.Description: Identifier   of   the   dispatcher   instance   currently   executing   this   task .  Part   of   the   compare - and - swap   claim   protocol ;  set   only   by   the   dispatcher ,  never   by   user - facing   writes .  Null   when   unclaimed .  Human - assigned   tasks   never   carry   a   claim .

Fields.Name: ClaimExpiresAt
Fields.Description: When   the   current   dispatcher   claim   lapses .  Long - running   tasks   extend   it   by   heartbeat ;  reconciliation   treats   an   expired   claim   as   an   orphaned   task   and   returns   it   to   Pending .

Fields.Name: ActionID
Fields.Description: The   Action   this   task   executes ,  when   the   node   is   action - assigned   rather   than   agent - assigned   or   awaiting   a   person .  Mutually   exclusive   with   UserID   and   AgentID  ( CK_Task_Assignment ).  Set   by   durable   entity - action   dispatch ,  where   a   single - node   graph   carries   one   action   to   run   with   restart   recovery .

Fields.Name: StepType
Fields.Description: Which   kind   of   workflow   step   this   task   represents .  NULL   for   a   task   that   is   not   part   of   a   workflow ,  such   as   a   hand - authored   to - do .  Determines   which   of   AgentID / ActionID / PromptID / UserID   is   meaningful   and   how   Configuration   is   read .  This   is   the   executable   vocabulary   and   is   deliberately   not   the   same   value   list   as   AIAgentStep . StepType ,  which   describes   a   step   at   design   time .

Fields.Name: Configuration
Fields.Description: Everything   about   this   step   that   has   no   column   of   its   own ,  as   JSON :  the   loop   definition   for   a   ForEach   or   While   step ,  an   agent   step ' s   message   and   template   parameters ,  the   mappings   that   move   data   between   this   step   and   the   workflow   payload ,  and   the   execution   policy  ( timeout ,  retries ,  what   to   do   on   failure ).  Typed   by   ITaskStepConfiguration .

Fields.Description: Name   of   the   parameter

Fields.Description: Description   of   the   parameter

Fields.Description: Type   of   the   parameter  -  Record   is   an   individual   record   within   the   entity   specified   by   EntityID .  Entity   means   an   entire   Entity   or   an   entity   filtered   by   the   LinkedParameterName / Field   attributes   and / or   ExtraFilter .  Object   is   any   valid   JSON   object . For   example ,  if   the   Entity - based   parameter   is   for   an   entity   like   Activities   and   there   is   another   parameter   of   type   Record   for   an   entity   like   Contacts ,  in   that   situation   the   Activities   Parameter   would   point   to   the   Contacts   parameter   as   the   LinkedParameterName   because   we   would   filter   down   the   Activities   in   each   template   render   to   only   those   linked   to   the   Contact .

Fields.Name: LinkedParameterField

Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   user - assigned   tags / labels   for   this   test   run .  Used   for   categorization ,  filtering ,  and   comparing   runs   with   different   configurations .  Inherits   from   parent   suite   run   tags   if   not   explicitly   set .
